/**
 * Public Feedback & Suggestions Page (Phase 10.3)
 * Route: /feedback
 * Allows visitors to submit criticisms, suggestions, product feedback, and questions
 * without creating an account. Displayed privately only to admins.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Container } from '@/components/ui/container';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { WoodBackground } from '@/components/ui/wood-background';
import { submitFeedbackAction } from '@/server/actions/feedback-actions';
import { CheckCircle2, MessageSquareHeart, ShieldCheck, Sparkles, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';

const FEEDBACK_TYPES = [
  { value: 'SUGGESTION', label: 'پیشنهاد سازنده', icon: '💡' },
  { value: 'CRITICISM', label: 'انتقاد یا شکایت', icon: '⚠️' },
  { value: 'PRODUCT_QUALITY', label: 'کیفیت محصولات', icon: '🍯' },
  { value: 'OTHER', label: 'سایر موارد', icon: '📝' },
];

export default function FeedbackPage() {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    phone: '',
    type: 'SUGGESTION',
    message: '',
    honeypot: '',
  });

  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successCode, setSuccessCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await submitFeedbackAction({
          name: formData.name,
          phone: formData.phone,
          type: formData.type as any,
          message: formData.message,
          honeypot: formData.honeypot,
        });

        if (res.success && res.trackingCode) {
          setSuccessCode(res.trackingCode);
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(res.error || 'خطایی در ثبت فرم رخ داد. لطفاً مجدداً بررسی نمایید.');
        }
      } catch {
        setErrorMessage('خطایی در ارتباط با سرور رخ داد. لطفاً چند لحظه دیگر تلاش فرمایید.');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleCopyCode = () => {
    if (successCode) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(successCode);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setSuccessCode(null);
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      phone: '',
      type: 'SUGGESTION',
      message: '',
      honeypot: '',
    });
  };

  return (
    <WoodBackground className="py-12 sm:py-20 min-h-screen text-[#3F2A1D]">
      <Container size="narrow">
        {/* Page Header */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-10 sm:mb-14 space-y-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FAF5EB] border border-[#D9A441]/40 text-[#C58A2A] text-xs font-black shadow-xs">
            <MessageSquareHeart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#C58A2A]" />
            <span>صدای شما، سرمایه ماست</span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-[#3F2A1D] tracking-tight leading-tight">
            انتقادات و پیشنهادات
          </h1>

          {/* Honeycomb / Diamond Accent Divider */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-1 pb-1" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="h-0.5 w-10 sm:w-16 bg-gradient-to-l from-[#D9A441] to-transparent" />
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rotate-45 bg-[#D9A441]" />
            <span className="h-0.5 w-10 sm:w-16 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D9A441] to-transparent" />
          </div>

          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg text-[#5C3A21] leading-relaxed font-semibold">
            دیدگاه‌ها، پیشنهادات و انتقادات شما مستقیماً توسط مدیریت مجموعه باباخُرم بررسی می‌شود. نظرات شما به ما در ارتقای کیفیت محصولات و خدمات کمک شایانی می‌کند.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Success View */}
        {successCode ? (
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] p-8 sm:p-12 shadow-xl rounded-none text-center space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-[#ECFDF5] text-[#059669] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-xs border border-emerald-200">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#3F2A1D]">
                پیام شما با موفقیت ثبت شد
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#5C3A21] max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed font-medium">
                از اینکه وقت ارزشمند خود را برای بهبود مجموعه با ما به اشتراک گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم. پیام شما به صورت محرمانه در پنل مدیریت قرار گرفت.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Tracking Code Box */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-[#DFD3C3] p-4 max-w-sm mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-none shadow-xs">
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className="text-[11px] text-[#7A6553] font-bold">کد رهگیری اختصاصی:</div>
                <div className="text-lg font-black text-[#C58A2A] font-mono tracking-wider" dir="ltr">
                  {successCode}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCopyCode}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#5C3A21] text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] transition-colors cursor-pointer rounded-none"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span>{copied ? 'کپی شد' : 'کپی کد'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleReset}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-[#3F2A1D] border border-[#DFD3C3] text-sm font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer rounded-none"
              >
                ثبت نظر جدید
              </button>
              <PillButton variant="gold" size="md" href="/">
                بازگشت به صفحه اصلی
              </PillButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Form Container */
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-xl rounded-none">
            {/* Error Banner */}
            {errorMessage && (
              <div
                className="mb-8 p-4 bg-[#FEF2F2] border-s-4 border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556] text-sm leading-relaxed font-bold"
                role="alert"
              >
                {errorMessage}
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
              {/* Honeypot field (hidden from real users, traps bots) */}
              <div className="hidden" aria-hidden="true">
                <label htmlFor="hp_field">لطفاً این فیلد را خالی بگذارید</label>
                <input
                  id="hp_field"
                  type="text"
                  tabIndex={-1}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  value={formData.honeypot}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, honeypot: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Grid: Name & Phone */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="fb_name" className="block text-sm font-black text-[#3F2A1D] mb-2">
                    نام و نام خانوادگی <span className="text-[#9E3556]">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="fb_name"
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="مثال: علی احمدی"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                    disabled={isPending}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#3F2A1D] placeholder-[#7A6553] text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#C58A2A] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D9A441]/30 transition-colors rounded-none disabled:opacity-50"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="fb_phone" className="block text-sm font-black text-[#3F2A1D] mb-2">
                    شماره تماس / موبایل <span className="text-[#9E3556]">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="fb_phone"
                    type="tel"
                    required
                    dir="ltr"
                    placeholder="09xxxxxxxxx"
                    value={formData.phone}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                    disabled={isPending}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#3F2A1D] placeholder-[#7A6553] text-sm text-right focus:outline-none focus:border-[#C58A2A] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D9A441]/30 transition-colors rounded-none disabled:opacity-50"
                  />
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[#5C3A21] mt-1 font-bold">
                    جهت پیگیری در صورت نیاز به پاسخ یا قدردانی
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Message Type Selector */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-black text-[#3F2A1D] mb-2.5">
                  موضوع یا نوع پیام <span className="text-[#9E3556]">*</span>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                  {FEEDBACK_TYPES.map((t) => {
                    const isSelected = formData.type === t.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={t.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setFormData({ ...formData, type: t.value })}
                        disabled={isPending}
                        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3.5 border transition-all text-center cursor-pointer rounded-none ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-[#D9A441] border-[#C58A2A] text-[#2E1F14] font-black shadow-xs ring-2 ring-[#D9A441]/30'
                            : 'bg-white border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#5C3A21] hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] hover:border-[#C58A2A]/50 font-bold'

import React from 'react';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { db } from '@/server/db/client';
import { getPublicSiteSettings } from '@/server/queries/settings';
import { decryptOrderPayload } from '@/server/auth/order-encryption';
import { OrderShareView } from '@/components/public/order-share-view';
import { WoodBackground } from '@/components/ui/wood-background';
import { Container } from '@/components/ui/container';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { AlertCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'لینک موقت سفارش | عسل باباخُرم',
  robots: {
    index: false,
    follow: false,
    nocache: true,
  },
};

interface OrderSharePageProps {
  params: Promise<{
    code: string;
  }>;
}

export default async function OrderSharePage({ params }: OrderSharePageProps) {
  const { code } = await params;

  // 1. Check cartEnabled
  const settings = await getPublicSiteSettings();
  if (!settings.cartEnabled) {
    notFound();
  }

  // 2. Fetch OrderShareLink
  const link = await db.orderShareLink.findUnique({
    where: { code },
  });

  // Unknown Code
  if (!link) {
    return (
      <WoodBackground className="py-20 min-h-screen">
        <Container size="narrow" className="text-center space-y-6 bg-black/40 p-8 border border-white/20">
          <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-[#EF4444] mx-auto" />
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">لینک سفارش یافت نشد</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#E8E2D9] leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">
            کد سفارش وارد شده در سامانه وجود ندارد یا قبلاً پاک شده است.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-4">
            <PillButton variant="gold" size="md" href="/products">
              مشاهده محصولات
            </PillButton>
          </div>
        </Container>
      </WoodBackground>
    );
  }

  // Check Expiry (30 minutes)
  const isExpired = new Date(link.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now();
  if (isExpired) {
    // Lazy deletion on expired access
    try {
      await db.orderShareLink.delete({ where: { id: link.id } });
    } catch {}

    return (
      <WoodBackground className="py-20 min-h-screen">
        <Container size="narrow" className="text-center space-y-6 bg-black/40 p-8 border border-white/20">
          <Clock className="w-12 h-12 text-[#FBBF24] mx-auto" />
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">اعتبار لینک سفارش به پایان رسیده است</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#E8E2D9] leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">
            به دلایل حفظ حریم خصوصی، لینک‌های بارکد سفارش تنها به مدت ۳۰ دقیقه فعال هستند.
            لطفاً در صورت نیاز مجدداً از طریق سبد خرید سایت اقدام به ثبت سفارش فرمایید.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-4">
            <PillButton variant="gold" size="md" href="/cart">
              بازگشت به سبد خرید
            </PillButton>
          </div>
        </Container>
      </WoodBackground>
    );
  }

  // 3. Decrypt Payload
  const decrypted = decryptOrderPayload<{
    orderCode: string;
    messageText: string;
    channelType: any;
    channelValue: string;
    directUrl: string;
  }>(link.payloadEncrypted);

  if (!decrypted) {
    return (
      <WoodBackground className="py-20 min-h-screen">
        <Container size="narrow" className="text-center space-y-6 bg-black/40 p-8 border border-white/20">
          <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-[#EF4444] mx-auto" />
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">خطا در رمزگشایی سفارش</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#E8E2D9]">
            اطلاعات این لینک قابل بازخوانی نیست.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-4">
            <PillButton variant="gold" size="md" href="/cart">
              بازگشت به سبد خرید
            </PillButton>
          </div>
        </Container>
      </WoodBackground>
    );
  }

  return (
    <OrderShareView
      orderCode={decrypted.orderCode}
      messageText={decrypted.messageText}
      channelType={link.channelType}
      channelValue={decrypted.channelValue}
      directUrl={decrypted.directUrl}
      expiresAt={link.expiresAt.toISOString()}
    />
  );
}

  const categoryNames = product.categories
    .map((c: any) => c.category?.name)
    .filter(Boolean);

export default async function RecipeDetailPage({ params }: RecipePageProps) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { recipe, relatedRecipes, redirect } = await getPublicRecipeBySlug(slug);

  // 1. Handle 301 Permanent Redirect
  if (redirect) {
    permanentRedirect(redirect.destination);
  }

  // 2. Handle 404 for Draft/Archived/Missing
  if (!recipe) {
    notFound();
  }

  // 3. Build JSON-LD (schema.org/Recipe per Brief Section 13)
  const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://babakhorram.com';
  const mainImageUrl = recipe.mainImage
    ? `${siteUrl}/uploads/${recipe.mainImage.storageKey}`
    : undefined;

  const categoryNames = recipe.categories
    .map((c: any) => c.category?.name)
    .filter(Boolean);

  const ingredientList = recipe.ingredients.map((ing: any) => {
    const parts = [ing.name, ing.quantityText, ing.unit].filter(Boolean);
    if (ing.isOptional) parts.push('(اختیاری)');
    return parts.join(' ');
  });

  const instructionSteps = recipe.steps.map((step: any, idx: number) => ({
    '@type': 'HowToStep',
    position: idx + 1,
    text: step.text,
  }));

  const jsonLd = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Recipe',
    name: recipe.nameFa,
    image: mainImageUrl,
    description: recipe.shortDescription || recipe.longDescription || undefined,
    recipeYield: recipe.yieldText || undefined,
    recipeCuisine: recipe.country || undefined,
    recipeCategory: categoryNames.length > 0 ? categoryNames.join(', ') : undefined,
    recipeIngredient: ingredientList,
    recipeInstructions: instructionSteps,
  };

  return (
    <>
      <script
        type="application/ld+json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd) }}
      />
      <RecipeDetailView recipe={recipe} relatedRecipes={relatedRecipes} />
    </>
  );

import React from 'react';
import { requireAdmin } from '@/server/auth/require-admin';
import { db } from '@/server/db/client';
import { queryAuditLogs, AuditLogEntry } from '@/server/services/audit-log-service';
import { AuditLogViewer } from './audit-log-viewer';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function AdminAuditLogPage() {
  await requireAdmin({ allowRedirect: true });

  const [initialData, users] = await Promise.all([
    queryAuditLogs({ take: 20 }),
    db.user.findMany({ orderBy: { name: 'asc' } }),
  ]);

  // Server action for loading more or filtering
  async function loadMoreLogsAction(params: {
    userId?: string;
    action?: string;
    entityType?: string;
    dateFrom?: string;
    dateTo?: string;
    cursor?: string;
  }) {
    'use server';
    await requireAdmin({ allowRedirect: false });
    const res = await queryAuditLogs({
      userId: params.userId,
      action: params.action,
      entityType: params.entityType,
      dateFrom: params.dateFrom,
      dateTo: params.dateTo,
      cursor: params.cursor,
      take: 20,
    });
    return {
      logs: res.logs,
      nextCursor: res.nextCursor,
    };
  }

  return (
    <AuditLogViewer
      initialLogs={initialData.logs}
      initialCursor={initialData.nextCursor}
      totalCount={initialData.totalCount}
      users={users}
      onLoadMoreAction={loadMoreLogsAction}
    />
  );
}

/**
 * Category Management Component (Phase 4, Task 1)
 * Features:
 * - Tabs for Product and Recipe category types
 * - Linked item count display
 * - Modal for Create / Edit
 * - Archive / Restore quick toggle
 * - Safe Delete: forbidden and disabled if category has linked items
 */

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';
import {
  createCategoryAction,
  updateCategoryAction,
  toggleCategoryStatusAction,
  deleteCategoryAction,
} from '@/server/actions/category-actions';
import { slugify } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';
import { ConfirmModal } from '@/components/admin/confirm-modal';
import { AdminBadge } from '@/components/admin/admin-badge';

export interface CategoryItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  type: 'PRODUCT' | 'RECIPE';
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'ARCHIVED';
  sortOrder: number;
  productCount?: number;
  recipeCount?: number;
}

export function CategoriesManager({ initialCategories }: { initialCategories: CategoryItem[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'PRODUCT' | 'RECIPE'>('PRODUCT');
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

  // Modal State
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState<CategoryItem | null>(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<{ isOpen: boolean; cat?: CategoryItem }>({ isOpen: false });

  // Form Fields
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'ACTIVE' | 'ARCHIVED'>('ACTIVE');
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<number>(0);

  const filteredCategories = initialCategories.filter((c) => c.type === activeTab);

  const openCreateModal = () => {
    setEditingCategory(null);
    setName('');
    setSlug('');
    setStatus('ACTIVE');
    setSortOrder(filteredCategories.length);
    setNotification(null);
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditModal = (cat: CategoryItem) => {
    setEditingCategory(cat);
    setName(cat.name);
    setSlug(cat.slug);
    setStatus(cat.status);
    setSortOrder(cat.sortOrder);
    setNotification(null);
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleNameChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setName(val);
    if (!editingCategory && !slug) {
      setSlug(slugify(val) || '');
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setNotification(null);

    startTransition(async () => {
      let res;
      if (editingCategory) {
        res = await updateCategoryAction({
          id: editingCategory.id,
          input: { name, slug, status, sortOrder, type: activeTab },
        });
      } else {
        res = await createCategoryAction({
          name,
          slug,
          type: activeTab,
          status,
          sortOrder,
        });
      }

      if (res.success) {
        setNotification({ type: 'success', message: uiStringsFa.adminCategories.savedSuccess });
        setModalOpen(false);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setNotification({ type: 'error', message: res.error || 'خطا در ذخیره' });
      }
    });
  };

  const handleToggleStatus = (cat: CategoryItem) => {
    setNotification(null);
    const newStatus = cat.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ARCHIVED' : 'ACTIVE';
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await toggleCategoryStatusAction({ id: cat.id, status: newStatus });
      if (res.success) {
        setNotification({ type: 'success', message: uiStringsFa.adminCategories.savedSuccess });
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setNotification({ type: 'error', message: res.error || 'خطا در تغییر وضعیت' });
      }
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = (cat: CategoryItem) => {
    const count = activeTab === 'PRODUCT' ? cat.productCount || 0 : cat.recipeCount || 0;
    if (count > 0) {
      toast.error(uiStringsFa.adminCategories.cannotDeleteInUse);
      return;
    }
    setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: true, cat });
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.cat) return;
    const cat = confirmDelete.cat;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteCategoryAction(cat.id);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminCategories.deletedSuccess);
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در حذف دسته‌بندی');
      }
    });
  };

          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#332115]">{uiStringsFa.adminCategories.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-1">{uiStringsFa.adminCategories.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={openCreateModal}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
        >
          <span>+</span>
          <span>{uiStringsFa.adminCategories.createCategory}</span>

          }`}

            activeTab === 'RECIPE'
              ? 'border-[#D97706] text-[#D97706]'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#5C5248] hover:text-[#332115]'
          }`}

              : 'bg-[#FEF2F2] border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556]'

'use client';

/**
 * FeedbacksManagerClient
 * Interactive client table and card manager for feedbacks in the admin panel.
 */

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import {
  updateFeedbackStatusAction,
  deleteFeedbackAction,
} from '@/server/actions/feedback-actions';
import {
  Phone,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle,
  Archive,
  AlertCircle,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Save,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Download,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';
import { ConfirmModal } from '@/components/admin/confirm-modal';
import { exportToCsv } from '@/lib/csv-export';

interface FeedbackItem {
  id: string;
  trackingCode: string;
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  type: string;
  message: string;
  status: string;
  adminNote?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export function FeedbacksManagerClient({
  initialFeedbacks,
}: {
  initialFeedbacks: FeedbackItem[];
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [feedbacks, setFeedbacks] = useState<FeedbackItem[]>(initialFeedbacks);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [notesState, setNotesState] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<{ isOpen: boolean; id?: string; trackingCode?: string }>({
    isOpen: false,
  });

  // Filter items
  const filtered = feedbacks.filter((f) => {
    if (statusFilter !== 'ALL' && f.status !== statusFilter) return false;
    if (typeFilter !== 'ALL' && f.type !== typeFilter) return false;
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const match =
        f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.phone.includes(q) ||
        f.trackingCode.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.message.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      if (!match) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  const handleStatusChange = (id: string, newStatus: string) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateFeedbackStatusAction({
        id,
        status: newStatus as any,
      });
      if (res.success && res.feedback) {
        setFeedbacks((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, status: newStatus } : item))
        );
      }
    });
  };

  const handleSaveNote = (id: string) => {
    const note = notesState[id] !== undefined ? notesState[id] : '';
    startTransition(async () => {
      const currentItem = feedbacks.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!currentItem) return;
      const res = await updateFeedbackStatusAction({
        id,
        status: currentItem.status as any,
        adminNote: note,
      });
      if (res.success && res.feedback) {
        setFeedbacks((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, adminNote: note } : item))
        );
        toast.success('یادداشت داخلی با موفقیت ذخیره شد.');
      } else {
        toast.error('خطا در ذخیره یادداشت');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, trackingCode: string) => {
    setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: true, id, trackingCode });
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.id) return;
    const { id } = confirmDelete;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteFeedbackAction(id);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbacks((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        toast.success('پیام با موفقیت حذف گردید.');
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در حذف پیام');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = ['کد پیگیری', 'نام فرستنده', 'شماره تماس', 'نوع پیام', 'متن پیام', 'وضعیت', 'یادداشت ادمین', 'تاریخ ثبت'];
    const rows = filtered.map((f) => [
      f.trackingCode,
      f.name,
      f.phone,
      f.type === 'SUGGESTION' ? 'پیشنهاد' : 'انتقاد/شکایت',
      f.message,
      f.status,
      f.adminNote || '',
      new Date(f.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR'),
    ]);
    exportToCsv('feedbacks_export', headers, rows);
    toast.success('فایل اکسل نظرات با موفقیت دانلود شد.');
  };

  const handleCopyPhone = (phone: string, id: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(phone);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  const getTypeBadge = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'SUGGESTION':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#92400E] border border-[#FDE68A]">
            💡 پیشنهاد سازنده
          </span>
        );
      case 'CRITICISM':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-[#FEF2F2] text-[#9E3556] border border-[#FECDD3]">
            ⚠️ انتقاد / شکایت
          </span>
        );
      case 'PRODUCT_QUALITY':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-[#EFF6FF] text-[#1E40AF] border border-[#BFDBFE]">
            🍯 کیفیت محصول
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 border border-stone-200">
            📝 سایر موارد
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'UNREAD':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200">
            خوانده‌نشده
          </span>
        );
      case 'REVIEWED':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
            بررسی‌شده
          </span>
        );
      case 'ARCHIVED':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 border border-stone-200">
            بایگانی
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Controls Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-4 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        {/* Status Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {[
              { key: 'ALL', label: 'همه وضعیت‌ها' },
              { key: 'UNREAD', label: 'خوانده‌نشده' },
              { key: 'REVIEWED', label: 'بررسی‌شده' },
              { key: 'ARCHIVED', label: 'بایگانی‌شده' },
            ].map((st) => (
              <button
                key={st.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st.key)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  statusFilter === st.key
                    ? 'bg-[#332115] text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-stone-50 text-[#5C5248] hover:bg-stone-100'
                }`}
              >
                {st.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Type Filter & Export */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportCsv}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-stone-300 hover:bg-stone-50 text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] rounded-none shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>خروجی اکسل (CSV)</span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#5C5248]" />

                className="bg-stone-50 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706] rounded-none"
              >
                <option value="ALL">همه موضوعات</option>
                <option value="SUGGESTION">پیشنهادات</option>
                <option value="CRITICISM">انتقادات</option>
                <option value="PRODUCT_QUALITY">کیفیت محصول</option>
                <option value="OTHER">سایر موارد</option>

            value={searchQuery}

/**
 * HomepageSectionsClient Component (Brief Section 7)
 * Admin table & management controls for ordering, editing, previewing, and deleting sections.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { HomepageSectionViewModel } from '@/server/queries/homepage-sections';
import {
  deleteHomepageSectionAction,
  toggleHomepageSectionStatusAction,
  reorderHomepageSectionAction,
} from '@/server/actions/homepage-actions';
import { TemplateSwitchModal } from '@/components/admin/homepage/template-switch-modal';
import {
  Plus,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  Edit,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  Trash2,
  ExternalLink,
  Eye,
  AlertTriangle,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SectionStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';

export function HomepageSectionsClient({
  initialSections,
}: {
  initialSections: HomepageSectionViewModel[];
}) {
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<HomepageSectionViewModel[]>(initialSections);
  const [activeModalSection, setActiveModalSection] = useState<HomepageSectionViewModel | null>(null);
  const [deleteTargetId, setDeleteTargetId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [isLoadingOrder, setIsLoadingOrder] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleToggleStatus = async (id: string, newStatus: SectionStatus) => {
    const res = await toggleHomepageSectionStatusAction(id, newStatus);
    if (res.success) {
      setSections((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, status: newStatus } : s))
      );
    }
  };

  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    setSections(initialSections);
  }, [initialSections]);

  const handleReorder = async (id: string, direction: 'UP' | 'DOWN') => {
    let originalSections: HomepageSectionViewModel[] = [];
    let updatedSections: HomepageSectionViewModel[] = [];

    // Functional state update: guaranteed latest state, immediate 0ms UI reorder
    setSections((prev) => {
      originalSections = prev;
      const idx = prev.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
      const targetIdx = direction === 'UP' ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;
      if (idx === -1 || targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= prev.length) {
        return prev;
      }
      const next = [...prev];
      const temp = next[idx];
      next[idx] = next[targetIdx];
      next[targetIdx] = temp;
      updatedSections = next.map((item, i) => ({ ...item, sortOrder: i + 1 }));
      return updatedSections;
    });

    if (updatedSections.length === 0) return;

    setIsLoadingOrder(id);
    try {
      const res = await reorderHomepageSectionAction(id, direction);
      if (!res.success) {
        setSections(originalSections);
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در جابه‌جایی سکشن');
      } else {
        toast.success('ترتیب سکشن‌ها با موفقیت تغییر یافت.');
      }
    } catch {
      setSections(originalSections);
      toast.error('خطا در برقراری ارتباط با سرور');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingOrder(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTargetId) return;
    setIsDeleting(true);
    const res = await deleteHomepageSectionAction(deleteTargetId);
    setIsDeleting(false);
    if (res.success) {
      setSections((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== deleteTargetId));
      setDeleteTargetId(null);
      toast.success('سکشن با موفقیت حذف گردید.');
    } else {
      toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در حذف سکشن');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-right">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-stone-200">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#2B2017] tracking-tight">
            مدیریت بخش‌های صفحه اصلی (Homepage CMS)
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500 font-bold mt-1">
            چیدمان سکشن‌ها، تغییر ترتیب نمایش، تنظیم پس‌زمینه چوبی و انتخاب قالب‌های بصری
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href="/admin/preview/homepage"
            target="_blank"
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 hover:bg-stone-50 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-stone-700 transition-colors shadow-xs"
          >
            <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-500" />
            <span>پیش‌نمایش زنده صفحه اصلی</span>
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400" />
          </Link>

          <Link
            href="/admin/homepage/new"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#D97706] text-white font-black text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all shadow-md hover:shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>افزودن بخش جدید</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sections List */}
      {sections.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-black text-lg text-stone-800">هنوز هیچ سکشنی در دیتابیس ثبت نشده است</h3>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed font-bold">
            در حال حاضر صفحه اصلی عمومی از چیدمان پیش‌فرض سیستم استفاده می‌کند. با کلیک بر روی دکمه «افزودن بخش جدید» می‌توانید سکشن‌های دلخواه خود را بسازید.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link
              href="/admin/homepage/new"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#D97706] text-white font-black text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all shadow-md"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>ایجاد اولین سکشن</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {sections.map((section, idx) => {
            const isFirst = idx === 0;
            const isLast = idx === sections.length - 1;
            const isWood = section.background === 'WOOD';

            return (
              <div
                key={section.id}
                id={`admin-section-${section.id}`}
                className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4"
              >
                {/* Reorder Buttons & Status Badge */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isFirst || isLoadingOrder === section.id}
                      onClick={() => handleReorder(section.id, 'UP')}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="انتقال به بالا"
                    >
                      <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isLast || isLoadingOrder === section.id}
                      onClick={() => handleReorder(section.id, 'DOWN')}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="انتقال به پایین"
                    >

                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 flex items-center justify-center font-mono font-black text-xs">

                  </span>

                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-black text-base text-[#2B2017]">

                      </span>

                      {/* Status Badge */}
                      <span

import {
  toggleProductAvailabilityAction,
  duplicateProductAction,
  deleteProductAction,
} from '@/server/actions/product-actions';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';
import { ConfirmModal } from '@/components/admin/confirm-modal';
import { AdminBadge } from '@/components/admin/admin-badge';
import { exportToCsv } from '@/lib/csv-export';
import { Download, Trash2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Plus, Eye, Edit3, Copy } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProductListItem {
  id: string;
  nameFa: string;
  nameOriginal?: string | null;
  slug: string;
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'ARCHIVED';
  isAvailable: boolean;
  isFeatured: boolean;
  cardTheme: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  optionCount: number;
  categorySlug?: string;
  categoryIds?: string[];
  categories?: any[];
  mainImage?: any;
}

export interface ProductsListProps {
  initialProducts: ProductListItem[];
  categories: Array<{ id: string; name: string; slug: string }>;
  totalCount: number;
}

export function ProductsList({ initialProducts, categories, totalCount }: ProductsListProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const [products, setProducts] = useState<ProductListItem[]>(initialProducts);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('');
  const [availabilityFilter, setAvailabilityFilter] = useState('');
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  // Bulk Selection
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Confirm Modal State
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<{ isOpen: boolean; prod?: ProductListItem; isBulk?: boolean }>({
    isOpen: false,
  });

  // Client-side quick filter
  const filtered = products.filter((p) => {
    if (statusFilter && p.status !== statusFilter) return false;
    if (availabilityFilter === 'AVAILABLE' && !p.isAvailable) return false;
    if (availabilityFilter === 'UNAVAILABLE' && p.isAvailable) return false;
    if (categoryFilter && p.categorySlug !== categoryFilter && !p.categoryIds?.includes(`cat_${categoryFilter}`)) return false;
    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      const match =
        (p.nameFa || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.nameOriginal || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.slug || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
      if (!match) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  const displayedItems = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);
  const hasMore = filtered.length > visibleCount;

  const handleToggleAvailability = (prod: ProductListItem) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const newAvail = !prod.isAvailable;
      const res = await toggleProductAvailabilityAction({ id: prod.id, isAvailable: newAvail });
      if (res.success) {
        setProducts((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) => (item.id === prod.id ? { ...item, isAvailable: newAvail } : item))
        );
        toast.success(`وضعیت موجودی «${prod.nameFa}» به ${newAvail ? 'موجود' : 'ناموجود'} تغییر یافت.`);
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در تغییر وضعیت');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleDuplicate = (prod: ProductListItem) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await duplicateProductAction(prod.id);
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminProducts.duplicatedSuccess);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در کپی محصول');
      }
    });
  };

  const confirmDeleteAction = async () => {
    if (confirmDelete.isBulk) {
      // Bulk delete
      const idsToDelete = Array.from(selectedIds);
      startTransition(async () => {
        let deletedCount = 0;
        for (const id of idsToDelete) {
          const res = await deleteProductAction(id);
          if (res.success) deletedCount++;
        }
        setProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => !selectedIds.has(p.id)));
        setSelectedIds(new Set());
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        toast.success(`${deletedCount} محصول با موفقیت حذف گردید.`);
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!confirmDelete.prod) return;
    const prod = confirmDelete.prod;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteProductAction(prod.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== prod.id));
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminProducts.deletedSuccess);
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در حذف محصول');
      }
    });
  };

  // CSV Export
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = ['شناسه', 'نام فارسی', 'نام لاتین', 'اسلاگ', 'وضعیت', 'موجودی', 'تعداد وزن‌ها', 'تم کارت'];
    const rows = filtered.map((p) => [
      p.id,
      p.nameFa,
      p.nameOriginal || '',
      p.slug,
      p.status,
      p.isAvailable ? 'موجود' : 'ناموجود',
      p.optionCount || 0,
      p.cardTheme || 'YELLOW',
    ]);
    exportToCsv('products_export', headers, rows);
    toast.success('فایل اکسل محصولات با موفقیت ایجاد و دانلود شد.');
  };

  // Bulk Selection Handlers
  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.size === displayedItems.length) {
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(new Set(displayedItems.map((p) => p.id)));
    }
  };

  const toggleSelectOne = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleBulkToggleAvailability = (isAvailable: boolean) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
      for (const id of ids) {
        await toggleProductAvailabilityAction({ id, isAvailable });
      }
      setProducts((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (selectedIds.has(item.id) ? { ...item, isAvailable } : item))
      );
      toast.success(`وضعیت موجودی ${ids.length} محصول به‌روزرسانی شد.`);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Add / Export Buttons */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#332115]">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-stone-300 hover:bg-stone-50 text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs rounded-none shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-600" />
            <span>خروجی اکسل (CSV)</span>
          </button>

          <Link
            href="/admin/products/new"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-black text-xs rounded-none shadow-xs transition-colors"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.newProduct}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-4 rounded-none shadow-xs grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {/* Search */}
        <div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={uiStringsFa.adminProducts.searchPlaceholder}
            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706] rounded-none"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Status */}
        <div>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white rounded-none"
          >
            <option value="">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.statusFilter}</option>
            <option value="DRAFT">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.draft}</option>
            <option value="PUBLISHED">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.published}</option>
            <option value="ARCHIVED">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.archived}</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Category */}
        <div>
          <select
            value={categoryFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white rounded-none"
          >
            <option value="">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.categoryFilter}</option>
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.slug}>
                {c.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Availability */}
        <div>
          <select
            value={availabilityFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setAvailabilityFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white rounded-none"
          >
            <option value="">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.availabilityFilter}</option>
            <option value="AVAILABLE">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.availableOnly}</option>
            <option value="UNAVAILABLE">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.unavailableOnly}</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Bulk Actions Bar (ADM-WORKFLOW-03) */}
      {selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="sticky top-20 z-20 bg-[#332115] text-white p-3.5 rounded-none shadow-xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 animate-in slide-in-from-top-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#2B2017] flex items-center justify-center font-black text-[11px]">
              {selectedIds.size}
            </span>
            <span>محصول انتخاب شده است</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleBulkToggleAvailability(true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-none text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>علامت‌گذاری به عنوان موجود</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleBulkToggleAvailability(false)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white rounded-none text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
            >
              <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>علامت‌گذاری به عنوان ناموجود</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: true, isBulk: true })}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-none text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>حذف گروهی</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedIds(new Set())}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-stone-300 hover:text-white text-xs underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              لغو انتخاب
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Products Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-none shadow-xs overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-start text-xs border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-[#EFE9E0] text-[#5C5248] bg-[#FDFBF8]">
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center w-10">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={displayedItems.length > 0 && selectedIds.size === displayedItems.length}
                  onChange={toggleSelectAll}
                  className="cursor-pointer"
                  aria-label="انتخاب همه"
                />
              </th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-start">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.nameFa}</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-start">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.nameOriginal}</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-start">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.status}</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.isAvailable}</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.optionsCount}</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">تم</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-end">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EFE9E0]">
            {displayedItems.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-[#5C5248]">
                  هیچ محصولی با معیارهای جستجو یافت نشد.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              displayedItems.map((prod) => {
                const isSelected = selectedIds.has(prod.id);
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={prod.id}
                    className={`transition-colors ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-amber-50/60' : 'hover:bg-[#FFFBEB]/40'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isSelected}
                        onChange={() => toggleSelectOne(prod.id)}
                        className="cursor-pointer"
                        aria-label={`انتخاب ${prod.nameFa}`}
                      />
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-[#332115]">
                      <Link href={`/admin/products/${prod.id}`} className="hover:text-[#D97706]">
                        {prod.nameFa}
                      </Link>
                      {prod.isFeatured && (
                        <span className="ms-1.5 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#C86A00] font-bold">
                          ویژه
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#5C5248] font-mono text-[11px]" dir="ltr">
                      {prod.nameOriginal || prod.slug}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {/* [ADM-UI-02] AdminBadge */}
                      <AdminBadge status={prod.status} />
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleAvailability(prod)}
                        className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold border rounded-none transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          prod.isAvailable
                            ? 'bg-[#DCFCE7] text-[#15803D] border-[#BBF7D0]'
                            : 'bg-[#FEE2E2] text-[#B91C1C] border-[#FECACA]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {prod.isAvailable ? 'موجود' : 'ناموجود'}
                      </button>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center font-bold text-[#332115]">
                      {prod.optionCount || 0}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] bg-[#EFE9E0] text-[#5C5248] rounded-none">
                        {prod.cardTheme}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-end space-x-reverse space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <Link
                        href={`/admin/preview/products/${prod.id}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#5C5248] hover:bg-[#EFE9E0] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-none"
                      >
                        پیش‌نمایش
                      </Link>

                      <Link
                        href={`/admin/products/${prod.id}`}
                        className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#FDE68A] rounded-none"
                      >
                        ویرایش
                      </Link>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() => handleDuplicate(prod)}
                        className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#5C5248] hover:bg-[#EFE9E0] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        کپی
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isPending}
                        onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: true, prod })}
                        className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#9E3556] hover:bg-[#FEF2F2] border border-[#FECACA] rounded-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        حذف
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Load More Button */}
      {hasMore && (
        <div className="flex justify-center pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 20)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#FFFBEB] hover:bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-none transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>نمایش بیشتر (نمایش {displayedItems.length} از {filtered.length})</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* [ADM-UI-01] Universal ConfirmModal */}
      <ConfirmModal
        isOpen={confirmDelete.isOpen}
        title={confirmDelete.isBulk ? 'حذف گروهی محصولات' : 'حذف محصول'}
        itemName={confirmDelete.prod?.nameFa || (confirmDelete.isBulk ? `${selectedIds.size} محصول انتخاب‌شده` : undefined)}
        message={
          confirmDelete.isBulk
            ? `آیا از حذف کامل ${selectedIds.size} محصول انتخاب‌شده اطمینان دارید؟ این عملیات غیرقابل بازگشت است.`
            : 'آیا از حذف کامل این محصول اطمینان دارید؟ تمام مشخصات و گزینه‌های وزنی آن حذف خواهند شد.'
        }
        confirmLabel="بله، حذف کن"
        cancelLabel="انصراف"
        isLoading={isPending}
        onConfirm={confirmDeleteAction}
        onCancel={() => setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false })}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { requireAdmin } from '@/server/auth/require-admin';
import { RecipeService } from '@/server/services/recipe-service';
import { CategoryService } from '@/server/services/category-service';
import { RecipeForm } from '@/components/admin/recipe-form';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function EditRecipePage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  await requireAdmin({ allowRedirect: true });
  const { id } = await params;

  const [recipe, categories] = await Promise.all([
    RecipeService.getRecipeById(id),
    CategoryService.listCategories('RECIPE'),
  ]);

  if (!recipe) {
    notFound();
  }

  return (
    <RecipeForm
      initialData={recipe}
      categories={categories}
      isEdit={true}
    />
  );
}

'use client';

/**
 * Recipes List Component (Phase 4, Task 3 & Overhaul Enhancements)
 *
 * Implements:
 * - [ADM-UI-01] Zero window.confirm(); Custom ConfirmModal + useToast() integration.
 * - [ADM-UI-02] Unified AdminBadge status matrix.
 */

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';
import { duplicateRecipeAction, deleteRecipeAction, updateRecipeAction } from '@/server/actions/recipe-actions';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';
import { ConfirmModal } from '@/components/admin/confirm-modal';
import { AdminBadge } from '@/components/admin/admin-badge';
import { Plus, CheckCircle2, Archive, Trash2, Download } from 'lucide-react';
import { exportToCsv } from '@/lib/csv-export';

export interface RecipeListItem {
  id: string;
  nameFa: string;
  nameOriginal?: string | null;
  slug: string;
  country?: string | null;
  servingTypes: string[];
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'ARCHIVED';
  isFeatured: boolean;
  cardTheme: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  ingredients?: any[];
  steps?: any[];
  categoryIds?: string[];
  categories?: any[];
  mainImage?: any;
}

export interface RecipesListProps {
  initialRecipes: RecipeListItem[];
  categories: Array<{ id: string; name: string; slug: string }>;
  totalCount: number;
}

export function RecipesList({ initialRecipes, categories, totalCount }: RecipesListProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<RecipeListItem[]>(initialRecipes);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('');
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  // Bulk Selection
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Confirm Modal state
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<{ isOpen: boolean; recipe?: RecipeListItem; isBulk?: boolean }>({
    isOpen: false,
  });

  const filtered = recipes.filter((r) => {
    if (statusFilter && r.status !== statusFilter) return false;
    if (categoryFilter && !r.categoryIds?.includes(`cat_${categoryFilter}`) && !r.categories?.some((c: any) => c.slug === categoryFilter)) return false;
    if (search) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      const match =
        (r.nameFa || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (r.nameOriginal || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (r.slug || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (r.country || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
      if (!match) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  const displayedItems = filtered.slice(0, visibleCount);
  const hasMore = filtered.length > visibleCount;

  // Toggle selection
  const handleToggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.size === displayedItems.length) {
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(new Set(displayedItems.map((r) => r.id)));
    }
  };

  // Bulk Status Update (Archive / Publish)
  const handleBulkStatusChange = (newStatus: 'ARCHIVED' | 'PUBLISHED') => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedIds);
    if (ids.length === 0) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      let updatedCount = 0;
      for (const id of ids) {
        const res = await updateRecipeAction({ id, input: { status: newStatus } });
        if (res.success) updatedCount++;
      }
      setRecipes((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) => (selectedIds.has(r.id) ? { ...r, status: newStatus } : r))
      );
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      toast.success(`${updatedCount} دستور به وضعیت «${newStatus === 'ARCHIVED' ? 'بایگانی‌شده' : 'منتشرشده'}» تغییر یافت.`);
    });
  };

  const handleDuplicate = (recipe: RecipeListItem) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await duplicateRecipeAction(recipe.id);
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.duplicatedSuccess);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در کپی دستور');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (confirmDelete.isBulk) {
      const idsToDelete = Array.from(selectedIds);
      startTransition(async () => {
        let deletedCount = 0;
        for (const id of idsToDelete) {
          const res = await deleteRecipeAction(id);
          if (res.success) deletedCount++;
        }
        setRecipes((prev) => prev.filter((r) => !selectedIds.has(r.id)));
        setSelectedIds(new Set());
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        toast.success(`${deletedCount} دستور با موفقیت حذف گردید.`);
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!confirmDelete.recipe) return;
    const recipe = confirmDelete.recipe;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteRecipeAction(recipe.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setRecipes((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== recipe.id));
        setConfirmDelete({ isOpen: false });
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.deletedSuccess);
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || 'خطا در حذف دستور');
      }
    });
  };

  // CSV Export
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = ['شناسه', 'نام فارسی', 'نام لاتین', 'نامک', 'خاستگاه', 'نحوه سرو', 'وضعیت'];
    const rows = filtered.map((r) => [
      r.id,
      r.nameFa,
      r.nameOriginal || '',
      r.slug,
      r.country || '',
      r.servingTypes?.join(', ') || '',
      r.status,
    ]);
    exportToCsv('recipes_export', headers, rows);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#332115]">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.title}</h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-1">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white hover:bg-stone-50 text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs rounded-none border border-[#EFE9E0] shadow-2xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-[#C86A00]" />
            <span>خروجی اکسل (CSV)</span>
          </button>

          <Link
            href="/admin/recipes/new"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-black text-xs rounded-none shadow-xs transition-colors"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.newRecipe}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-4 rounded-none shadow-xs grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.searchPlaceholder}
            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706] rounded-none"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white rounded-none"
          >
            <option value="">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.statusFilter}</option>
            <option value="DRAFT">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.draft}</option>
            <option value="PUBLISHED">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.published}</option>
            <option value="ARCHIVED">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.archived}</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div>
          <select
            value={categoryFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white rounded-none"
          >
            <option value="">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.categoryFilter}</option>
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.slug}>
                {c.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Bulk Actions Bar (ADM-WORKFLOW-03) */}
      {selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="sticky top-20 z-20 bg-[#332115] text-white p-3.5 rounded-none shadow-xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 animate-in slide-in-from-top-2">

              <span>حذف گروهی</span>
            </button>

              onClick={() => setSelectedIds(new Set())}

            >
              لغو انتخاب

                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  aria-label="انتخاب همه"
                  checked={displayedItems.length > 0 && selectedIds.size === displayedItems.length}
                  onChange={handleSelectAll}
                  className="rounded-none border-stone-300 text-[#C86A00] focus:ring-[#C86A00] cursor-pointer"
                />
              </th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-start">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.nameFa}</th>

  CHANNEL_TYPES_META,
  ChannelType,
  validateChannel,
} from '@/lib/contact-channels';

  Search,
  ShoppingCart,

  initialSettings: SiteSettingsData;

  initialSettings,
  initialChannels,

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SiteSettingsData>(initialSettings);
  const [channels, setChannels] = useState<ContactChannelData[]>(initialChannels);

    label: '',

    showInContactBar: true,
    showInFooter: true,
    showInContactPage: true,
    acceptsOrders: false,
  });

  const [channelError, setChannelError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    setToast({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
  };

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateSiteSettingsAction(settings);
      if (res.success) {
        showToast('success', 'تنظیمات با موفقیت ذخیره شد.');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        showToast('error', res.error || 'خطا در ذخیره تنظیمات.');
      }
    });

    setEditingChannel(null);
    setChannelForm({
      type: 'PHONE',

      isActive: true,

      showInContactBar: true,
      showInFooter: true,
      showInContactPage: true,
      acceptsOrders: false,
    });
    setChannelError(null);
    setIsChannelModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditChannelModal = (ch: ContactChannelData) => {
    setEditingChannel(ch);
    setChannelForm({
      type: ch.type,
      value: ch.value,
      label: ch.label || '',
      isActive: ch.isActive ?? true,
      sortOrder: ch.sortOrder ?? 0,
      showInContactBar: ch.showInContactBar ?? true,
      showInFooter: ch.showInFooter ?? true,
      showInContactPage: ch.showInContactPage ?? true,
      acceptsOrders: ch.acceptsOrders ?? false,
    });
    setChannelError(null);
    setIsChannelModalOpen(true);

        setConfirmDeleteChannel({ isOpen: false });

        showToast('error', res.error || 'خطا در حذف کانال.');

              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
              : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-800'
          }`}
        >
          {toast.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{toast.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header & Save Action */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#EFE9E0]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#2B2017]">تنظیمات سایت و ارتباطات</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-1">
            مدیریت مشخصات هویتی، آدرس‌ها، کانال‌های دریافت سفارش و درگاه سبد خرید
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleSaveSettings}
          disabled={isPending}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#D97706] text-white px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {isPending ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />}
          <span>ذخیره تنظیمات</span>
        </button>
      </div>

            activeTab === 'contact'
              ? 'border-[#F59E0B] text-[#D97706] bg-amber-50/50'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#5C5248] hover:text-[#2B2017]'

            activeTab === 'seo'
              ? 'border-[#F59E0B] text-[#D97706] bg-amber-50/50'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#5C5248] hover:text-[#2B2017]'
          }`}
        >
          <Search className="w-4 h-4" />

              ? 'border-[#F59E0B] text-[#D97706] bg-amber-50/50'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#5C5248] hover:text-[#2B2017]'

      {/* Tab 1: General */}
      {activeTab === 'general' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">

            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                نام وب‌سایت به انگلیسی
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                dir="ltr"

            </div>
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                شعار برند (Tagline)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={settings.tagline || ''}

                placeholder="طعم اصیل و طبیعی کوهستان"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                متن کپی‌رایت فوتر
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={settings.copyrightText || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, copyrightText: e.target.value })}

                placeholder="تمامی حقوق برای برند عسل باباخُرم محفوظ است. طراحی و توسعه ۱۴۰۵."

          </div>
        </div>

              نشانی فیزیکی و ساعات کاری

                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={settings.address || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, address: e.target.value })}

              </div>
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                  ساعات کاری و پاسخگویی
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={settings.workingHours || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, workingHours: e.target.value })}
