                  placeholder="همه‌روزه از ساعت ۹:۰۰ الی ۲۱:۰۰"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                  عرض جغرافیایی (Latitude)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.0001"
                  dir="ltr"
                  value={settings.latitude ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      latitude: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) : null,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-left focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                  placeholder="38.8711"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                  طول جغرافیایی (Longitude)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.0001"
                  dir="ltr"
                  value={settings.longitude ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      longitude: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) : null,
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-left focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                  placeholder="47.0354"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Contact Channels Manager */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-[#2B2017]">کانال‌های ارتباطی و شبکه‌های اجتماعی</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#5C5248] mt-0.5">
                  کانال‌های فعال در نوار بالای سایت، فوتر و صفحه تماس با ما نمایش داده می‌شوند.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={openNewChannelModal}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-amber-50 text-[#D97706] hover:bg-amber-100 border border-amber-200 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-colors"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>افزودن کانال جدید</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Channels Table */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right border-collapse text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs font-bold text-[#5C5248] bg-[#FDFBF8]">
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">نوع کانال</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">عنوان نمایشی</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">مقدار / شماره</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">محل نمایش</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">دریافت سفارش</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">وضعیت</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">عملیات</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EFE9E0]">
                  {channels.map((ch) => (
                    <tr key={ch.id} className="hover:bg-amber-50/20 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-[#2B2017]">
                        {CHANNEL_TYPES_META[ch.type]?.titleFa || ch.type}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#5C5248]">{ch.label || '—'}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#2B2017] font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">
                        {ch.value}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                        <div className="inline-flex gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                          {ch.showInContactBar && (
                            <span className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">نوار بالا</span>
                          )}
                          {ch.showInFooter && (
                            <span className="bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">فوتر</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                        {ch.acceptsOrders ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>فعال</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-stone-400 text-xs">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                        {ch.isActive ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold text-xs">فعال</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-stone-400 font-bold text-xs">غیرفعال</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => openEditChannelModal(ch)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-stone-600 hover:text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-50 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                            title="ویرایش"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => ch.id && handleDeleteChannel(ch.id)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                            title="حذف"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {channels.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-[#5C5248]">
                        هیچ کانال ارتباطی ثبت نشده است.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: SEO */}
      {activeTab === 'seo' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                عنوان پیش‌فرض سئو (SEO Title)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={settings.seoTitle || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, seoTitle: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                placeholder="عسل باباخُرم | طعم اصیل و طبیعی کوهستان"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                توضیحات پیش‌فرض متا (SEO Meta Description)
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                value={settings.seoDescription || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, seoDescription: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                placeholder="تولید و عرضه مستقیم انواع عسل طبیعی و ارگانیک از دامنه‌های ارسباران و قره‌داغ."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 4: Cart & Orders */}
      {activeTab === 'cart' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-amber-50/60 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#2B2017]">فعال‌سازی سبد خرید و ثبت سفارش آنلاین</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
                در صورت فعال بودن، آیکون سبد خرید در هدر و دکمه‌های افزودن به سبد در صفحات محصولات نمایش داده می‌شوند.
              </p>
            </div>
            <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={settings.cartEnabled}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, cartEnabled: e.target.checked })}
                className="sr-only peer"
              />
              <div className="w-11 h-6 bg-stone-300 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-stone-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-5 after:w-5 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-[#3F8F3B]"></div>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-2">
                پیام اطلاع‌رسانی سبد خرید (Cart Notice)
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={settings.cartNotice}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, cartNotice: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                placeholder="قیمت و هزینه‌ی ارسال پس از تأیید اعلام می‌شود."
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017]">
                  متن مقدمه سفارش ارسالی (Order Intro Text)
                </label>
                <span className="text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
                  {(settings.orderIntroText?.length || 0)} / ۲۰۰ نویسه
                </span>
              </div>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                maxLength={200}
                value={settings.orderIntroText || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, orderIntroText: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                placeholder="سلام، مایلم سفارش زیر را ثبت نمایم:"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017]">
                  متن پایانی سفارش ارسالی (Order Outro Text)
                </label>
                <span className="text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
                  {(settings.orderOutroText?.length || 0)} / ۲۰۰ نویسه
                </span>
              </div>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                maxLength={200}
                value={settings.orderOutroText || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, orderOutroText: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                placeholder="لطفاً پیش‌فاکتور و اطلاعات پرداخت را برای من ارسال فرمایید."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Channel Create/Edit Modal */}
      {isChannelModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs">

            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-[#2B2017] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-3">

            {channelError && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2">

                <span>{channelError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-1.5">نوع پلتفرم / شبکه</label>

                  value={channelForm.type}

                    const newType = e.target.value as ChannelType;
                    setChannelForm({
                      ...channelForm,
                      type: newType,
                      acceptsOrders: newType === 'INSTAGRAM' ? false : channelForm.acceptsOrders,
                    });
                  }}
                  className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                >
                  {Object.values(CHANNEL_TYPES_META).map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.type} value={m.type}>
                      {m.titleFa}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-1.5">
                  مقدار / شماره یا شناسه کاربری <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  dir="ltr"
                  value={channelForm.value}
                  onChange={(e) => setChannelForm({ ...channelForm, value: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder={selectedMeta.placeholderFa}
                  className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-left font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                />
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#5C5248] mt-1 block">
                  مثال: <span dir="ltr">{selectedMeta.example}</span>
                </span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#2B2017] mb-1.5">عنوان نمایشی اختیاری</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={channelForm.label}
                  onChange={(e) => setChannelForm({ ...channelForm, label: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder={selectedMeta.defaultLabel}
                  className="w-full bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B]"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Order Channel Toggle (Addendum A2) */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50/50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={channelForm.acceptsOrders}
                    disabled={channelForm.type === 'INSTAGRAM'}
                    onChange={(e) => setChannelForm({ ...channelForm, acceptsOrders: e.target.checked })}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-[#3F8F3B] focus:ring-0 disabled:opacity-50"
                  />
                  <span
                    className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                      channelForm.type === 'INSTAGRAM' ? 'text-stone-400' : 'text-[#2B2017]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    پذیرش و ارسال سفارشات سبد خرید در این کانال
                  </span>
                </label>
                {selectedMeta.orderChannelHintFa && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[#5C5248] flex items-start gap-1">
                    <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{selectedMeta.orderChannelHintFa}</span>
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Visibility Options */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-[#2B2017]">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-lg cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={channelForm.showInContactBar}
                    onChange={(e) => setChannelForm({ ...channelForm, showInContactBar: e.target.checked })}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-[#F59E0B]"
                  />
                  <span>نوار بالای سایت</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-lg cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={channelForm.showInFooter}

/**
 * Admin Users Manager Client Component (Phase 2, Task 8)
 * Manages admin accounts, status activation/deactivation, password resets,
 * and enforces self-deactivation and last-admin safety protections.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  createAdminUserAction,
  toggleUserStatusAction,
  changeUserPasswordAction,
} from '@/server/actions/user-actions';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';
import {
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  UserPlus,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Loader2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface UserItem {
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: string | Date;
}

interface AdminUsersManagerProps {
  initialUsers: any[];
  currentUserId: string;
}

export function AdminUsersManager({
  initialUsers,
  currentUserId,
}: AdminUsersManagerProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserItem[]>(initialUsers);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

  // Modals
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPasswordModalOpen, setIsPasswordModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedUserForPassword, setSelectedUserForPassword] = useState<UserItem | null>(null);

  // Form states
  const [createForm, setCreateForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', password: '' });
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [modalError, setModalError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showToast = (type: 'success' | 'error', message: string) => {
    setToast({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleToggleStatus = (user: UserItem) => {
    if (user.id === currentUserId && user.isActive) {
      showToast('error', uiStringsFa.adminUsers.cannotDeactivateSelf);
      return;
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await toggleUserStatusAction({
        userId: user.id,
        isActive: !user.isActive,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setUsers(
          users.map((u) => (u.id === user.id ? { ...u, isActive: !user.isActive } : u))
        );
        showToast(
          'success',
          !user.isActive
            ? 'کاربر با موفقیت فعال شد.'
            : 'کاربر با موفقیت غیرفعال شد و نشست‌های آن منقضی گردید.'
        );
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        showToast('error', res.error || 'خطا در تغییر وضعیت کاربر.');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleCreateUser = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setModalError(null);

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await createAdminUserAction({
        name: createForm.name,
        email: createForm.email,
        temporaryPassword: createForm.password,
      });

      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setUsers([...users, { ...(res.data as any), createdAt: new Date() }]);
        setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
        setCreateForm({ name: '', email: '', password: '' });
        showToast('success', uiStringsFa.adminUsers.userCreatedSuccess);
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setModalError((res as any).error || 'خطا در ایجاد مدیر جدید.');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleChangePassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedUserForPassword) return;
    setModalError(null);

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await changeUserPasswordAction({
        userId: selectedUserForPassword.id,
        newPassword,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setIsPasswordModalOpen(false);
        setNewPassword('');
        setSelectedUserForPassword(null);
        showToast('success', 'رمز عبور با موفقیت تغییر یافت و نشست‌های فعال کاربر لغو شدند.');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        setModalError(res.error || 'خطا در تغییر رمز عبور.');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div
          className={`fixed top-4 left-4 right-4 md:right-auto md:left-6 md:w-96 z-50 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg border flex items-center gap-3 transition-all ${
            toast.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
              : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-800'
          }`}
        >
          {toast.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{toast.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#EFE9E0]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#2B2017] flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-[#F59E0B]" />
            <span>مدیریت کاربران و مدیران سامانه</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-1">
            تعریف مدیران جدید، مدیریت وضعیت فعال/غیرفعال و بازنشانی دسترسی‌ها با رعایت استانداردهای امنیتی
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setModalError(null);
            setIsCreateModalOpen(true);
          }}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#F59E0B] hover:bg-[#D97706] text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-xs transition-colors"
        >
          <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>افزودن مدیر جدید</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Users Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-right border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-[#FDFBF8] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] text-[#5C5248] font-bold">
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">نام کاربر</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4">نشانی ایمیل</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">نقش</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">وضعیت دسترسی</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">تاریخ ایجاد</th>
                <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">عملیات</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#EFE9E0]">

                        {u.role}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                      {u.isActive ? (

'use client';

/**
 * Admin Login Page (Phase 2, Task 7)
 * Implements:
 * - RTL layout with Vazirmatn typography
 * - Client-side form submission to adminLoginAction
 * - Generic error messaging (no user enumeration)
 * - Reliable window.location.href redirect upon authentication
 * - Dotted arrow icon matching honey.com design
 */

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';
import { adminLoginAction } from '@/server/actions/auth-actions';
import { DottedArrowIcon } from '@/components/ui/dotted-arrow-icon';

export default function AdminLoginPage() {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [isSuccess, setIsSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await adminLoginAction({ email, password });
        if (result.success) {
          setIsSuccess(true);
          // Hard document navigation ensures session cookies are transmitted directly to Next.js RSC
          window.location.href = '/admin';
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(result.error || uiStringsFa.adminAuth.invalidCredentials);
        }
      } catch {
        setErrorMessage('خطایی در برقراری ارتباط با سرور رخ داد. لطفاً مجدداً تلاش نمایید.');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#FDFBF8]">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-8 shadow-md rounded-none">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex w-14 h-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#D97706] mb-4 shadow-xs">
            <svg className="w-7 h-7" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#332115]">{uiStringsFa.adminAuth.loginTitle}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C5248] mt-2 font-medium">{uiStringsFa.adminAuth.loginSubtitle}</p>
        </div>

        {/* Error Alert */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-[#FEF2F2] border-s-4 border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556] text-sm leading-relaxed" role="alert">
            {errorMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Success Alert */}
        {isSuccess && (
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-[#ECFDF5] border-s-4 border-[#059669] text-[#065F46] text-sm leading-relaxed font-bold" role="status">
            ورود موفقیت‌آمیز بود. در حال انتقال به پیشخوان مدیریت...
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1.5">
              {uiStringsFa.adminAuth.emailLabel}
            </label>
            <input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              required
              autoComplete="email"
              dir="ltr"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="admin@honey.ir"
              disabled={isPending || isSuccess}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#FFFBEB]/40 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-[#2B2017] text-start focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706] transition-colors rounded-none disabled:opacity-50"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1.5">
              {uiStringsFa.adminAuth.passwordLabel}
            </label>
            <input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              required
              autoComplete="current-password"
              dir="ltr"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isPending || isSuccess}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#FFFBEB]/40 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-[#2B2017] text-start focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706] transition-colors rounded-none disabled:opacity-50"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPending || isSuccess}
            className="group w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-6 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-xs rounded-none"
          >
            <span>{isSuccess ? 'در حال انتقال...' : isPending ? 'در حال بررسی...' : uiStringsFa.adminAuth.loginButton}</span>
            <DottedArrowIcon direction="left" className="w-4 h-4 transition-transform group-hover:-translate-x-1" />
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-8 text-center text-xs text-[#5C5248]/80 border-t border-[#EFE9E0] pt-4 font-medium">
          {uiStringsFa.brand.name} • پنل مدیریت متمرکز
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: D:\Project\honey\honey-website\honey-website\FINAL 2\honey-project-phase10-fixed-1\src\app\uploads\[...path]\route.ts ===
/**
 * Public Static Uploads Serving Handler (Phase 3, Task 3)
 * Serves optimized WebP media assets in development via Next.js
 * with immutable long-cache headers.
 *
 * In production (Phase 12), Nginx/Caddy proxies /uploads directly from disk:
 * location /uploads/ {
 *     alias /var/www/honey/uploads/;
 *     expires 1y;
 *     add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
 *     add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff";
 * }
 */

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { LocalDiskStorage } from '@/server/storage/storage-provider';

export async function GET(
  _request: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ path: string[] }> }
) {
  try {
    const { path: pathSegments } = await context.params;
    const requestedFilename = pathSegments.join('/');

    // Prevent directory traversal
    const storage = new LocalDiskStorage();
    let filePath: string;
    try {
      filePath = storage.resolveSafePath(requestedFilename);
    } catch {
      return new NextResponse('Forbidden', { status: 403 });
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      return new NextResponse('File Not Found', { status: 404 });
    }

    const fileBuffer = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);

    // Determine MIME type
    let contentType = 'image/webp';
    if (requestedFilename.endsWith('.jpg') || requestedFilename.endsWith('.jpeg')) {
      contentType = 'image/jpeg';
    } else if (requestedFilename.endsWith('.png')) {
      contentType = 'image/png';
    }

    return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(fileBuffer), {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': contentType,
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable',
        'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
      },
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new NextResponse('Internal Server Error', { status: 500 });
  }
}

import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';
import { db } from '@/server/db/client';

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://babakhorram.com';

  let products: any[] = [];
  let recipes: any[] = [];

  try {
    const [prods, recs] = await Promise.all([
      db.product.findMany({ where: { status: 'PUBLISHED' } }),
      db.recipe.findMany({ where: { status: 'PUBLISHED' } }),
    ]);
    products = prods || [];
    recipes = recs || [];
  } catch {
    products = [];
    recipes = [];
  }

  const staticRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 1.0,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/products`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.9,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/recipes`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'daily',
      priority: 0.9,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/contact`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.6,
    },
    {
      url: `${siteUrl}/feedback`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly',
      priority: 0.5,
    },
  ];

  const productRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = products.map((p: any) => ({
    url: `${siteUrl}/products/${p.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(p.updatedAt || p.createdAt || new Date()),
    changeFrequency: 'weekly',
    priority: 0.8,
  }));

  const recipeRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = recipes.map((r: any) => ({
    url: `${siteUrl}/recipes/${r.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(r.updatedAt || r.createdAt || new Date()),
    changeFrequency: 'weekly',
    priority: 0.8,
  }));

  return [...staticRoutes, ...productRoutes, ...recipeRoutes];
}

/**
 * ControlledLinkPicker Component (Brief Section 7)
 * Safe link picker supporting internal routes, product/recipe/category targets, and validated paths.
 */

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { ControlledLink, LinkType } from '@/server/validation/homepage-schemas';
import { Link as LinkIcon, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface ControlledLinkPickerProps {
  value?: ControlledLink | null;
  onChange: (value: ControlledLink) => void;
  label?: string;
}

const LINK_TYPE_LABELS: Record<LinkType, string> = {
  NONE: 'بدون پیوند (غیرفعال)',
  HOME: 'صفحه اصلی',
  PRODUCTS_PAGE: 'کاتالوگ همه محصولات',
  RECIPES_PAGE: 'کاتالوگ همه دستورها',
  CONTACT_PAGE: 'صفحه تماس با ما',
  PRODUCT: 'محصول خاص (اسلاگ یا شناسه)',
  RECIPE: 'دستور پخت خاص (اسلاگ یا شناسه)',
  CATEGORY: 'دسته‌بندی خاص',
  INTERNAL_PATH: 'مسیر داخلی سفارشی (مانند /feedback)',
};

export function ControlledLinkPicker({
  value = { type: 'NONE', label: 'مشاهده بیشتر' },
  onChange,
  label = 'دکمه اقدام (Call to Action / Link)',
}: ControlledLinkPickerProps) {
  const current = value || { type: 'NONE', label: 'مشاهده بیشتر' };

  const handleTypeChange = (type: LinkType) => {
    onChange({
      ...current,
      type,
      targetId: type === 'NONE' || type === 'HOME' || type === 'PRODUCTS_PAGE' || type === 'RECIPES_PAGE' || type === 'CONTACT_PAGE' ? undefined : current.targetId,
      path: type === 'INTERNAL_PATH' ? current.path || '/' : undefined,
    });
  };

  const isInternalPath = current.type === 'INTERNAL_PATH';
  const hasTarget = current.type === 'PRODUCT' || current.type === 'RECIPE' || current.type === 'CATEGORY';

  const pathError =
    isInternalPath && current.path
      ? !current.path.startsWith('/') || current.path.startsWith('//') || current.path.toLowerCase().includes('javascript:')
        ? 'مسیر باید با / آغاز شود و فاقد کاراکترهای نامعتبر باشد.'
        : null
      : null;

  return (
    <div className="p-4 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-black text-[#2B2017] border-b border-stone-200 pb-2">
        <LinkIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D97706]" />
        <span>{label}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {/* Link Type Selector */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 mb-1">
            نوع پیوند
          </label>
          <select
            value={current.type}
            onChange={(e) => handleTypeChange(e.target.value as LinkType)}
            className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F59E0B] focus:outline-none"
          >
            {Object.entries(LINK_TYPE_LABELS).map(([k, text]) => (
              <option key={k} value={k}>
                {text}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Button Text Label */}
        {current.type !== 'NONE' && (
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 mb-1">
              عنوان متنی دکمه
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={current.label || ''}
              onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...current, label: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="مثلاً: مشاهده بیشتر، شناخت بیشتر عسل..."
              className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F59E0B] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Target Identifier Input (for PRODUCT, RECIPE, CATEGORY) */}
      {hasTarget && (
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 mb-1">
            اسلاگ یا شناسه انگلیسی مقصد
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={current.targetId || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...current, targetId: e.target.value.trim() })}
            placeholder="مثلاً: mountain-astragalus-honey یا blueberry-citrus-honey-smoothie"
            className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F59E0B] focus:outline-none font-mono"
            dir="ltr"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Internal Path Input */}
      {isInternalPath && (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 mb-1">
            مسیر داخلی (حتماً با / شروع شود)
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={current.path || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...current, path: e.target.value.trim() })}
            placeholder="/feedback یا /about"
            className={`w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold bg-white border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:outline-none font-mono ${
              pathError ? 'border-red-500 focus:ring-red-400' : 'border-stone-300 focus:ring-[#F59E0B]'
            }`}
            dir="ltr"
          />
          {pathError && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-red-600 font-bold mt-1">
              <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>{pathError}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * SectionForm Component (Brief Section 7)
 * Comprehensive per-type content form for creating and editing homepage sections.
 * Guarantees zero fields for CSS, custom fonts, or manual styling.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ControlledLinkPicker } from './controlled-link-picker';
import { ControlledLink, SectionImage } from '@/server/validation/homepage-schemas';
import { createHomepageSectionAction, updateHomepageSectionAction } from '@/server/actions/homepage-actions';
import { SectionType, SectionStatus, SectionBackground } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  Save,
  AlertTriangle,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  ArrowRight,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';

interface SectionFormProps {
  initialData?: {
    id?: string;
    internalName: string;
    type: SectionType;
    template: string;
    status: SectionStatus;
    background: SectionBackground;
    sortOrder?: number;
    content: Record<string, any>;
  };
  isNew?: boolean;
}

export function SectionForm({ initialData, isNew = false }: SectionFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [internalName, setInternalName] = useState(initialData?.internalName || '');
  const [type] = useState<SectionType>(initialData?.type || 'HERO');
  const [template] = useState<string>(initialData?.template || 'hero-default');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SectionStatus>(initialData?.status || 'DRAFT');
  const [background, setBackground] = useState<SectionBackground>(initialData?.background || 'NONE');
  const [content, setContent] = useState<Record<string, any>>(initialData?.content || {});

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const updateContentField = (key: string, val: any) => {
    setContent((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: val,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    const payload = {
      internalName,
      type,
      template,
      status,
      background,
      content,
    };

    let res;
    if (isNew) {
      res = await createHomepageSectionAction(payload as any);
    } else if (initialData?.id) {
      res = await updateHomepageSectionAction(initialData.id, payload as any);
    }

    setIsSubmitting(false);

    if (res?.success) {
      setSuccessMessage('اطلاعات سکشن با موفقیت ذخیره شد.');
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/admin/homepage');
      }, 700);
    } else {
      setErrorMessage(res?.error || 'خطا در ثبت اطلاعات.');
    }
  };

  // Helper for Hero & Gallery image management
  const imagesList: SectionImage[] = Array.isArray(content.images) ? content.images : [];

  const handleAddImage = () => {
    const next = [...imagesList, { url: '/images/hero-1.jpg', alt: '' }];
    updateContentField('images', next);
  };

  const handleUpdateImage = (index: number, field: 'url' | 'alt', val: string) => {
    const next = [...imagesList];
    next[index] = { ...next[index], [field]: val };
    updateContentField('images', next);
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = (index: number) => {
    const next = imagesList.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    updateContentField('images', next);
  };

  // Helper for Content Grid items
  const gridItems = Array.isArray(content.items) ? content.items : [];

  const handleAddGridItem = () => {
    const next = [
      ...gridItems,
      {
        id: Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9),
        title: 'عنوان جدید',
        description: '',
        image: { url: '/images/recipe-1.jpg', alt: '' },
      },
    ];
    updateContentField('items', next);
  };

  const handleUpdateGridItem = (index: number, field: string, val: any) => {
    const next = [...gridItems];
    next[index] = { ...next[index], [field]: val };
    updateContentField('items', next);
  };

  const handleRemoveGridItem = (index: number) => {
    const next = gridItems.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    updateContentField('items', next);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8 max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-16 text-right">
      {/* Top Banner Warning for Active Sections */}
      {status === 'ACTIVE' && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border-2 border-amber-300 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3 shadow-xs">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-amber-900 leading-relaxed font-bold">
            <span className="font-black text-amber-950">هشدار اعمال فوری: </span>
            این سکشن در وضعیت <span className="underline decoration-amber-600">فعال (ACTIVE)</span> قرار دارد. هر تغییری پس از ذخیره بلافاصله در صفحه اصلی سایت عمومی نمایش داده خواهد شد.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. General Section Configuration */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm space-y-6">
        <h3 className="font-black text-base text-[#2B2017] border-b border-stone-100 pb-3">
          تنظیمات عمومی سکشن
        </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
          {/* Internal Name */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-700">
              نام داخلی سکشن (جهت شناسایی در پنل مدیریت) *
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={internalName}
              onChange={(e) => setInternalName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="مثلاً: هیرو اصلی پاییزه، بنر زنبورداری..."
              className="w-full h-11 px-3.5 text-sm font-bold bg-stone-50 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F59E0B] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Status */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-700">
              وضعیت انتشار *
            </label>

              value={status}

/**
 * TemplatePicker Component (Brief Section 7)
 * Visual preview cards for section templates with thumbnail, description, and selection state.
 */

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { TEMPLATE_REGISTRY, TemplateDefinition } from '@/server/services/homepage-template-service';
import { SectionType } from '@prisma/client';
import { Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface TemplatePickerProps {
  selectedTemplateId: string;
  onSelectTemplate: (template: TemplateDefinition) => void;
  filterSectionType?: SectionType | null;
}

export function TemplatePicker({
  selectedTemplateId,
  onSelectTemplate,
  filterSectionType,
}: TemplatePickerProps) {
  const templates = Object.values(TEMPLATE_REGISTRY).filter((t) =>
    filterSectionType ? t.sectionType === filterSectionType : true
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
      {templates.map((tpl) => {
        const isSelected = selectedTemplateId === tpl.id;
        return (
          <div
            key={tpl.id}
            onClick={() => onSelectTemplate(tpl)}
            className={`group relative rounded-xl border-2 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between bg-white text-right ${
              isSelected
                ? 'border-[#F59E0B] ring-4 ring-[#FBBF24]/20 shadow-lg'
                : 'border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-400 hover:shadow-md'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Visual Thumbnail / Mini Render */}
            <div className="relative w-full h-36 bg-stone-100 overflow-hidden border-b border-stone-100">
              <img
                src={tpl.thumbnail}
                alt={tpl.name}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
              />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
              <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 right-3 text-white text-xs font-black drop-shadow-md">
                {tpl.sectionType}
              </div>

              {isSelected && (
                <div className="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#F59E0B] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                  <Check className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[3]" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Template Info */}
            <div className="p-4 space-y-1.5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-black text-sm text-[#2B2017] group-hover:text-[#D97706] transition-colors">
                  {tpl.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 font-bold leading-relaxed mt-1">
                  {tpl.description}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-stone-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-stone-400">
                <span>پس‌زمینه پیش‌فرض: {tpl.defaultBackground === 'WOOD' ? 'چوبی' : 'ساده'}</span>
                <span className="text-amber-600 font-black">انتخاب</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * TemplateSwitchModal Component (Brief Section 7)
 * Allows admins to switch templates with field mapping preview and preserved bucket indicator.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TEMPLATE_REGISTRY, analyzeTemplateSwitch, TemplateDefinition } from '@/server/services/homepage-template-service';
import { switchHomepageSectionTemplateAction } from '@/server/actions/homepage-actions';
import { X, ArrowRightLeft, AlertTriangle, Check, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { TemplatePicker } from './template-picker';

interface TemplateSwitchModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  sectionId: string;
  currentTemplateId: string;
  currentContent: Record<string, any>;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function TemplateSwitchModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  sectionId,
  currentTemplateId,
  currentContent,
  onSuccess,
}: TemplateSwitchModalProps) {
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState<TemplateDefinition | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const analysis = selectedTemplate
    ? analyzeTemplateSwitch(currentTemplateId, selectedTemplate.id, currentContent)
    : null;

  const handleConfirmSwitch = async () => {
    if (!selectedTemplate) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const res = await switchHomepageSectionTemplateAction(sectionId, selectedTemplate.id);
    setIsSubmitting(false);

    if (res.success) {
      onSuccess();
      onClose();
    } else {
      setError(res.error || 'خطا در تغییر قالب سکشن');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity" onClick={onClose} />

      {/* Modal Dialog */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-right border border-stone-200 z-10 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-stone-200 flex items-center justify-between bg-stone-50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ArrowRightLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-[#D97706]" />
            <span className="font-black text-lg text-[#2B2017]">تغییر قالب سکشن</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-200/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6">
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-stone-700 mb-3">
              قالب مقصد مورد نظر خود را انتخاب کنید:
            </h4>
            <TemplatePicker
              selectedTemplateId={selectedTemplate?.id || currentTemplateId}
              onSelectTemplate={(tpl) => setSelectedTemplate(tpl)}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Field Mapping & Preserved Bucket Warning */}
          {selectedTemplate && selectedTemplate.id !== currentTemplateId && analysis && (
            <div className="p-5 bg-amber-50 border-2 border-amber-200 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-800 font-black text-sm">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>بررسی تطبیق داده‌ها (حفظ امن اطلاعات)</span>
              </div>

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Search,
  LayoutDashboard,
  Package,
  BookOpen,
  FolderTree,
  Sliders,
  MessageSquareHeart,
  Settings,
  Users,
  Shield,
  Plus,
  ExternalLink,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface CommandItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  href: string;
  icon: any;
}

const COMMAND_ITEMS: CommandItem[] = [
  { id: 'dashboard', title: 'داشبورد مدیریت', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin', icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { id: 'products', title: 'مدیریت محصولات عسل', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/products', icon: Package },
  { id: 'new-product', title: 'افزودن محصول جدید', category: 'اقدامات سریع', href: '/admin/products/new', icon: Plus },
  { id: 'recipes', title: 'مدیریت دستورهای مصرف و دسرها', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/recipes', icon: BookOpen },
  { id: 'new-recipe', title: 'افزودن دستور جدید', category: 'اقدامات سریع', href: '/admin/recipes/new', icon: Plus },
  { id: 'categories', title: 'مدیریت دسته‌بندی‌ها', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/categories', icon: FolderTree },
  { id: 'homepage', title: 'مدیریت سکشن‌های صفحه اصلی (CMS)', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/homepage', icon: Sliders },
  { id: 'feedbacks', title: 'مشاهده پیام‌ها و بازخوردها', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/feedbacks', icon: MessageSquareHeart },
  { id: 'settings', title: 'تنظیمات سایت و شبکه‌های اجتماعی', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/settings', icon: Settings },
  { id: 'users', title: 'مدیریت کاربران و دسترسی‌ها', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/users', icon: Users },
  { id: 'audit', title: 'گزارش وقایع و حسابرسی (Audit Log)', category: 'بخش‌ها', href: '/admin/audit-log', icon: Shield },
  { id: 'public-site', title: 'مشاهده وب‌سایت عمومی باباخُرم', category: 'لینک‌ها', href: '/', icon: ExternalLink },
];

export function CommandPalette() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0);
  const router = useRouter();

  // Listen to Cmd+K / Ctrl+K
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsOpen((prev) => !prev);
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const filtered = COMMAND_ITEMS.filter((item) =>
    item.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
    item.category.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleSelect = (href: string) => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    setQuery('');
    router.push(href);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIndex(0);
  }, [query]);

  const handleListKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % Math.max(1, filtered.length));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + filtered.length) % Math.max(1, filtered.length));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (filtered[selectedIndex]) {
        handleSelect(filtered[selectedIndex].href);
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-20 p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-150"
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-white border-2 border-stone-300 rounded-none shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-right flex flex-col max-h-[75vh]">
        {/* Search Input Bar */}
        <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-stone-200 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
          <input
            type="text"
            autoFocus
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={handleListKeyDown}
            placeholder="جستجو در بخش‌ها، محصولات، دستورها... (Ctrl + K)"
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-stone-800 placeholder-stone-400 focus:outline-none"
            dir="rtl"
          />
          {query && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setQuery('')}
              className="p-1 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-stone-400 border border-stone-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-none">
            ESC
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Results List */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs sm:text-sm text-stone-500 font-bold">
              موردی مطابق با جستجوی شما یافت نشد.
            </div>
          ) : (
            filtered.map((item, idx) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;
              const isSelected = idx === selectedIndex;
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(item.href)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(idx)}
                  className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-none text-right flex items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#92400E] font-black'
                      : 'hover:bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 font-bold'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <Icon className={`w-4 h-4 ${isSelected ? 'text-[#D97706]' : 'text-stone-400'}`} />
                    <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm">{item.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-400 font-medium">
                    {item.category}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer info */}
        <div className="p-2.5 bg-stone-50 border-t border-stone-200 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-stone-500 font-medium">
          <span>برای پیمایش از کلیدهای جهت‌نما و برای انتخاب از Enter استفاده کنید</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-stone-400">Ctrl + K</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { Menu, X, ExternalLink, LogOut, User as UserIcon, Search, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { AdminSidebar } from './sidebar';

interface AdminHeaderProps {
  user: {
    name: string | null;
    email: string;
    role: string;
  };
}

const BREADCRUMB_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: 'داشبورد',
  products: 'محصولات عسل',
  recipes: 'دستورهای مصرف',
  categories: 'دسته‌بندی‌ها',
  homepage: 'سکشن‌های صفحه اصلی',
  feedbacks: 'انتقادات و پیشنهادات',
  settings: 'تنظیمات و ارتباطات',
  users: 'مدیران سامانه',
  'audit-log': 'گزارش وقایع',
  new: 'جدید',
  edit: 'ویرایش',
};

export function AdminHeader({ user }: AdminHeaderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [isMobileOpen, setIsMobileOpen] = useState(false);

  // Generate dynamic breadcrumbs
  const pathSegments = pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const breadcrumbs = pathSegments.map((segment, index) => {
    const href = '/' + pathSegments.slice(0, index + 1).join('/');
    const title = BREADCRUMB_MAP[segment] || segment;
    return { href, title };
  });

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      // Invalidate cookie / session
      document.cookie = 'better-auth.session_token=; path=/; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT';
      router.push('/admin/login');
      router.refresh();
    } catch {}
  };

  const handleOpenSearch = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true }));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <header className="h-16 bg-white border-b border-[#EFE9E0] px-4 md:px-8 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-2xs">

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(true)}
            aria-label="باز کردن منوی موبایل"
            className="md:hidden p-2 text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Menu className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>

          {/* Dynamic Breadcrumbs */}
          <nav aria-label="مسیر صفحه" className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-stone-500">
            {breadcrumbs.map((crumb, idx) => {
              const isLast = idx === breadcrumbs.length - 1;
              return (
                <React.Fragment key={crumb.href}>
                  {idx > 0 && <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-300" />}
                  {isLast ? (
                    <span className="text-[#C86A00] font-black">{crumb.title}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <Link href={crumb.href} className="hover:text-stone-800 transition-colors">
                      {crumb.title}
                    </Link>
                  )}
                </React.Fragment>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
        </div>

        {/* Left Section in RTL: Search Command Button + User Badge & Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          {/* Quick Spotlight Search Button (Ctrl+K) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenSearch}
            className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 border border-stone-200 text-stone-600 rounded-none text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"

/**

 * Accessible, responsive single image uploader with:
 * - Drag-and-drop zone
 * - Preview using <Picture>
 * - Replace / Remove actions
 * - Alt text editing
 * - Persian progress and error messaging
 * - Full keyboard navigation (focus rings, enter/space triggers)
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useTransition } from 'react';
import { Picture } from '@/components/ui/picture';
import { uploadMediaAction, updateMediaAltAction } from '@/server/actions/media-actions';
import { MediaAssetRecord } from '@/server/db/client';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';

export interface ImageUploaderProps {
  value?: MediaAssetRecord | null;
  onChange: (asset: MediaAssetRecord | null) => void;
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function ImageUploader({
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  className = '',
}: ImageUploaderProps) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [altText, setAltText] = useState<string>(value?.alt || '');
  const [isAltSaved, setIsAltSaved] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);

  const handleFileSelect = async (file: File) => {
    setError(null);
    setProgress(10);

    // Client-side quick checks
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError(uiStringsFa.adminMedia.fileTooLarge);
      setProgress(0);
      return;
    }

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    formData.append('alt', altText);

    startTransition(async () => {
      setProgress(40);
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress((prev) => (prev < 90 ? prev + 15 : prev));
      }, 100);

      const res = await uploadMediaAction(formData);
      clearInterval(timer);
      setProgress(100);

      if (res.success && res.data) {
        onChange(res.data);
        setAltText(res.data.alt || '');
        setError(null);
      } else {
        setError(res.error || uiStringsFa.adminMedia.processingError);
      }

      setTimeout(() => setProgress(0), 400);
    });
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const handleAltSave = async () => {
    if (!value?.id) return;
    const res = await updateMediaAltAction({ assetId: value.id, alt: altText });
    if (res.success) {
      setIsAltSaved(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsAltSaved(false), 2000);
      onChange({ ...value, alt: altText });
    }
  };

  const handleRemove = () => {
    onChange(null);
    setAltText('');
    setError(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-3 ${className}`}>
      {label && (
        <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115]">
          {label}
        </label>
      )}

      {/* Hidden File Input */}
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        className="hidden"
        aria-label={label || uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadTitle}
      />

      {/* Empty State / Upload Dropzone */}
      {!value ? (
        <div
          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
          onDrop={handleDrop}
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              fileInputRef.current?.click();
            }
          }}
          tabIndex={0}
          role="button"
          aria-label={uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadPrompt}
          className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 border-2 border-dashed transition-all cursor-pointer outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D97706] ${
            isDragging
              ? 'border-[#D97706] bg-[#FEF3C7]/40'
              : 'border-[#EFE9E0] bg-[#FFFBEB]/30 hover:border-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#FFFBEB]'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#D97706] flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
            <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115]">
            {uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadPrompt}
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs text-[#5C5248] mt-1 text-center">
            {uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadHint}
          </span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* Preview & Actions Card */
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-4 shadow-xs space-y-4 rounded-none">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-start">
            <div className="w-full sm:w-48 h-36 bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0] overflow-hidden shrink-0 relative group">
              <Picture
                asset={value}
                alt={altText}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
              />
              <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-[#2B1B10]/85 backdrop-blur-xs text-amber-300 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 border border-amber-500/30">

/**
 * Multi-Image Gallery Uploader Component (Phase 3, Task 5)
 * Handles:
 * - Multi-file selection and sequential upload
 * - Reordering of gallery items (move up/down)
 * - Individual alt text editing
 * - Removal of individual images
 * - Accessible keyboard navigation and Persian messaging
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useTransition } from 'react';
import { Picture } from '@/components/ui/picture';
import { uploadMediaAction, updateMediaAltAction } from '@/server/actions/media-actions';
import { MediaAssetRecord } from '@/server/db/client';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';

export interface MultiImageUploaderProps {
  values: MediaAssetRecord[];
  onChange: (assets: MediaAssetRecord[]) => void;
  label?: string;
  maxImages?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function MultiImageUploader({
  values = [],
  onChange,
  label = uiStringsFa.adminMedia.multiUploadTitle,
  maxImages = 10,
  className = '',
}: MultiImageUploaderProps) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFilesSelect = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    if (values.length + files.length > maxImages) {
      setError(`حداکثر ${maxImages} تصویر می‌توانید در این گالری اضافه کنید.`);
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setProgress(10);

    startTransition(async () => {
      const uploadedAssets: MediaAssetRecord[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        const file = files[i];
        if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
          setError(`فایل ${file.name} بیش از ۱۰ مگابایت است و رد شد.`);
          continue;
        }

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        formData.append('alt', '');

        const res = await uploadMediaAction(formData);
        if (res.success && res.data) {
          uploadedAssets.push(res.data);
        } else {
          setError(res.error || uiStringsFa.adminMedia.processingError);
        }

        setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / files.length) * 100));
      }

      if (uploadedAssets.length > 0) {
        onChange([...values, ...uploadedAssets]);
      }

      setTimeout(() => setProgress(0), 400);
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      }
    });
  };

  const handleMove = (index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const targetIndex = direction === 'up' ? index - 1 : index + 1;
    if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= values.length) return;

    const updated = [...values];
    const temp = updated[index];
    updated[index] = updated[targetIndex];
    updated[targetIndex] = temp;
    onChange(updated);
  };

  const handleRemove = (index: number) => {
    const updated = values.filter((_, idx) => idx !== index);
    onChange(updated);
  };

  const handleAltChange = async (index: number, newAlt: string) => {
    const updated = [...values];
    updated[index] = { ...updated[index], alt: newAlt };
    onChange(updated);

    if (updated[index].id) {
      await updateMediaAltAction({ assetId: updated[index].id, alt: newAlt });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-4 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115]">{label}</h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
            {values.length} از {maxImages} تصویر اضافه شده است.
          </span>
        </div>

        {values.length < maxImages && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>+</span>
            <span>{uiStringsFa.adminMedia.addImage}</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        multiple
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
        onChange={handleFilesSelect}
        className="hidden"
        aria-label={label}
      />

      {/* Progress Bar */}
      {isPending && progress > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
            <span>{uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploading}</span>
            <span>{progress}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-[#EFE9E0] overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-[#D97706] transition-all duration-200"
              style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error Banner */}
      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-[#FEF2F2] border-s-4 border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556] text-xs leading-relaxed" role="alert">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty State */}
      {values.length === 0 && (
        <div
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          tabIndex={0}
          role="button"
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
              e.preventDefault();
              fileInputRef.current?.click();
            }
          }}
          className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 border-2 border-dashed border-[#EFE9E0] bg-[#FFFBEB]/30 hover:border-[#D97706] cursor-pointer transition-colors"
        >
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#D97706] flex items-center justify-center mb-2">
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#332115]">
            {uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadPrompt}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#5C5248] mt-1">
            {uiStringsFa.adminMedia.uploadHint}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Gallery Cards List */}
      {values.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {values.map((item, idx) => (
            <div
              key={item.id || idx}
              className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-4 p-3 bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] shadow-xs"

                  WebP
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Info & Alt Text */}
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5 w-full">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1 text-[11px] text-[#5C5248]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[9px] rounded-full">
