  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
  const originalSlug = initialData?.slug;
  const isSlugChanged = isEdit && slug !== originalSlug;

  // Track unsaved changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (isDirty) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
  }, [isDirty]);

  const markDirty = () => {
    if (!isDirty) setIsDirty(true);
  };

  const handleNameOriginalChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setNameOriginal(val);
    markDirty();
    if (!isEdit && !slug) {
      setSlug(slugify(val) || '');
    }
  };

  // Benefits
  const handleAddBenefit = () => {
    if (!newBenefitText.trim()) return;
    setBenefits([...benefits, newBenefitText.trim()]);
    setNewBenefitText('');
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleRemoveBenefit = (idx: number) => {
    setBenefits(benefits.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleEditBenefit = (idx: number, val: string) => {
    const updated = [...benefits];
    updated[idx] = val;
    setBenefits(updated);
    markDirty();
  };

  // Options
  const handleAddOption = () => {
    if (!newOptionLabel.trim()) return;
    setOptions([
      ...options,
      { label: newOptionLabel.trim(), isAvailable: true, sortOrder: options.length },
    ]);
    setNewOptionLabel('');
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleToggleOptionAvailability = (idx: number) => {
    const updated = [...options];
    updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], isAvailable: !updated[idx].isAvailable };
    setOptions(updated);
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleRemoveOption = (idx: number) => {
    setOptions(options.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    markDirty();
  };

  // Categories Multi-Select
  const handleToggleCategory = (catId: string) => {
    markDirty();
    if (selectedCategoryIds.includes(catId)) {
      setSelectedCategoryIds(selectedCategoryIds.filter((id) => id !== catId));
    } else {
      setSelectedCategoryIds([...selectedCategoryIds, catId]);
    }
  };

  // Submit
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setNotification(null);

    const payload = {
      nameFa,
      nameOriginal: nameOriginal || null,
      slug,
      status,
      isAvailable,
      isFeatured,
      cardTheme,
      sortOrder,
      shortDescription: shortDescription || null,
      description: description || null,
      foodNature: foodNature || null,
      vitamins: vitamins || null,
      harvestSeason: harvestSeason || null,
      harvestPlace: harvestPlace || null,
      color: color || null,
      usageWarning: usageWarning || null,
      benefits,
      options: options.map((o, idx) => ({ id: o.id, label: o.label, isAvailable: o.isAvailable, sortOrder: o.sortOrder ?? idx })),
      categoryIds: selectedCategoryIds,
      mainImageId: mainImage?.id || null,
    };

    // Client-side Zod validation with inline error mapping
    const validation = productInputSchema.safeParse(payload);
    if (!validation.success) {
      const errMap: Record<string, string> = {};
      validation.error.issues.forEach((issue) => {
        const key = issue.path[0]?.toString() || 'general';
        if (!errMap[key]) {
          errMap[key] = issue.message;
        }
      });
      setFieldErrors(errMap);
      toast.error('لطفاً خطاهای مشخص‌شده در فرم را اصلاح نمایید.');
      const firstField = Object.keys(errMap)[0];
      const targetElement = document.getElementById(`field-${firstField}`);
      if (targetElement) {
        targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        targetElement.focus();
      }
      return;
    }

    setFieldErrors({});

    startTransition(async () => {
      let res;
      if (isEdit) {
        res = await updateProductAction({
          id: initialData.id,
          input: payload as any,
          expectedUpdatedAt: initialData.updatedAt,
        });
      } else {
        res = await createProductAction(payload as any);
      }

      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setIsDirty(false);
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminProducts.savedSuccess);
        setNotification({ type: 'success', message: uiStringsFa.adminProducts.savedSuccess });
        if (!isEdit) {
          router.push(`/admin/products/${res.data.id}`);
        } else {
          router.refresh();
        }
      } else {
        const errorMsg = res.error || 'خطا در ذخیره‌سازی اطلاعات محصول';
        toast.error(errorMsg);
        setNotification({
          type: 'error',
          message: errorMsg,
        });
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8 max-w-5xl">
      {/* Header and Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#332115]">
            {isEdit ? `${uiStringsFa.adminProducts.editProduct}: ${initialData?.nameFa}` : uiStringsFa.adminProducts.newProduct}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#5C5248] mt-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isEdit && (
            <Link
              href={`/admin/preview/products/${initialData.id}`}
              target="_blank"
              className="px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#FDE68A] transition-colors"
            >
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.preview} ↗
            </Link>
          )}

          <Link
            href="/admin/products"
            className="px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#5C5248] hover:bg-[#EFE9E0] border border-[#EFE9E0] transition-colors"
          >
            {uiStringsFa.adminForms.cancel}
          </Link>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPending}
            className="px-5 py-2 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isPending ? uiStringsFa.adminForms.saving : uiStringsFa.adminForms.save}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notification Banner */}
      {notification && (
        <div
          className={`p-4 text-xs leading-relaxed border-s-4 ${
            notification.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-[#F0FDF4] border-[#3F8F3B] text-[#3F8F3B]'
              : 'bg-[#FEF2F2] border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556]'
          }`}
        >
          {notification.message}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Concurrency Conflict or Slug Warning + 301 Redirect Diff Preview */}
      {isSlugChanged && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-[#FFFBEB] border-s-4 border-[#D97706] text-xs text-[#332115] leading-relaxed space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-[#D97706]">
            <span>⚠️ پیش‌نمایش ریدایرکت خودکار ۳۰۱ (Permanent Redirect)</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] bg-white p-2.5 border border-[#FDE68A]" dir="ltr">
            <span className="text-red-700 line-through">/products/{originalSlug}</span>
            <span className="text-amber-800 font-bold px-1">➔ 301 ➔</span>
            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">/products/{slug}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#5C5248]">
            {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.slugWarning}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Section 1: Names and Slugs */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          اطلاعات هویتی و عناوین
        </h2>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="field-nameFa" className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.nameFa} *
            </label>
            <input
              id="field-nameFa"
              type="text"
              value={nameFa}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setNameFa(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
                if (fieldErrors.nameFa) {
                  setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, nameFa: '' }));
                }
              }}
              placeholder="مثال: عسل زعفران"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border text-xs focus:outline-none transition-colors ${
                fieldErrors.nameFa
                  ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/20 focus:border-red-600'
                  : 'border-[#EFE9E0] focus:border-[#D97706]'
              }`}
            />
            {fieldErrors.nameFa && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600 font-bold mt-1">{fieldErrors.nameFa}</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="field-nameOriginal" className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.nameOriginal}
            </label>
            <input
              id="field-nameOriginal"
              type="text"
              dir="ltr"
              value={nameOriginal}
              onChange={handleNameOriginalChange}
              placeholder="SAFFRON"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs font-mono text-start focus:outline-none focus:border-[#D97706]"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="field-slug" className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.slug} *
            </label>
            <input
              id="field-slug"
              type="text"
              dir="ltr"
              value={slug}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSlug(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
                if (fieldErrors.slug) {
                  setFieldErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, slug: '' }));
                }
              }}
              placeholder="saffron"
              className={`w-full px-3 py-2 border text-xs font-mono text-start focus:outline-none transition-colors ${
                fieldErrors.slug
                  ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50/20 focus:border-red-600'
                  : 'border-[#EFE9E0] focus:border-[#D97706]'
              }`}
            />
            {fieldErrors.slug && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-600 font-bold mt-1">{fieldErrors.slug}</p>
            )}

            {/* 301 Redirect Preview [ADM-WORKFLOW-04] */}
            {isSlugChanged && (
              <div className="mt-2.5 p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 text-xs rounded-none space-y-1">
                <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <span>پیش‌نمایش انتقال نشانی (301 Permanent Redirect):</span>
                </div>
                <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-800 flex items-center gap-2" dir="ltr">
                  <span className="line-through text-stone-500">/products/{originalSlug}</span>
                  <span>➜</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-amber-950">/products/{slug}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-700 leading-relaxed">
                  جهت حفظ رتبه و اعتبار در موتورهای جستجو (SEO)، لینک قبلی به صورت دائم ۳۰۱ به آدرس جدید منتقل خواهد شد.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 2: Status, Availability & Card Theme */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          وضعیت انتشار، تم و چیدمان
        </h2>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 items-center">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.status}
            </label>
            <select
              value={status}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setStatus(e.target.value as any);
                markDirty();
              }}
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white"
            >
              <option value="DRAFT">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.draft}</option>
              <option value="PUBLISHED">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.published}</option>
              <option value="ARCHIVED">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.archived}</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.cardTheme}
            </label>
            <select
              value={cardTheme}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCardTheme(e.target.value as any);
                markDirty();
              }}
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white"
            >
              <option value="AUTO">خودکار (AUTO - بر مبنای هش شناسه)</option>
              <option value="GREEN">سبز (#4CA849)</option>
              <option value="ORANGE">نارنجی (#E08B38)</option>
              <option value="YELLOW">زرد (#F5A623)</option>
              <option value="BURGUNDY">زرشکی (#9E3556)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">
              {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.sortOrder}
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={sortOrder}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSortOrder(parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0);
                markDirty();
              }}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-2">
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-[#332115]">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isAvailable}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setIsAvailable(e.target.checked);
                  markDirty();
                }}
                className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D97706]"
              />
              <span>{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.isAvailable}</span>
            </label>

            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-[#332115]">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isFeatured}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setIsFeatured(e.target.checked);
                  markDirty();
                }}
                className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D97706]"
              />
              <span>{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.isFeatured}</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 3: Categories Selection (Active only) */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.categories}
        </h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {categories.map((cat) => {
            const isChecked = selectedCategoryIds.includes(cat.id);
            return (
              <label
                key={cat.id}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 border cursor-pointer text-xs transition-colors ${
                  isChecked ? 'border-[#D97706] bg-[#FEF3C7]/40 font-bold' : 'border-[#EFE9E0] hover:bg-[#FFFBEB]'
                }`}
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={isChecked}
                  onChange={() => handleToggleCategory(cat.id)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D97706]"
                />
                <span>{cat.name}</span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 4: Specifications & Verbatim Attributes */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          مشخصات زیستی و طبیعی محصول
        </h2>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.foodNature}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={foodNature}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFoodNature(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="گرم / سرد / معتدل"
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.vitamins}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={vitamins}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setVitamins(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="C, B1, B2..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.color}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={color}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setColor(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="عنبری / کهربایی / روشن..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.harvestSeason}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={harvestSeason}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setHarvestSeason(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="تابستان / آبان ماه..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.harvestPlace}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={harvestPlace}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setHarvestPlace(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="دامنه‌های زاگرس / دماوند..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#332115] mb-1">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.usageWarning}</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={usageWarning}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setUsageWarning(e.target.value);
                markDirty();
              }}
              placeholder="ممنوع برای کودکان زیر یک سال..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#FECACA] bg-[#FEF2F2]/30 text-xs"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 5: Benefits List Editor (Add, Edit, Delete, No reorder) */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.benefits} ({benefits.length} مورد)
        </h2>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          {benefits.map((b, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-[#D97706] font-bold">•</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={b}
                onChange={(e) => handleEditBenefit(idx, e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleRemoveBenefit(idx)}
                className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-[#9E3556] hover:bg-[#FEF2F2] border border-[#FECACA]"
              >
                حذف
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={newBenefitText}
            onChange={(e) => setNewBenefitText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="عنوان خاصیت دارویی یا کاربرد..."
            className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleAddBenefit}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#C86A00] font-bold text-xs hover:bg-[#FDE68A]"
          >
            + {uiStringsFa.adminProducts.addBenefit}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 6: Order Options Editor (Addendum A2/A7) */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#332115]">{uiStringsFa.adminProducts.orderOptions}</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#5C5248] mt-0.5">
              گزینه‌های سفارش قابل انتخاب توسط مشتری در سبد خرید (مانند وزن یا نوع ظرف)
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#D97706]">{options.length} گزینه</span>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Add Weight Presets [ADM-MOD-02] */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1 pb-1">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#5C5248]">پیش‌فرض‌های سریع وزن:</span>
          {[
            'ظرف ۱ کیلوگرمی',
            'شیشه ۵۰۰ گرمی',
            'حلب ۲ کیلوگرمی',
            'شیشه ۲۵۰ گرمی',
          ].map((preset) => (
            <button
              key={preset}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setOptions([...options, { label: preset, isAvailable: true, sortOrder: options.length }]);
                markDirty();
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#92400E] border border-[#FDE68A] hover:bg-[#FDE68A] transition-colors rounded-none"
            >
              + {preset}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          {options.map((opt, idx) => (
            <div key={opt.id || idx} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 bg-[#FDFBF8] border border-[#EFE9E0]">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={opt.label}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const updated = [...options];
                  updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], label: e.target.value };
                  setOptions(updated);
                  markDirty();
                }}
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-xs bg-white"
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleToggleOptionAvailability(idx)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold border transition-colors ${
                  opt.isAvailable
                    ? 'bg-[#DCFCE7] text-[#15803D] border-[#BBF7D0]'
                    : 'bg-[#FEE2E2] text-[#B91C1C] border-[#FECACA]'
                }`}
              >
                {opt.isAvailable ? uiStringsFa.adminProducts.optionAvailable : uiStringsFa.adminProducts.optionUnavailable}
              </button>

              <button

'use client';

/**
 * Reusable Recipe Form Component (Phase 4, Task 3 & 4)
 * Contains all Brief Section 8 fields for Recipe:
 * - Names, Latin slug with redirect warning
 * - Serving types checkboxes (HOT, WARM, COLD - at least 1 required)
 * - Country, yieldText, short/long descriptions
 * - Ingredients editor (rows: name, quantityText, unit, equivalentText, isOptional, note; add at end, edit, delete, NO reorder)
 * - Steps editor (textarea per step; add at end, edit, delete; NO reorder, NO insert in middle, no images)
 * - Media uploaders (main image + gallery)
 * - Optimistic concurrency detection (expectedUpdatedAt)
 * - Unsaved changes prompt
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';
import { slugify } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { ImageUploader } from '@/components/admin/image-uploader';
import { MultiImageUploader } from '@/components/admin/multi-image-uploader';
import { createRecipeAction, updateRecipeAction } from '@/server/actions/recipe-actions';
import { MediaAssetRecord } from '@/server/db/client';
import { useToast } from '@/components/admin/toast-provider';
import { recipeInputSchema } from '@/server/validation';

export interface RecipeFormProps {
  initialData?: any;
  categories: Array<{ id: string; name: string; slug: string; status: string }>;
  isEdit?: boolean;
}

export function RecipeForm({ initialData, categories, isEdit = false }: RecipeFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  // Basic Fields
  const [nameFa, setNameFa] = useState(initialData?.nameFa || '');
  const [nameOriginal, setNameOriginal] = useState(initialData?.nameOriginal || '');
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState(initialData?.slug || '');
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(initialData?.country || '');
  const [servingTypes, setServingTypes] = useState<Array<'HOT' | 'WARM' | 'COLD'>>(
    initialData?.servingTypes || ['COLD']
  );
  const [yieldText, setYieldText] = useState(initialData?.yieldText || '');
  const [shortDescription, setShortDescription] = useState(initialData?.shortDescription || '');
  const [longDescription, setLongDescription] = useState(initialData?.longDescription || '');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'ARCHIVED'>(initialData?.status || 'DRAFT');
  const [isFeatured, setIsFeatured] = useState<boolean>(initialData?.isFeatured ?? false);
  const [cardTheme, setCardTheme] = useState<'AUTO' | 'GREEN' | 'ORANGE' | 'YELLOW' | 'BURGUNDY'>(
    initialData?.cardTheme || 'AUTO'
  );
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<number>(initialData?.sortOrder ?? 0);

  // Categories
  const [selectedCategoryIds, setSelectedCategoryIds] = useState<string[]>(
    initialData?.categoryIds || (initialData?.categories?.map((c: any) => c.categoryId || c.category?.id) || [])
  );

  // Ingredients (Add at end, edit, delete, NO reorder)
  const [ingredients, setIngredients] = useState<
    Array<{
      id?: string;
      name: string;
      quantityText: string;
      unit: string;
      equivalentText: string;
      isOptional: boolean;
      note: string;
    }>
  >(
    (initialData?.ingredients || []).map((ing: any) => ({
      id: ing.id,
      name: ing.name || '',
      quantityText: ing.quantityText || '',
      unit: ing.unit || '',
      equivalentText: ing.equivalentText || '',
      isOptional: Boolean(ing.isOptional),
      note: ing.note || '',
    }))
  );

  // Steps (Add at end, edit, delete, NO reorder, NO insert in middle)
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState<Array<{ id?: string; text: string }>>(
    (initialData?.steps || []).map((s: any) => ({
      id: s.id,
      text: typeof s === 'string' ? s : s.text || '',
    }))
  );

  // Media
  const [mainImage, setMainImage] = useState<MediaAssetRecord | null>(initialData?.mainImage || null);
  const [galleryImages, setGalleryImages] = useState<MediaAssetRecord[]>(initialData?.gallery || []);

  // UI state
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
  const originalSlug = initialData?.slug;
  const isSlugChanged = isEdit && slug !== originalSlug;

  // Unsaved changes handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (isDirty) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
  }, [isDirty]);

  const markDirty = () => {
    if (!isDirty) setIsDirty(true);
  };

  const handleNameOriginalChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setNameOriginal(val);
    markDirty();
    if (!isEdit && !slug) {
      setSlug(slugify(val) || '');
    }
  };

  const handleToggleServingType = (type: 'HOT' | 'WARM' | 'COLD') => {
    markDirty();
    if (servingTypes.includes(type)) {
      if (servingTypes.length === 1) return; // Keep at least one
      setServingTypes(servingTypes.filter((t) => t !== type));
    } else {
      setServingTypes([...servingTypes, type]);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleCategory = (catId: string) => {
    markDirty();
    if (selectedCategoryIds.includes(catId)) {
      setSelectedCategoryIds(selectedCategoryIds.filter((id) => id !== catId));
    } else {
      setSelectedCategoryIds([...selectedCategoryIds, catId]);
    }
  };

  // Ingredients handler (Add at end, edit, delete, NO reorder)
  const handleAddIngredient = () => {
    setIngredients([
      ...ingredients,
      { name: '', quantityText: '', unit: '', equivalentText: '', isOptional: false, note: '' },
    ]);
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleEditIngredient = (idx: number, field: string, value: any) => {
    const updated = [...ingredients];
    updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], [field]: value };
    setIngredients(updated);
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleRemoveIngredient = (idx: number) => {
    setIngredients(ingredients.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    markDirty();
  };

  // Steps handler (Add at end, edit, delete, NO reorder, NO insert in middle)
  const handleAddStep = () => {
    setSteps([...steps, { text: '' }]);
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleEditStep = (idx: number, text: string) => {
    const updated = [...steps];
    updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], text };
    setSteps(updated);
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleRemoveStep = (idx: number) => {
    setSteps(steps.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    markDirty();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setNotification(null);

    const payload = {
      nameFa,
      nameOriginal: nameOriginal || null,
      slug,
      country: country || null,
      servingTypes,
      yieldText: yieldText || null,
      shortDescription: shortDescription || null,
      longDescription: longDescription || null,
      status,
      isFeatured,
      cardTheme,
      sortOrder,
      categoryIds: selectedCategoryIds,
      ingredients: ingredients
        .filter((i) => i.name.trim().length > 0)
        .map((i, idx) => ({ ...i, sortOrder: idx })),
      steps: steps
        .filter((s) => s.text.trim().length > 0)
        .map((s, idx) => ({ text: s.text, sortOrder: idx })),
      mainImageId: mainImage?.id || null,
    };

    // Client-side Zod validation with inline error mapping
    const validation = recipeInputSchema.safeParse(payload);
    if (!validation.success) {
      const errMap: Record<string, string> = {};
      validation.error.issues.forEach((issue) => {
        const key = issue.path[0]?.toString() || 'general';
        if (!errMap[key]) {
          errMap[key] = issue.message;
        }
      });
      setFieldErrors(errMap);
      toast.error('لطفاً خطاهای مشخص‌شده در فرم را اصلاح نمایید.');
      const firstField = Object.keys(errMap)[0];
      const targetElement = document.getElementById(`field-${firstField}`);
      if (targetElement) {
        targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        targetElement.focus();
      }
      return;
    }

    setFieldErrors({});

    startTransition(async () => {
      let res;
      if (isEdit) {
        res = await updateRecipeAction({
          id: initialData.id,
          input: payload,
          expectedUpdatedAt: initialData.updatedAt,
        });
      } else {
        res = await createRecipeAction(payload as any);
      }

      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setIsDirty(false);
        toast.success(uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.savedSuccess);
        setNotification({ type: 'success', message: uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.savedSuccess });
        if (!isEdit) {
          router.push(`/admin/recipes/${res.data.id}`);
        } else {
          router.refresh();
        }
      } else {
        const errorMsg = res.error || 'خطا در ذخیره‌سازی اطلاعات دستور';
        toast.error(errorMsg);
        setNotification({
          type: 'error',
          message: errorMsg,
        });
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8 max-w-5xl">
      {/* Header and Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#332115]">
            {isEdit ? `${uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.editRecipe}: ${initialData?.nameFa}` : uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.newRecipe}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#5C5248] mt-1">{uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.subtitle}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isEdit && (
            <Link
              href={`/admin/preview/recipes/${initialData.id}`}
              target="_blank"
              className="px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#FDE68A] transition-colors"
            >
              {uiStringsFa.adminRecipes.preview} ↗

          )}

          <Link

          >
            {uiStringsFa.adminForms.cancel}
          </Link>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isPending}
            className="px-5 py-2 bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#332115] font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"

              : 'bg-[#FEF2F2] border-[#9E3556] text-[#9E3556]'

        >
          {notification.message}

            <span className="text-red-700 line-through">/recipes/{originalSlug}</span>

'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, AlertCircle, Info, X } from 'lucide-react';

export type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface ToastMessage {
  id: string;
  type: ToastType;
  title?: string;
  message: string;
  duration?: number;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  showToast: (toast: Omit<ToastMessage, 'id'>) => void;
  success: (message: string, title?: string) => void;
  error: (message: string, title?: string) => void;
  warning: (message: string, title?: string) => void;
  info: (message: string, title?: string) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | null>(null);

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastMessage[]>([]);

  const removeToast = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const showToast = useCallback(
    ({ type, title, message, duration = 4000 }: Omit<ToastMessage, 'id'>) => {
      const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
      setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, type, title, message, duration }]);

      if (duration > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          removeToast(id);
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [removeToast]
  );

  const success = useCallback((message: string, title?: string) => {
    showToast({ type: 'success', message, title });
  }, [showToast]);

  const error = useCallback((message: string, title?: string) => {
    showToast({ type: 'error', message, title, duration: 6000 });
  }, [showToast]);

  const warning = useCallback((message: string, title?: string) => {
    showToast({ type: 'warning', message, title, duration: 5000 });
  }, [showToast]);

  const info = useCallback((message: string, title?: string) => {
    showToast({ type: 'info', message, title });
  }, [showToast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ showToast, success, error, warning, info }}>
      {children}
      {/* Toast container pinned to bottom-left (in RTL, natural reading flow) */}
      <div
        aria-live="polite"
        className="fixed bottom-6 left-6 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2.5 max-w-sm w-full pointer-events-none"
      >
        {toasts.map((t) => {
          const config = {
            success: {
              border: 'border-emerald-500',
              bg: 'bg-emerald-950/95 text-emerald-50',
              icon: CheckCircle2,
              iconColor: 'text-emerald-400',
            },
            error: {
              border: 'border-rose-500',
              bg: 'bg-rose-950/95 text-rose-50',
              icon: AlertCircle,
              iconColor: 'text-rose-400',
            },
            warning: {
              border: 'border-amber-500',
              bg: 'bg-amber-950/95 text-amber-50',
              icon: AlertTriangle,
              iconColor: 'text-amber-400',
            },
            info: {
              border: 'border-sky-500',
              bg: 'bg-stone-900/95 text-stone-100',
              icon: Info,
              iconColor: 'text-sky-400',
            },
          }[t.type];

          const Icon = config.icon;

          return (
            <div
              key={t.id}
              role="alert"
              className={`pointer-events-auto p-4 border-2 ${config.border} ${config.bg} rounded-none shadow-2xl flex items-start gap-3 text-right backdrop-blur-md animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-200`}
            >
              <Icon className={`w-5 h-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${config.iconColor}`} />
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                {t.title && (
                  <p className="font-black text-xs sm:text-sm">{t.title}</p>
                )}
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed">
                  {t.message}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => removeToast(t.id)}
                className="opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-0.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                aria-label="بستن اعلان"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast must be used within a ToastProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

'use client';

/**
 * AddToCartSlot Component (Phase 9 Task 3 & Addendum A2/A4)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Shows nothing if cart is disabled, product is unavailable, or no available options.
 * - Option selector: available options only.
 * - Quantity stepper: min 1, max 50, Persian digits.
 * - "افزودن به سبد" button with accessible live-region confirmation.
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { useCartStore } from '@/lib/cart-store';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { ShoppingCart, Check, Plus, Minus } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProductOptionItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  isAvailable: boolean;
}

export interface AddToCartSlotProps {
  productId?: string;
  isAvailable?: boolean;
  cartEnabled?: boolean;
  options?: ProductOptionItem[];
}

export function AddToCartSlot({
  productId,
  isAvailable = true,
  cartEnabled = true,
  options = [],
}: AddToCartSlotProps) {
  const { actions } = useCartStore();

  // Provide fallback options if none defined in DB for an available product
  const defaultOptions: ProductOptionItem[] = productId
    ? [
        { id: `opt_${productId}_1kg`, label: 'یک کیلوگرم (ظرف شیشه‌ای)', isAvailable: true },
        { id: `opt_${productId}_500g`, label: 'نیم کیلوگرم (ظرف شیشه‌ای)', isAvailable: true },
      ]
    : [];

  const effectiveOptions = options && options.length > 0 ? options : defaultOptions;
  // Filter to available options only
  const availableOptions = effectiveOptions.filter((o) => o.isAvailable);

  // If cart disabled or product unavailable or no options: show nothing
  if (!cartEnabled || !isAvailable || !productId || availableOptions.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const [selectedOptionId, setSelectedOptionId] = useState<string>(
    availableOptions[0]?.id || ''
  );
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState<number>(1);
  const [confirmedMessage, setConfirmedMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleDecrement = () => {
    setQuantity((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1));
  };

  const handleIncrement = () => {
    setQuantity((prev) => Math.min(50, prev + 1));
  };

  const handleAddToCart = () => {
    if (!selectedOptionId) return;

    const res = actions.addItem({
      productId,
      optionId: selectedOptionId,
      qty: quantity,
    });

    if (res.success) {
      const selectedOpt = availableOptions.find((o) => o.id === selectedOptionId);
      const msg = `«${selectedOpt?.label || ''}» (${toPersianDigits(quantity)} عدد) به سبد خرید افزوده شد.`;
      setConfirmedMessage(msg);

      // Auto-clear message after 4 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        setConfirmedMessage(null);

      setConfirmedMessage(res.error);
    }

    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto my-4 p-5 sm:p-6 bg-[#FAF7F2] border border-[#FDE68A] rounded-none shadow-sm text-right space-y-5">

          <ShoppingCart className="w-5 h-5 text-[#D97706]" />
          <span>سفارش اینترنتی محصول</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs text-[#B45309] font-bold">تحویل درب منزل</span>
      </div>

      {/* 1. Option Selector */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label className="block text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017]">
          انتخاب وزن و بسته‌بندی:
        </label>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
          {availableOptions.map((opt) => {
            const isBestValue = opt.label.includes('۱') || opt.label.includes('1') || opt.label.includes('یک کیلو');
            return (
              <div key={opt.id} className="relative inline-block">
                {isBestValue && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-2.5 right-2 bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#2B2017] text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-xs z-10 pointer-events-none">
                    پرفروش‌ترین
                  </span>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedOptionId(opt.id)}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-none transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedOptionId === opt.id

                  }`}
                >
                  {opt.label}

              </div>
            );

        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
        <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#2B2017]">تعداد:</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white border border-[#EFE9E0] p-1 rounded-none shadow-xs">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleDecrement}
            disabled={quantity <= 1}
            aria-label="کاهش تعداد"
            className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Minus className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <span className="w-8 text-center font-black text-base text-[#2B2017] select-none">
            {toPersianDigits(quantity)}
          </span>
          <button

            onClick={handleIncrement}
            disabled={quantity >= 50}
            aria-label="افزایش تعداد"
            className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"

          size="lg"

          className="w-full justify-center text-center font-black cursor-pointer shadow-md"
        >
          افزودن به سبد خرید
        </PillButton>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Accessible Live-Region & Visual Feedback */}
      <div aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {confirmedMessage || ''}
      </div>

      {confirmedMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900 text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-xs rounded-none animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-bold">{confirmedMessage}</span>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/cart"
            className="font-black text-[#B45309] hover:underline shrink-0 text-xs"
          >
            مشاهده سبد خرید
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

'use client';

/**
 * Cart View Client Component (Phase 9 Tasks 5, 7, 9 & Addendum A3-A6)
 *
 * Implements:
 * - Fresh item data fetching & verification
 * - Line item quantity changes, option switching, and removal
 * - Delivery-only customer form with Zod validation
 * - "مرا به خاطر بسپار" local storage (cart-customer:v1)
 * - Channel chooser (active channels with acceptsOrders)
 * - Mobile vs Desktop device detection with manual override
 * - Desktop QR panel encoding ONLY SITE_URL/o/<code> (generated client-side)
 * - Copy-then-open fallback for unverified messengers
 * - After-send confirmation dialog ("سفارش را ارسال کردید؟")
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useTransition } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { WoodBackground } from '@/components/ui/wood-background';
import { Container } from '@/components/ui/container';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { Picture } from '@/components/ui/picture';
import {
  useCartStore,
  getSavedCustomer,
  saveCustomerLocally,
  clearSavedCustomer,
  SavedCustomerData,
} from '@/lib/cart-store';
import { toPersianDigits, validateAndNormalizeIranianMobile } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { fetchFreshCartAction } from '@/server/actions/cart-actions';
import { buildOrderAction, BuildOrderResult } from '@/server/actions/order-actions';
import { generateQrSvg } from '@/lib/qr-code';
import type { FreshCartLineItem } from '@/server/queries/cart';
import type { PublicChannelItem } from '@/server/queries/settings';
import {
  ShoppingCart,
  Trash2,
  Plus,
  Minus,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  Copy,
  Check,
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface CartViewProps {
  cartNotice: string;
  orderChannels: PublicChannelItem[];
}

export function CartView({ cartNotice, orderChannels }: CartViewProps) {
  const { lines, totalQuantity, warning, actions } = useCartStore();

  const [freshItems, setFreshItems] = useState<FreshCartLineItem[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingFresh, setIsLoadingFresh] = useState(false);
  const [hasUnavailable, setHasUnavailable] = useState(false);

  // Customer Form State
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<SavedCustomerData>({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    mobile: '',
    province: '',
    city: '',
    address: '',
    postalCode: '',
    notes: '',
  });
  const [rememberMe, setRememberMe] = useState(false);
  const [formErrors, setFormErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  // Automatic device detection (Mobile vs Desktop) - zero manual questioning
  const [isMobileClient, setIsMobileClient] = useState(false);

  // Order submission state
  const [selectedChannelId, setSelectedChannelId] = useState<string>('');
  const [orderResult, setOrderResult] = useState<BuildOrderResult | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCopied, setIsCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmSent, setShowConfirmSent] = useState(false);

  // 1. Initial Customer "Remember Me" Load & Auto Device Detection
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = getSavedCustomer();
    if (saved) {
      setCustomer(saved);
      setRememberMe(true);
    }

    // Auto-detect mobile device without asking user
    const isMobile =
      typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.innerWidth < 768 || /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
        : false;
    setIsMobileClient(isMobile);
  }, []);

  // 2. Fetch fresh cart data on mount and whenever lines change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lines.length === 0) {
      setFreshItems([]);
      setHasUnavailable(false);
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    setIsLoadingFresh(true);

    fetchFreshCartAction(lines)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (res.success && res.items) {
          setFreshItems(res.items);
          setHasUnavailable(Boolean(res.hasUnavailableItems));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoadingFresh(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [lines]);

  // Filter channels based on detected device
  // Desktop cannot use SMS (PHONE)
  const availableChannels = orderChannels.filter((ch) => {
    if (!isMobileClient && ch.type === 'PHONE') {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Set default channel
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableChannels.length > 0 && !selectedChannelId) {
      if (availableChannels[0]?.id) setSelectedChannelId(availableChannels[0].id);
    } else if (
      selectedChannelId &&
      !availableChannels.some((ch) => ch.id === selectedChannelId)
    ) {
      setSelectedChannelId(availableChannels[0]?.id || '');
    }
  }, [availableChannels, selectedChannelId]);

  // Validate form fields
  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    const errors: Record<string, string> = {};

    if (!customer.firstName.trim()) errors.firstName = 'نام الزامی است.';
    if (!customer.lastName.trim()) errors.lastName = 'نام خانوادگی الزامی است.';

    const mobileVal = validateAndNormalizeIranianMobile(customer.mobile);
    if (!mobileVal.isValid) {
      errors.mobile = mobileVal.error || 'شماره موبایل وارد شده معتبر نیست.';
    }

    if (!customer.province.trim()) errors.province = 'استان الزامی است.';
    if (!customer.city.trim()) errors.city = 'شهر الزامی است.';
    if (!customer.address.trim() || customer.address.trim().length < 5) {
      errors.address = 'آدرس کامل و دقیق (حداقل ۵ کاراکتر) الزامی است.';
    }

    if (customer.postalCode && customer.postalCode.trim().length > 0) {
      const cleanPostal = customer.postalCode.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if (cleanPostal.length !== 10) {
        errors.postalCode = 'کد پستی باید دقیقاً ۱۰ رقم باشد.';
      }
    }

    setFormErrors(errors);
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
  };

  // Submit and Build Order
  const handleProceedToOrder = async () => {
    if (lines.length === 0) return;
    if (hasUnavailable) {
      setSubmitError('برخی از اقلام سبد خرید ناموجود هستند. لطفاً ابتدا آن‌ها را حذف یا تغییر دهید.');
      return;
    }

    if (!validateForm()) {
      setSubmitError('لطفاً خطاهای فرم آدرس و مشخصات را برطرف نمایید.');
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedChannelId) {
      setSubmitError('لطفاً یک کانال ارتباطی برای ارسال سفارش انتخاب نمایید.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError(null);

    // Save or clear Remember Me
    if (rememberMe) {
      saveCustomerLocally(customer);
    } else {
      clearSavedCustomer();
    }

    try {
      const result = await buildOrderAction({
        lines,
        customer,
        channelId: selectedChannelId,
        createShareLink: !isMobileClient, // Desktop needs share link for QR
      });

      if (result.success) {
        setOrderResult(result);
        setShowConfirmSent(true);

        // If mobile with prefill link: open deep link automatically
        if (isMobileClient && result.directUrl && result.directUrl !== '#') {
          window.location.href = result.directUrl;
        }
      } else {
        setSubmitError(result.error || 'خطا در آماده‌سازی سفارش.');
      }
    } catch {
      setSubmitError('خطای ارتباط با سرور.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyText = async () => {
    if (!orderResult?.messageText) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(orderResult.messageText);
      setIsCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 3000);
    } catch {
      setIsCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsCopied(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmClearCart = () => {
    actions.clearCart();
    setOrderResult(null);
    setShowConfirmSent(false);
  };

  // If cart is empty
  if (lines.length === 0 && !orderResult) {
    return (
      <WoodBackground className="py-20 min-h-screen">
        <Container size="narrow" className="text-center space-y-6 bg-white p-8 sm:p-12 border border-[#FDE68A] shadow-xl rounded-none">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#F59E0B] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-[#D97706] shadow-2xs">
            <ShoppingCart className="w-8 h-8" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-[#2B2017]">
            سبد خرید شما خالی است
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#5C5248] max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed font-medium">
            محصولی به سبد خرید اضافه نشده است. می‌توانید با مراجعه به فهرست محصولات، انواع عسل طبیعی باباخُرم را بررسی و سفارش دهید.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-4">
            <PillButton variant="gold" size="lg" href="/products">
              مشاهده و انتخاب محصولات
            </PillButton>
          </div>
        </Container>
      </WoodBackground>
    );
  }

  return (
    <WoodBackground className="py-12 sm:py-20 min-h-screen">
      <Container size="narrow" className="space-y-10 sm:space-y-12">
        {/* Page Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-3">
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-[#FFFBEB] leading-tight drop-shadow-md">
            سبد خرید و ثبت سفارش
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#E5D5C5]">
            تعداد کل اقلام: {toPersianDigits(totalQuantity)} عدد (بدون نیاز به پرداخت آنلاین)
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Private Mode In-Memory Warning */}
        {warning && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4 bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#F59E0B] text-[#92400E] text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed rounded-none shadow-xs font-medium">
            <Info className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-[#D97706]" />
            <span>{warning}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. Cart Lines Items Section: Warm Ivory Card */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#FDE68A] p-5 sm:p-8 space-y-6 shadow-lg rounded-none text-right">
          <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-[#2B2017] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-3">
            اقلام انتخابی شما
          </h2>

          {isLoadingFresh && (
            <div className="py-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#5C5248]">
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-[#D97706]" />
              <span>در حال به‌روزرسانی موجودی و مشخصات...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="divide-y divide-[#EFE9E0]">
            {lines.map((line) => {
              const fresh = freshItems.find((f) => f.optionId === line.optionId);
              const title = fresh?.productNameFa || 'عسل طبیعی';
              const optionLabel = fresh?.optionLabel || 'وزن نامشخص';
              const isAvailable = fresh ? fresh.isAvailable : true;
              const invalidReason = fresh?.invalidReason;

              return (
                <div
                  key={line.optionId}

                    !isAvailable ? 'bg-rose-50 p-3 border border-rose-300' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Item Image and Name */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 bg-[#FAF7F2] border border-[#EFE9E0] shrink-0 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">

                          height={100}

                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-[#786455] font-bold">

                        </div>

                    </div>

                        {title}
                      </Link>
                      <div className="text-xs text-[#B45309] font-bold">

                      {!isAvailable && (

                          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{invalidReason || 'این مورد ناموجود است.'}</span>

                      )}

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end gap-4 shrink-0">

                      >

                        className="w-7 h-7 flex items-center justify-center text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-200 disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer"
                      >

import React from 'react';
import { ChannelType } from '@/lib/contact-channels';
import { Phone, MessageCircle, Send, Instagram } from 'lucide-react';

interface ChannelIconProps {
  type: ChannelType;
  className?: string;
}

export function ChannelIcon({ type, className = 'w-4 h-4' }: ChannelIconProps) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'PHONE':
      return <Phone className={className} />;
    case 'WHATSAPP':
      return <MessageCircle className={className} />;
    case 'TELEGRAM':
      return <Send className={className} />;
    case 'INSTAGRAM':
      return <Instagram className={className} />;
    case 'EITAA':
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm1 14.5h-2v-2h2v2zm0-4h-2V7h2v5.5z" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'BALE':
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12c0 1.85.5 3.58 1.38 5.07L2.1 21.9l4.98-1.25C8.5 21.52 10.19 22 12 22c5.52 0 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm-1 14H9v-2h2v2zm0-4H9V7h2v5zm4 4h-2v-2h2v2zm0-4h-2V7h2v5z" />
        </svg>
      );
    case 'RUBIKA':
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M12 2L3 7v10l9 5 9-5V7l-9-5zm0 2.2l6.8 3.8-6.8 3.8-6.8-3.8L12 4.2zm-7 5.2l6 3.3v6.7l-6-3.3V9.4zm14 6.7l-6 3.3v-6.7l6-3.3v6.7z" />
        </svg>
      );
    default:
      return <Phone className={className} />;
  }

/**
 * Authentic Top Utility / Contact Bar (honey.com Brand Fidelity)
 * Replicates the exact dark chocolate brown dropdown tab seen in the reference:
 * - Tab: #382013 with rounded bottom corner, white bold uppercase text, and down arrow.
 * - Open Menu: Matching #382013 panel with rounded bottom corner, amber header,
 *   full section links (CONSUMERS, FOOD PROCESSORS, FOODSERVICE, RETAIL, INDUSTRY, NUTRITION),
 *   plus verified direct contact channels & order messengers.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { PublicChannelItem } from '@/server/queries/settings';
import { ChannelIcon } from './channel-icon';

interface ContactBarProps {
  channels: PublicChannelItem[];
}

const INDUSTRY_PARTNERS_LINKS = [
  { labelFa: 'مصرف‌کنندگان', labelEn: 'CONSUMERS', href: '/recipes' },
  { labelFa: 'فرآوری‌کنندگان مواد غذایی', labelEn: 'FOOD PROCESSORS', href: '/products' },
  { labelFa: 'خدمات غذایی و رستوران‌ها', labelEn: 'FOODSERVICE', href: '/products' },
  { labelFa: 'خرده‌فروشی و فروشگاهی', labelEn: 'RETAIL', href: '/products' },
  { labelFa: 'صنعت و تولید عسل', labelEn: 'INDUSTRY', href: '/products' },
  { labelFa: 'تغذیه و سلامت', labelEn: 'NUTRITION', href: '/recipes' },
];

export function ContactBar({ channels }: ContactBarProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close on outside click or Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <div className="relative z-50 bg-[#24150C] border-b border-[#3D2517]/80 text-white select-none">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex items-center justify-between h-9">
        {/* Subtitle / Brand Tagline */}
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-[#E8E2D9]/85 font-medium">
          <span className="font-bold text-[#FBBF24]">عسل باباخُرم</span>
          <span className="text-white/40">•</span>
          <span>شهد خالص کوهستان‌های ارسباران و سبلان</span>
        </div>

        {/* The Exact honey.com Tab (image_2fca16 & image_2fcd06) */}
        <div className="relative" ref={containerRef}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
            aria-haspopup="true"
            aria-label="منوی همکاران تجاری و راه‌های ارتباطی"
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-black tracking-wider transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#F59E0B] ${

'use client';

/**
 * Contact Map & Route Buttons Component (Phase 10 Tasks 3 & 4)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Lazy-loaded on scroll or tap (does not block LCP).
 * - OpenStreetMap tiles via env-configurable tile URL.
 * - Self-hosted / zero external CDN dependency.
 * - Marker placed at coordinates from settings.
 * - Static fallback card if tiles fail, offline, or JS is off.
 * - Route buttons below map: universal geo:, Google Maps, Waze, Neshan, Balad.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MapPin, Navigation, ExternalLink, RefreshCw, AlertTriangle, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';

export interface ContactMapProps {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  zoom?: number;
  siteNameFa: string;
  address: string;
  workingHours?: string | null;
  tileUrl?: string;
}

export function ContactMap({
  latitude,
  longitude,
  zoom = 14,
  siteNameFa,
  address,
  workingHours,
  tileUrl = 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',
}: ContactMapProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);
  const [currentZoom, setCurrentZoom] = useState(zoom);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Lazy loading via IntersectionObserver
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current || isLoaded) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          setIsLoaded(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '200px' }
    );

    observer.observe(containerRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [isLoaded]);

  // Close modal on Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setIsModalOpen(false);
    };
    if (isModalOpen) {
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isModalOpen]);

  // Major 4 Routing Options
  const routingApps = [
    {
      name: 'نشان (Neshan)',
      desc: 'مسیریاب و نقشه ایرانی نشان',
      url: `https://nshn.ir/?lat=${latitude}&lng=${longitude}`,
      iconText: 'نشان',
      badgeClass: 'bg-[#00A859] text-white',
    },
    {
      name: 'بلد (Balad)',
      desc: 'نقشه و مسیریاب هوشمند بلد',
      url: `https://balad.ir/location?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}`,
      iconText: 'بلد',
      badgeClass: 'bg-[#2E5BFF] text-white',
    },
    {
      name: 'گوگل مپ (Google Maps)',
      desc: 'Google Maps Navigation',
      url: `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${latitude},${longitude}`,
      iconText: 'Google',
      badgeClass: 'bg-[#EA4335] text-white',
    },
    {
      name: 'ویز (Waze)',
      desc: 'Waze GPS Navigation & Traffic',
      url: `https://waze.com/ul?ll=${latitude},${longitude}&navigate=yes`,
      iconText: 'Waze',
      badgeClass: 'bg-[#33CCFF] text-[#2B2017]',
    },
  ];

  // Slippy map tile calculations
  const lon2tile = (lon: number, z: number) => Math.floor(((lon + 180) / 360) * Math.pow(2, z));
  const lat2tile = (lat: number, z: number) =>
    Math.floor(
      ((1 -
        Math.log(Math.tan((lat * Math.PI) / 180) + 1 / Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180)) / Math.PI) /
        2) *
        Math.pow(2, z)
    );

  const centerTileX = lon2tile(longitude, currentZoom);
  const centerTileY = lat2tile(latitude, currentZoom);

  // 3x3 tile grid around center
  const tiles: Array<{ x: number; y: number; offsetX: number; offsetY: number }> = [];
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      tiles.push({
        x: centerTileX + dx,
        y: centerTileY + dy,
        offsetX: dx * 256,
        offsetY: dy * 256,
      });
    }
  }

  const getTileUrl = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
    return tileUrl.replace('{z}', String(z)).replace('{x}', String(x)).replace('{y}', String(y));
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="space-y-6">
      {/* Map Display Container: Warm Ivory Frame */}
      <div className="relative w-full h-80 sm:h-96 bg-[#FAF7F2] border-2 border-[#EFE9E0] overflow-hidden shadow-md rounded-none">
        {!isLoaded ? (
          /* Click or Scroll to Load Trigger */
          <div
            onClick={() => setIsLoaded(true)}
            className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 p-6 text-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#FFFBEB] transition-colors"
          >
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#FEF3C7] border border-[#F59E0B] flex items-center justify-center text-[#D97706] shadow-2xs">
              <MapPin className="w-6 h-6 animate-bounce" />
            </div>
            <p className="font-black text-[#2B2017] text-base">
              بارگذاری نقشه تعاملی موقعیت مکانی
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#786455] max-w-sm font-medium">
              برای مشاهده نقشه و مسیریابی لمس کنید یا به پایین اسکرول نمایید.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : hasError ? (
          /* Static Fallback Card (if tiles fail or network offline) */
          <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center space-y-3 bg-[#FAF7F2]">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-10 h-10 text-[#D97706]" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#2B2017]">
              کارت موقعیت مکانی دفتر عسل باباخُرم
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#5C5248] max-w-md leading-relaxed font-medium">
              {address}
            </p>
            <div className="text-xs text-[#B45309] font-mono font-bold" dir="ltr">
              {latitude.toFixed(4)}° N, {longitude.toFixed(4)}° E
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#786455]">
              (امکان بارگذاری تصویر نقشه وجود نداشت؛ لطفاً از دکمه‌های مسیریابی زیر استفاده فرمایید.)
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Interactive Tile Container */
          <div className="w-full h-full relative overflow-hidden bg-stone-100 select-none">
            {/* 3x3 Tile Grid */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
              <div className="relative w-[768px] h-[768px]">
                {tiles.map((t) => (
                  <img
                    key={`${t.x}_${t.y}_${currentZoom}`}
                    src={getTileUrl(t.x, t.y, currentZoom)}
                    alt=""
                    onError={() => setHasError(true)}
                    className="absolute w-[256px] h-[256px] object-cover"
                    style={{
                      left: `calc(50% + ${t.offsetX - 128}px)`,
                      top: `calc(50% + ${t.offsetY - 128}px)`,
                    }}
                  />
                ))}

            </div>

            {/* Central Marker */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none z-10">
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center -translate-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
                <div className="px-3 py-1 bg-[#2B2017] border border-[#FBBF24] text-[#FBBF24] font-black text-xs shadow-lg mb-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                  {siteNameFa}

            </div>

            {/* Zoom Controls */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-20 flex flex-col gap-1 shadow-md">

                onClick={() => setCurrentZoom((z) => Math.min(18, z + 1))}

/**
 * HamburgerDrawer Component (Adaptive: Categories on Desktop, Navigation on Mobile)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * 1. Mobile (< lg):
 *    - Displays ONLY the main header navigation options:
 *      صفحه اصلی | محصولات | دستورها و دسرها | تماس با ما | انتقادات و پیشنهادات | جستجو
 *    - Does NOT display the categories lists on mobile.
 * 2. Desktop (lg:):
 *    - Preserves classic state: displays category sections:
 *      "محصولات ما" (with link to /products and active product categories)
 *      "دسرهای عسل" (with link to /recipes and active recipe categories)
 *    - Header title: "دسته‌بندی‌های عسل باباخُرم"
 * 3. Accessibility & Animation:
 *    - Full RTL support with backdrop, scroll-lock, focus trap, and Escape key handling.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  X,
  Home,
  ShoppingBag,
  UtensilsCrossed,
  Phone,
  MessageSquareQuote,
  Search,
  ChevronLeft,
  Sparkles,
  Utensils,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface CategoryNavItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  type: 'PRODUCT' | 'RECIPE';
}

interface HamburgerDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenSearch?: () => void;
  productCategories?: CategoryNavItem[];
  recipeCategories?: CategoryNavItem[];
  triggerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
}

export function HamburgerDrawer({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenSearch,
  productCategories = [],
  recipeCategories = [],
  triggerRef,
}: HamburgerDrawerProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const drawerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  // Body Scroll Lock & Initial Focus
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => {
        closeButtonRef.current?.focus();
      }, 50);
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Focus Trap & Escape Key Handler
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (!isOpen) return;

      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
        triggerRef?.current?.focus();
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'Tab' && drawerRef.current) {
        const focusableElements = drawerRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
          'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
        );
        if (focusableElements.length === 0) return;

        const firstElement = focusableElements[0];
        const lastElement = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];

        if (e.shiftKey) {
          if (document.activeElement === firstElement) {
            e.preventDefault();
            lastElement.focus();
          }
        } else {
          if (document.activeElement === lastElement) {
            e.preventDefault();
            firstElement.focus();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose, triggerRef]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const mobileNavItems = [
    {
      href: '/',
      label: 'صفحه اصلی',
      icon: Home,
      description: 'خانه، معرفی و گزیده محصولات و مقالات',
    },
    {
      href: '/products',
      label: 'محصولات',
      icon: ShoppingBag,
      description: 'انواع عسل‌های طبیعی و خام کوهستان',
    },
    {
      href: '/recipes',
      label: 'دستورها و دسرها',
      icon: UtensilsCrossed,
      description: 'ترکیبات، نوشیدنی‌ها و دسرهای خوش‌طعم',
    },
    {
      href: '/contact',
      label: 'تماس با ما',
      icon: Phone,
      description: 'راه‌های ارتباطی، دفتر مرکزی و نقشه',
    },
    {
      href: '/feedback',
      label: 'انتقادات و پیشنهادات',
      icon: MessageSquareQuote,
      description: 'ثبت نظر، پیگیری و صدای مشتریان',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-start"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="منوی سایت"
    >
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity duration-300 ease-out"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {/* Drawer Container (Right side in RTL) */}
      <div
        ref={drawerRef}
        className="relative w-[85vw] sm:w-[380px] max-w-md h-full bg-[#FDFBF8] text-[#2B2017] shadow-2xl z-10 flex flex-col overflow-hidden animate-in slide-in-from-right duration-300 ease-out border-l border-[#EFE9E0] rounded-none"
      >
        {/* Drawer Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-5 border-b border-[#EFE9E0] bg-white">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-none bg-[#F59E0B] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black shadow-xs">
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M12 2L4 6.5V17.5L12 22L20 17.5V6.5L12 2ZM12 4.3L18 7.7V16.3L12 19.7L6 16.3V7.7L12 4.3ZM12 7L8 9.3V14.7L12 17L16 14.7V9.3L12 7Z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <span className="font-black text-lg text-[#2B2017]">
              <span className="lg:hidden">منوی اصلی</span>
              <span className="hidden lg:inline">دسته‌بندی‌های عسل باباخُرم</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            ref={closeButtonRef}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onClose();
              triggerRef?.current?.focus();
            }}

            className="p-2 text-[#5C5248] hover:text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-none transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#F59E0B] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/*

          {mobileNavItems.map((item) => {

            return (

'use client';

/**
 * Header Cart Icon (Phase 9 Task 4)
 * Client island displaying the cart link and dynamic item count badge.
 * Renders nothing if cartEnabled is false.
 */

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { ShoppingCart } from 'lucide-react';
import { useCartStore } from '@/lib/cart-store';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';

export function HeaderCartIcon({ cartEnabled }: { cartEnabled: boolean }) {
  const { totalQuantity } = useCartStore();

  if (!cartEnabled) {
    return null;
  }

  const displayCount =
    totalQuantity > 99 ? '+۹۹' : toPersianDigits(totalQuantity);

  return (
    <Link
      href="/cart"
      aria-label={`سبد خرید${totalQuantity > 0 ? ` (${toPersianDigits(totalQuantity)} مورد)` : ''}`}
      className="relative p-2.5 rounded-none text-white hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white"
    >
      <ShoppingCart className="w-5 h-5 text-white drop-shadow-sm" />
      {totalQuantity > 0 && (
        <span
          className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 min-w-[20px] h-5 px-1 bg-[#D97706] text-white text-[11px] font-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ring-2 ring-white shadow-sm pointer-events-none"
        >
          {displayCount}
        </span>
      )}
    </Link>
  );
}

interface HeaderProps {
  siteNameFa: string;
  cartEnabled: boolean;
  channels?: PublicChannelItem[];

  onOpenHamburger: () => void;
  hamburgerButtonRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
