export function Header({
  siteNameFa,
  cartEnabled,
  channels = [],
  onOpenSearch,
  onOpenHamburger,
  hamburgerButtonRef,
}: HeaderProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [isContactOpen, setIsContactOpen] = useState(false);
  const desktopContactRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mobileContactRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close contact menu on outside click or Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      const isInsideDesktop = desktopContactRef.current?.contains(target);
      const isInsideMobile = mobileContactRef.current?.contains(target);
      if (!isInsideDesktop && !isInsideMobile) {
        setIsContactOpen(false);
      }
    }
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isContactOpen) {
        setIsContactOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isContactOpen]);

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'صفحه اصلی' },
    { href: '/products', label: 'محصولات' },
    { href: '/recipes', label: 'دستورها و دسرها' },

  ];

  const contactListContent = (
    <div className="pt-1 pb-3 px-3 space-y-1 animate-in fade-in duration-150 border-t border-white/10">
      {/* Phone call link */}
      <a
        href="tel:09120000000"
        onClick={() => setIsContactOpen(false)}
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-black/25 hover:text-[#FBBF24] transition-colors rounded-none"

        </span>
      </a>

      {/* Messengers & Channels */}
      {channels && channels.length > 0 ? (
        channels.map((ch) => (
          <a
            key={ch.id}
            href={ch.url}
            target={ch.type === 'PHONE' ? undefined : '_blank'}
            rel={ch.type === 'PHONE' ? undefined : 'noopener noreferrer'}
            onClick={() => setIsContactOpen(false)}
            className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-black/25 hover:text-[#FBBF24] transition-colors rounded-none"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ChannelIcon type={ch.type} className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FBBF24]" />
              <span>{ch.label || ch.type}</span>
            </div>

          </a>
        ))
      ) : (
        <>
          <a
            href="https://wa.me/"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={() => setIsContactOpen(false)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-black/25 hover:text-[#FBBF24] transition-colors rounded-none"
          >
            <ChannelIcon type="WHATSAPP" className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#FBBF24]" />
            <span>پیام‌رسان واتساپ</span>
          </a>
          <a

          </a>

          >

            <span>کانال ایتا</span>

        </>

      <Link
        href="/contact"
        onClick={() => setIsContactOpen(false)}
        className="flex items-center px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-white hover:bg-black/25 hover:text-[#FBBF24] transition-colors rounded-none border-t border-white/10 mt-1"
      >
        <span>صفحه تماس و نقشه</span>
      </Link>
      <Link
        href="/feedback"
        onClick={() => setIsContactOpen(false)}

      >
        <span>انتقادات و پیشنهادات</span>
      </Link>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <header
      className="sticky top-0 z-40 text-white shadow-lg border-b border-[#B45309]/30 transition-all bg-[#F59E0B] bg-cover bg-center relative"

/**
 * HeroSlider Component (Authentic honey.com Fidelity)
 * Features:
 * - Slideshow rotating between high-resolution nature/honey images every 6-7 seconds.
 * - Smooth transition: image blurs and fades out, next image fades in with crisp focus.
 * - Continuous slow Ken Burns zoom animation.
 * - Strictly NO buttons in hero section.
 * - Indicator dots completely removed per user requirement.
 * - Accepts dynamic images, title, subtitle from CMS or defaults.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const DEFAULT_HERO_IMAGES = [
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_35.jpg',
    alt: 'شهد زرین و کندوهای عسل طبیعی باباخُرم',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_32.jpg',
    alt: 'مراتع سرسبز کوهستانی و زنبورداری سنتی',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_33.jpg',
    alt: 'زنبورداران پرتلاش و متعهد باباخُرم',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_34.jpg',
    alt: 'برداشت مستقیم عسل خالص از شان',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_36.jpg',
    alt: 'کلونی‌های فعال زنبور عسل در طبیعت بکر',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_37.jpg',
    alt: 'عسل کوهستان با بالاترین درجه خلوص و اصالت',
  },
  {
    src: '/images/hero/photo_38.jpg',
    alt: 'شهد ناب و طبیعی دامنه کوهستان',
  },
];

export interface HeroSliderProps {
  images?: Array<{ url?: string; src?: string; alt?: string }>;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
}

import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';

export function HeroSlider({
  images,
  title = 'عسل خالص و طبیعی باباخُرم',
  subtitle = 'برداشت مستقیم از بهترین مراتع ییلاقی ارسباران، با حفظ ۱۰۰٪ خواص زیستی و دارویی',
}: HeroSliderProps) {
  const slideImages =
    images && images.length > 0
      ? images.map((img) => ({
          src: img.url || img.src || '/images/hero/photo_35.jpg',
          alt: img.alt || title,
        }))
      : DEFAULT_HERO_IMAGES;

  const [currentSlide, setCurrentSlide] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (slideImages.length <= 1) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % slideImages.length);
    }, 6500);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [slideImages.length]);

  return (
    <section
      className="relative min-h-[520px] sm:min-h-[580px] lg:min-h-[640px] overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center text-center px-4 py-24 bg-[#2C1D11]"
      aria-labelledby="hero-heading"
    >
      {/* Background Images with Blur + Fade Out/In & Ken Burns Zoom */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        {slideImages.map((img, idx) => {
          const isActive = idx === currentSlide;
          return (
            <div
              key={`${img.src}-${idx}`}
              className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full transition-all duration-1000 ease-in-out ${
                isActive
                  ? 'opacity-100 blur-0 scale-100 z-1'
                  : 'opacity-0 blur-md scale-105 z-0'
              }`}
            >
              <img
                src={img.src}
                alt={img.alt}
                className="hero-bg-image absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-center"
                loading={idx === 0 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}
                width={1600}
                height={700}
              />
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Hero Content (Strictly Title, Subtitle, and Two Primary Buttons) */}
      <div className="relative z-20 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-white space-y-6 sm:space-y-8">
        <h1
          id="hero-heading"
          className="hero-title-white text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-black !text-white leading-tight tracking-tight"
          style={{
            color: '#ffffff',
            textShadow: '2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)',
          }}
        >
          {title}
        </h1>

        {subtitle && (
          <p
            className="hero-subtitle-white text-base sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl !text-white max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed font-bold"
            style={{
              color: '#ffffff',
              textShadow: '2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)',
            }}
          >
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        )}

        {/* Call to action buttons */}
        <div className="pt-2 sm:pt-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4">
          <PillButton variant="gold" size="lg" href="/products" className="shadow-2xl font-black text-base px-8 py-3.5">
            خرید عسل طبیعی و خام
          </PillButton>
          <PillButton variant="orange" size="lg" href="/recipes" className="font-bold text-base px-6 py-3.5 shadow-xl">
            دستورهای اختصاصی عسل
          </PillButton>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { useCartStore } from '@/lib/cart-store';
import { ShoppingCart, Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface MobileStickyBuyBarProps {
  productId: string;
  productName: string;
  isAvailable: boolean;
  cartEnabled: boolean;
  defaultOptionId?: string;
}

export function MobileStickyBuyBar({
  productId,
  productName,
  isAvailable,
  cartEnabled,
  defaultOptionId,
}: MobileStickyBuyBarProps) {
  const { actions } = useCartStore();
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
  const [added, setAdded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      // Reveal sticky bar after user scrolls down 350px
      if (window.scrollY > 350) {
        setIsVisible(true);
      } else {
        setIsVisible(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  if (!isAvailable || !cartEnabled || !isVisible) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleBuy = () => {
    const optId = defaultOptionId || `opt_${productId}_1kg`;
    const res = actions.addItem({
      productId,
      optionId: optId,
      qty: 1,
    });

    if (res.success) {
      setAdded(true);
      setTimeout(() => setAdded(false), 2500);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="sm:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-[#23150B]/95 border-t-2 border-[#F59E0B] p-3 shadow-[0_-10px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300">
      <div className="text-right truncate flex-1 min-w-0 pr-1">
        <div className="text-xs font-black text-[#FFFBEB] truncate">
          {productName}
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-[#FBBF24] font-bold">
          {added ? '✓ به سبد اضافه شد' : '۱۰۰٪ طبیعی و دارای برگه آزمایش'}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="shrink-0">
        <PillButton
          variant="gold"
          size="sm"
          onClick={handleBuy}
          className="font-black text-xs px-4 py-2.5 shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5"
        >
          {added ? (
            <>
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-950" />
              <span>ثبت شد</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>افزودن به سبد</span>
            </>
          )}
        </PillButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

/**
 * Order Share View Component (Phase 9 Task 8 & Addendum A4)
 * Client component for /o/[code] page.
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { WoodBackground } from '@/components/ui/wood-background';
import { Container } from '@/components/ui/container';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { Copy, Check, ExternalLink, Clock, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ChannelType } from '@prisma/client';

export interface OrderShareViewProps {
  orderCode: string;
  messageText: string;
  channelType: ChannelType;
  channelValue: string;
  directUrl: string;
  expiresAt: string; // ISO string
}

const CHANNEL_NAMES: Record<ChannelType, string> = {
  PHONE: 'پیامک (SMS)',
  WHATSAPP: 'واتساپ',
  TELEGRAM: 'تلگرام',
  EITAA: 'ایتا',
  BALE: 'بله',
  RUBIKA: 'روبیکا',
  INSTAGRAM: 'اینستاگرام',
};

export function OrderShareView({
  orderCode,
  messageText,
  channelType,
  channelValue,
  directUrl,
  expiresAt,
}: OrderShareViewProps) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(messageText);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 3000);
    } catch {
      // Fallback for older browsers
      const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
      textarea.value = messageText;
      document.body.appendChild(textarea);
      textarea.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textarea);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  const channelName = CHANNEL_NAMES[channelType] || 'پیام‌رسان';

  return (
    <WoodBackground className="py-12 sm:py-20 min-h-screen">
      <Container size="narrow" className="space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="inline-block px-3 py-1 bg-[#FBBF24]/20 border border-[#FBBF24]/40 text-[#FBBF24] text-xs font-bold rounded-full">
            ارسال سفارش تلفن همراه
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-white">
            سفارش عسل باباخُرم
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#E8E2D9]">
            کد پیگیری سفارش:{' '}
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#FBBF24]">{orderCode}</span>
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Expiry Warning Notice */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-[#FFFBEB] border border-[#FDE68A] text-[#92400E] text-xs justify-center shadow-xs rounded-none font-bold">
          <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D97706] shrink-0" />
          <span>اعتبار این صفحه موقت بوده و تا ۳۰ دقیقه پس از صدور منقضی خواهد شد.</span>
        </div>

        {/* Order Message Box: Warm Ivory Artisan Sheet */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-[#FDE68A] p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 shadow-xl rounded-none text-right">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#2B2017] border-b border-[#EFE9E0] pb-2.5">
            <span className="font-black text-sm">متن آماده سفارش ({channelName}):</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#D97706] hover:text-[#B45309] font-black transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>کپی شد!</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>کپی متن</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          <pre
            className="w-full max-h-80 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#2B2017] leading-relaxed bg-[#FAF7F2] p-4 border border-[#EFE9E0] select-all rounded-none font-medium"
            dir="rtl"
          >
            {messageText}
          </pre>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 pt-2">
          {directUrl && directUrl !== '#' && (
            <a
              href={directUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-3.5 rounded-full bg-[#15803D] hover:bg-[#166534] text-white font-black text-sm sm:text-base shadow-lg transition-all"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="w-5 h-5" />
              <span>ارسال در {channelName}</span>

            size="lg"

            className="w-full sm:w-auto justify-center font-black"
          >
            {copied ? 'متن کپی شد' : 'کپی مجدد متن سفارش'}

export function ProductCarousel({

    if (N === 0) return [];

    const repeatCount = N < 6 ? 3 : 2;
    for (let k = 0; k < repeatCount; k++) {
      products.forEach((p, idx) => {
        list.push({ ...p, key: `${p.id || p.slug}-${k}-${idx}` });
      });
    }
    return list;

  const slideNext = useCallback(() => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
    const card = el.querySelector('article');
    const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
    el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? -step : step, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  const slidePrev = useCallback(() => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
    const card = el.querySelector('article');
    const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
    el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? step : -step, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

      const el = scrollContainerRef.current;

      const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
      const card = el.querySelector('article');
      const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
      const maxScroll = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
      const currentScroll = Math.abs(el.scrollLeft);

      if (currentScroll >= maxScroll - 25) {
        el.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      } else {
        el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? -step : step, behavior: 'smooth' });

  }, [isPaused, N]);

        className="relative flex items-center px-2 sm:px-12"
        onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
        onTouchStart={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onTouchEnd={() => setIsPaused(false)}
      >
        {/* RTL Prev Button (Right side) - Hidden on mobile, visible on tablet/desktop */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={slidePrev}
          aria-label="محصول قبلی"

        </button>

import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { loadMoreProductsAction } from '@/server/actions/listing-actions';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import type { ProductCardViewModel, ProductCursor } from '@/server/queries/products';

export interface CategoryItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
}

export interface ProductsListingClientProps {
  initialItems: ProductCardViewModel[];
  initialCursor: ProductCursor | null;
  initialHasMore: boolean;
  totalCount: number;
  categories: CategoryItem[];
  selectedCategorySlug?: string;
  initialQuery?: string;
}

// Module-level client in-memory cache for instant filter restoration (Priority 5)
const productListingCache = new Map<string, { items: ProductCardViewModel[]; cursor: ProductCursor | null; hasMore: boolean }>();

export function ProductsListingClient({
  initialItems,
  initialCursor,
  initialHasMore,
  totalCount,
  categories,
  selectedCategorySlug = '',
  initialQuery = '',
}: ProductsListingClientProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState(selectedCategorySlug);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ProductCardViewModel[]>(initialItems);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<ProductCursor | null>(initialCursor);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(initialHasMore);
  const [isLoadingMore, setIsLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const initialBatchCount = 12;

  // Sync state when server props update
  useEffect(() => {
    setItems(initialItems);
    setCursor(initialCursor);
    setHasMore(initialHasMore);
    setActiveCategory(selectedCategorySlug);
    setErrorMessage(null);
  }, [initialItems, initialCursor, initialHasMore, selectedCategorySlug]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchTerm(initialQuery);
  }, [initialQuery]);

  // Save to client cache on receive
  useEffect(() => {
    const cacheKey = activeCategory || 'all';
    if (items.length > 0 && !searchTerm) {
      productListingCache.set(cacheKey, { items, cursor, hasMore });
    }
  }, [items, cursor, hasMore, activeCategory, searchTerm]);


  // URL sync helper
  const updateUrlParams = (newCategory?: string, newQ?: string) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams?.toString() ?? '');

    const cat = newCategory !== undefined ? newCategory : activeCategory;
    const q = newQ !== undefined ? newQ : searchTerm;

    if (cat && cat !== 'all' && cat !== 'همه') {
      params.set('category', cat);
    } else {
      params.delete('category');
    }

    if (q && q.trim().length > 0) {
      params.set('q', q.trim());
    } else {
      params.delete('q');
    }

    startTransition(() => {
      const queryString = params.toString();
      router.push(`/products${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`);
    });
  };

  // Debounced search input sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchTerm === initialQuery) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      updateUrlParams(undefined, searchTerm);
    }, 300);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  const handleCategoryClick = (categorySlug: string) => {
    setActiveCategory(categorySlug);
    const cacheKey = categorySlug || 'all';
    if (productListingCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      const cached = productListingCache.get(cacheKey)!;
      setItems(cached.items);
      setCursor(cached.cursor);
      setHasMore(cached.hasMore);
    }
    updateUrlParams(categorySlug, undefined);
  };

  const handleClearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
    updateUrlParams(undefined, '');
  };

  // Load More: fetches next batch and strictly prevents duplicates
  const handleLoadMore = async () => {
    if (isLoadingMore || !hasMore) return;

    setIsLoadingMore(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await loadMoreProductsAction({
        categorySlug: activeCategory || undefined,
        q: searchTerm.trim() || undefined,
        cursor,
        skip: items.length,
        take: initialBatchCount,
      });

      if (res.success && res.items) {
        setItems((prev) => {
          // Strictly deduplicate by id
          const existingIds = new Set(prev.map((x) => x.id));
          const newItems = res.items!.filter((x) => !existingIds.has(x.id));
          if (newItems.length === 0 || !res.hasMore) {
            setHasMore(false);
          } else {
            setHasMore(Boolean(res.hasMore));
          }
          return [...prev, ...newItems];
        });
        setCursor(res.nextCursor ?? null);
      } else {
        setHasMore(false);
        if (res.error) setErrorMessage(res.error);
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('خطای ارتباط با سرور.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  // Show Less: collapses back to initial batch and smoothly scrolls up
  const handleShowLess = () => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.slice(0, initialBatchCount));
    setHasMore(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 200, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const [inStockOnly, setInStockOnly] = useState(false);

  // Client-side instant filter to guarantee search and category filtering work 100% of the time
  const displayedItems = useMemo(() => {
    let list = items;

    if (inStockOnly) {
      list = list.filter((item) => item.isAvailable !== false);
    }

    if (activeCategory && activeCategory !== 'all' && activeCategory !== 'همه') {
      list = list.filter((item: any) => {
        if (item.categorySlug === activeCategory) return true;
        if (item.categories && item.categories.some((c: any) => c.slug === activeCategory || c.category?.slug === activeCategory)) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }

    const q = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      list = list.filter((item) => {
        const text = `${item.title} ${item.subtitle || ''} ${item.nameFa || ''} ${item.nameOriginal || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        return text.includes(q);
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [items, activeCategory, searchTerm, inStockOnly]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10 sm:space-y-14">
      {/* 1. Scoped Search & Category Filter Bar */}
      <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <div className="relative max-w-lg mx-auto">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="جستجو در محصولات باباخُرم..."
            className="w-full h-12 pr-11 pl-10 rounded-none bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#3F2A1D] placeholder-[#7A6553] text-sm sm:text-base focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D9A441]/40 focus:border-[#C58A2A] transition-all shadow-xs"
            dir="rtl"
          />
          <Search className="absolute right-4 top-3.5 w-5 h-5 text-[#C58A2A] pointer-events-none" />
          {searchTerm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClearSearch}
              className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-[#7A6553] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="پاک کردن جستجو"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Category Chips: Horizontal Scroll on Mobile + Wrap on Desktop (UX-05) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1 px-1 sm:flex-wrap sm:justify-center">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleCategoryClick('')}
            className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-1.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-2 rounded-none text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              !activeCategory || activeCategory === 'all'
                ? 'bg-[#D9A441] text-[#2E1F14] border border-[#C58A2A] shadow-md ring-2 ring-[#D9A441]/30 font-black'
                : 'bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#5C3A21] border border-[#DFD3C3] hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] hover:border-[#C58A2A]/50 font-bold'
            }`}
          >
            همه محصولات
          </button>
          {categories.map((cat) => (
            <button
              key={cat.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleCategoryClick(cat.slug)}
              className={`shrink-0 px-4 py-1.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-2 rounded-none text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                activeCategory === cat.slug
                  ? 'bg-[#D9A441] text-[#2E1F14] border border-[#C58A2A] shadow-md ring-2 ring-[#D9A441]/30 font-black'
                  : 'bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#5C3A21] border border-[#DFD3C3] hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] hover:border-[#C58A2A]/50 font-bold'
              }`}
            >
              {cat.name}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* In-Stock Only Toggle (UX-05) */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center pt-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setInStockOnly((prev) => !prev)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-none text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              inStockOnly
                ? 'bg-[#3F7E3C] text-white border-transparent shadow-md ring-2 ring-[#3F7E3C]/30'
                : 'bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#5C3A21] border border-[#DFD3C3] hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] shadow-xs'
            }`}
          >
            <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${inStockOnly ? 'bg-emerald-300 animate-pulse' : 'bg-stone-400'}`} />
            <span>فقط کالاهای موجود در انبار</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Results Container */}
      {isPending && displayedItems.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-[#5C3A21]">
          <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-[#C58A2A]" />
          <span className="text-sm font-bold">در حال جستجو و فیلتر...</span>
        </div>
      ) : displayedItems.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-20 text-center space-y-4 max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] p-8 shadow-sm">
          <p className="text-xl font-black text-[#3F2A1D]">موردی یافت نشد</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C3A21] leading-relaxed">
            محصولی با مشخصات جستجوشده یافت نشد. لطفاً عبارت دیگری را جستجو کنید یا فیلتر دسته‌بندی را تغییر دهید.
          </p>
          {(searchTerm || activeCategory) && (
            <div className="pt-2">
              <PillButton
                variant="gold"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchTerm('');
                  setActiveCategory('');
                  updateUrlParams('', '');
                }}
              >
                مشاهده همه محصولات
              </PillButton>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-12">
          {/* Desktop & Tablet: 3-column card grid (Brief Section 9) */}
          <div className="hidden sm:grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8">
            {displayedItems.map((item, idx) => (
              <ContentCard
                key={"desk-" + item.id}
                title={item.title}
                subtitle={item.subtitle}
                href={item.href}
                imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                imageUrl={item.imageUrl || (item.slug ? `/images/products/${item.slug}.jpg` : (item.imageAsset ? null : '/images/honey-jar.jpg'))}
                theme={item.theme || item.cardTheme}
                slug={item.slug}
                isAvailable={item.isAvailable}
                linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                variant="vertical"
                index={idx}
                sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Mobile (< sm): One item per row with horizontal card variant (Brief Section 9) */}
          <div className="sm:hidden space-y-3.5">
            {displayedItems.map((item, idx) => (
              <ContentCard
                key={"mob-" + item.id}
                title={item.title}
                subtitle={item.subtitle}
                href={item.href}
                imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                imageUrl={item.imageUrl || (item.slug ? `/images/products/${item.slug}.jpg` : (item.imageAsset ? null : '/images/honey-jar.jpg'))}
                theme={item.theme || item.cardTheme}
                slug={item.slug}
                isAvailable={item.isAvailable}
                linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                variant="horizontal"
                index={idx}
                sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Error Message */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-900/60 border border-red-500 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm text-center max-w-md mx-auto">
              {errorMessage}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 3. Load More / Show Less Controls (Per User Requirement) */}
          <div className="text-center pt-6 space-y-3">
            {hasMore ? (
              /* Button: نمایش بیشتر */
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLoadMore}
                disabled={isLoadingMore}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#D9A441] hover:bg-[#C58A2A] text-[#2E1F14] hover:text-white font-black text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isLoadingMore ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>در حال بارگذاری...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span>نمایش بیشتر</span>
                )}
              </button>
            ) : items.length > initialBatchCount ? (
              /* Button: نمایش کمتر (Replaces نمایش بیشتر when all items are shown) */
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleShowLess}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#FAF6EE] hover:bg-[#F2ECE0] text-[#5C3A21] border border-[#DFD3C3] font-black text-sm sm:text-base transition-all duration-200 shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ChevronUp className="w-5 h-5 text-[#C58A2A]" />
                <span>نمایش کمتر</span>
              </button>
            ) : null}

            {!hasMore && items.length > 0 && (
              <div className="text-center text-xs text-[#5C3A21] pt-2 font-bold">
                تمام موارد نمایش داده شد ({toPersianDigits(items.length)} محصول)
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * RecipeCarousel Component (Infinite Looping, Mobile-Responsive & Touch-Friendly)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Seamless infinite looping: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 without resetting/jumping back.
 * - Auto-scroll: advances 1 card every 5 seconds continuously, pauses on hover and touch.
 * - Dynamic card step measurement for pixel-perfect card alignment on all screen widths.
 * - Touch swipe support (left/right swipe) for mobile devices.
 * - Responsive card width (w-[270px] on mobile to w-[340px] on desktop) with zero horizontal overflow.
 * - Four card themes: green, orange, yellow (dark text), burgundy, and AUTO (hashed from slug).
 * - Uniform fixed dimensions matching ProductCarousel (240px image height on desktop, object-cover).
 * - Link label with three dots only (LOCKED: NO ARROW / CHEVRON).
 * - Optional noBackground prop to allow seamless merging inside WoodGroup.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { WoodBackground } from '@/components/ui/wood-background';
import { Container } from '@/components/ui/container';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { getCardThemeForSlug, getBalancedCardTheme, resolveItemCardTheme } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';

interface RecipeItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  slug: string;
  imageUrl?: string;
  theme?: string;
  cardTheme?: string;
  sortOrder?: number;
}

const THEME_CLASSES: Record<string, { bg: string; text: string }> = {
  GREEN: { bg: 'bg-[#4CA849]', text: 'text-white' },
  ORANGE: { bg: 'bg-[#E08B38]', text: 'text-white' },
  YELLOW: { bg: 'bg-[#F5A623]', text: 'text-[#2B2017]' },
  BURGUNDY: { bg: 'bg-[#9E3556]', text: 'text-white' },
  green: { bg: 'bg-[#4CA849]', text: 'text-white' },
  orange: { bg: 'bg-[#E08B38]', text: 'text-white' },
  yellow: { bg: 'bg-[#F5A623]', text: 'text-[#2B2017]' },
  burgundy: { bg: 'bg-[#9E3556]', text: 'text-white' },
};

import { DottedArrowIcon } from '@/components/ui/dotted-arrow-icon';

export function RecipeCarousel({
  recipes,
  noBackground = false,
}: {
  recipes: RecipeItem[];
  noBackground?: boolean;
}) {
  const N = recipes.length;
  const scrollContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);

  // Repeat items if small set to allow generous continuous scroll
  const displayItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (N === 0) return [];
    const list: Array<RecipeItem & { key: string }> = [];
    const repeatCount = N < 6 ? 3 : 2;
    for (let k = 0; k < repeatCount; k++) {
      recipes.forEach((r, idx) => {
        list.push({ ...r, key: `${r.id || r.slug}-${k}-${idx}` });
      });
    }
    return list;
  }, [recipes, N]);

  const slideNext = useCallback(() => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
    const card = el.querySelector('article');
    const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
    el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? -step : step, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  const slidePrev = useCallback(() => {
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
    const card = el.querySelector('article');
    const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
    el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? step : -step, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  // Continuous auto-advance on desktop when not interacting
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPaused || N === 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const isRtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
      const card = el.querySelector('article');
      const step = card ? card.offsetWidth + 16 : 286;
      const maxScroll = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
      const currentScroll = Math.abs(el.scrollLeft);

      if (currentScroll >= maxScroll - 25) {
        el.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      } else {
        el.scrollBy({ left: isRtl ? -step : step, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }, 5000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [isPaused, N]);

  if (N === 0) return null;

  const content = (
    <Container>
      {/* Section Header with Warm Ivory Title and Cream Subtitle */}
      <div className="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-10 sm:mb-16 space-y-3 px-2">
        <h2
          id="recipes-heading"
          className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black text-[#FFFBEB] drop-shadow-md tracking-tight"
        >
          ترکیبات و دسرهای سلامت‌بخش
        </h2>
        <p className="text-[#E5D5C5] font-bold text-sm sm:text-base lg:text-lg">
          دستورهای غذایی سنتی، معجون‌ها و نوشیدنی‌های شگفت‌انگیز با طعم اصیل عسل
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Carousel Outer Wrapper */}
      <div
        className="relative flex items-center px-2 sm:px-12"
        onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
        onTouchStart={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onTouchEnd={() => setIsPaused(false)}
      >
        {/* RTL Prev Button (Right side) - Hidden on mobile, visible on tablet/desktop */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={slidePrev}
          aria-label="دستور قبلی"
          className="hidden sm:flex absolute right-2 sm:right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-30 w-11 h-11 sm:w-12 sm:h-12 rounded-full bg-white text-[#332115] shadow-2xl items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer border border-[#EFE9E0] hover:bg-[#FBBF24] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" />
        </button>

        {/* Viewport: Native Hardware-Accelerated CSS Scroll-Snap Container */}
        <div
          ref={scrollContainerRef}
          className="w-full overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth no-scrollbar py-4 px-[calc(50vw-135px)] xs:px-[calc(50vw-145px)] sm:px-4 flex gap-4 sm:gap-6 will-change-scroll"
          style={{
            scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory',
            WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
            scrollbarWidth: 'none',
            msOverflowStyle: 'none',
          }}
        >
          {displayItems.map((r, idx) => {
            const themeKey = resolveItemCardTheme({ ...r, index: idx });
            const theme = THEME_CLASSES[themeKey] || THEME_CLASSES.GREEN;

            return (
              <article
                key={r.key}
                className="shrink-0 w-[270px] xs:w-[290px] sm:w-[320px] md:w-[340px] snap-center rounded-none overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-black/10 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1.5 hover:shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(51,33,21,0.24)] group cursor-pointer bg-white flex flex-col"
                style={{
                  scrollSnapAlign: 'center',
                  scrollSnapStop: 'always',
                }}
              >
                <Link href={`/recipes/${r.slug}`} className="flex flex-col h-full">
                  {/* Image Wrap - Balanced aspect ratio with clean borders */}
                  <div className="w-full aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden shrink-0 relative">
                    <img
                      src={r.imageUrl || `/images/recipe-${((idx % 6) + 1)}.jpg`}
                      alt={r.title}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-105"
                      loading="lazy"
                      width={360}
                      height={270}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Content Wrap */}
                  <div
                    className={`p-5 sm:p-6 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between ${theme.bg} ${theme.text}`}
                  >
                    <h3 className="font-black text-base sm:text-xl leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                      {r.title}
                    </h3>

                    <div className="mt-4 sm:mt-6 pt-3 border-t border-black/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs sm:text-sm font-black">
                      <span>مشاهده دستور پخت</span>
                      <DottedArrowIcon direction="left" className="w-4 h-4 transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:-translate-x-2" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* RTL Next Button (Left side) - Hidden on mobile, visible on tablet/desktop */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={slideNext}
          aria-label="دستور بعدی"
          className="hidden sm:flex absolute left-2 sm:left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-30 w-11 h-11 sm:w-12 sm:h-12 rounded-full bg-white text-[#332115] shadow-2xl items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer border border-[#EFE9E0] hover:bg-[#FBBF24] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" />
        </button>
      </div>

'use client';

/**
 * RecipesListingClient Component
 * Features:
 * - Scoped search with instant filtering and URL sync.
 * - Category filter chips and Cold/Hot serving filter.
 * - Dynamic pagination: "نمایش بیشتر" loads additional unique items without duplicates.
 * - When all items are shown, "نمایش بیشتر" disappears and "نمایش کمتر" appears (per user request).
 * - Clicking "نمایش کمتر" collapses back to the initial page and scrolls smoothly up.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useTransition, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Search, Loader2, X, ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { ContentCard } from '@/components/ui/content-card';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { loadMoreRecipesAction } from '@/server/actions/listing-actions';
import { toPersianDigits, matchesServingFilter } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import type { RecipeCardViewModel, RecipeCursor } from '@/server/queries/recipes';

export interface CategoryItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
}

export interface RecipesListingClientProps {
  initialItems: RecipeCardViewModel[];
  initialCursor: RecipeCursor | null;
  initialHasMore: boolean;
  totalCount: number;
  categories: CategoryItem[];
  selectedCategorySlug?: string;
  selectedServing?: 'cold' | 'hot';
  initialQuery?: string;
}

// Module-level client in-memory cache for instant filter restoration (Priority 5)
const recipeListingCache = new Map<string, { items: RecipeCardViewModel[]; cursor: RecipeCursor | null; hasMore: boolean }>();

export function RecipesListingClient({
  initialItems,
  initialCursor,
  initialHasMore,
  totalCount,
  categories,
  selectedCategorySlug = '',
  selectedServing = 'cold',
  initialQuery = '',
}: RecipesListingClientProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState(selectedCategorySlug);
  const [serving, setServing] = useState<'cold' | 'hot'>(selectedServing);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<RecipeCardViewModel[]>(initialItems);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<RecipeCursor | null>(initialCursor);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(initialHasMore);
  const [isLoadingMore, setIsLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const initialBatchCount = 12;

  useEffect(() => {
    setItems(initialItems);
    setCursor(initialCursor);
    setHasMore(initialHasMore);
    setActiveCategory(selectedCategorySlug);
    setServing(selectedServing);
    setErrorMessage(null);
  }, [initialItems, initialCursor, initialHasMore, selectedCategorySlug, selectedServing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchTerm(initialQuery);
  }, [initialQuery]);

  // Save to client cache on receive
  useEffect(() => {
    const cacheKey = `${activeCategory || 'all'}_${serving}`;
    if (items.length > 0 && !searchTerm) {
      recipeListingCache.set(cacheKey, { items, cursor, hasMore });
    }
  }, [items, cursor, hasMore, activeCategory, serving, searchTerm]);


  const updateUrlParams = (newCategory?: string, newServing?: 'cold' | 'hot', newQ?: string) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams?.toString() ?? '');

    const cat = newCategory !== undefined ? newCategory : activeCategory;
    const srv = newServing !== undefined ? newServing : serving;
    const q = newQ !== undefined ? newQ : searchTerm;

    if (cat && cat !== 'all' && cat !== 'همه') {
      params.set('category', cat);
    } else {
      params.delete('category');
    }

    if (srv) {
      params.set('serving', srv);
    }

    if (q && q.trim().length > 0) {
      params.set('q', q.trim());
    } else {
      params.delete('q');
    }

    startTransition(() => {
      const queryString = params.toString();
      router.push(`/recipes${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`);
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchTerm === initialQuery) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      updateUrlParams(undefined, undefined, searchTerm);
    }, 300);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  const handleCategoryClick = (categorySlug: string) => {
    setActiveCategory(categorySlug);
    const cacheKey = `${categorySlug || 'all'}_${serving}`;
    if (recipeListingCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      const cached = recipeListingCache.get(cacheKey)!;
      setItems(cached.items);
      setCursor(cached.cursor);
      setHasMore(cached.hasMore);
    }
    updateUrlParams(categorySlug, undefined, undefined);
  };

  const handleServingToggle = (newServing: 'cold' | 'hot') => {
    setServing(newServing);
    updateUrlParams(undefined, newServing, undefined);
  };

  const handleClearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
    updateUrlParams(undefined, undefined, '');
  };

  const handleLoadMore = async () => {
    if (isLoadingMore || !hasMore) return;

    setIsLoadingMore(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await loadMoreRecipesAction({
        categorySlug: activeCategory || undefined,
        serving,
        q: searchTerm.trim() || undefined,
        cursor,
        skip: items.length,
        take: initialBatchCount,
      });

      if (res.success && res.items) {
        setItems((prev) => {
          const existingIds = new Set(prev.map((x) => x.id));
          const newItems = res.items!.filter((x) => !existingIds.has(x.id));
          if (newItems.length === 0 || !res.hasMore) {
            setHasMore(false);
          } else {
            setHasMore(Boolean(res.hasMore));
          }
          return [...prev, ...newItems];
        });
        setCursor(res.nextCursor ?? null);
      } else {
        setHasMore(false);
        if (res.error) setErrorMessage(res.error);
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('خطای ارتباط با سرور.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  const handleShowLess = () => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.slice(0, initialBatchCount));
    setHasMore(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 200, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const displayedItems = useMemo(() => {
    let list = items;

    if (activeCategory && activeCategory !== 'all' && activeCategory !== 'همه') {
      list = list.filter((item: any) => {
        if (item.categorySlug === activeCategory) return true;
        if (item.categories && item.categories.some((c: any) => c.slug === activeCategory || c.category?.slug === activeCategory)) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }

    if (serving) {
      list = list.filter((item: any) => {
        return matchesServingFilter(item.servingTypes, serving.toUpperCase() as 'COLD' | 'HOT');
      });
    }

    const q = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      list = list.filter((item) => {
        const text = `${item.title} ${item.subtitle || ''} ${item.nameFa || ''} ${item.country || ''}`.toLowerCase();
        return text.includes(q);
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [items, activeCategory, serving, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10 sm:space-y-14">
      {/* 1. Search Bar & Filter Controls */}
      <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <div className="relative max-w-lg mx-auto">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="جستجو در دسرهای عسل باباخُرم..."
            className="w-full h-12 pr-11 pl-10 rounded-none bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#DFD3C3] text-[#3F2A1D] placeholder-[#7A6553] text-sm sm:text-base focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D9A441]/40 focus:border-[#C58A2A] transition-all shadow-xs"
            dir="rtl"
          />
          <Search className="absolute right-4 top-3.5 w-5 h-5 text-[#C58A2A] pointer-events-none" />
          {searchTerm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClearSearch}
              className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-[#7A6553] hover:text-[#3F2A1D] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="پاک کردن جستجو"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

/**
 * SearchDrawer Component (Phase 10 Task 1)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - 250ms input debounce.
 * - Grouped suggestions (up to 8 products, up to 8 recipes).
 * - Thumbnails, titles, links.
 * - "مشاهده همه" links to scoped listings with ?q=.
 * - Global results page link to /search?q=.
 * - Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Escape).
 * - Focus management and trap.
 * - Empty ("موردی یافت نشد"), loading, and error states.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useId } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Search, X, Loader2, ArrowLeft, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { searchGlobalAction } from '@/server/actions/search-actions';
import { Picture } from '@/components/ui/picture';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import type { ProductCardViewModel } from '@/server/queries/products';
import type { RecipeCardViewModel } from '@/server/queries/recipes';

interface SearchDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface SelectableItem {
  id: string;
  type: 'product' | 'recipe' | 'see-all-products' | 'see-all-recipes' | 'see-all-global';
  title: string;
  href: string;
}

export function SearchDrawer({ isOpen, onClose }: SearchDrawerProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [debouncedQuery, setDebouncedQuery] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<ProductCardViewModel[]>([]);
  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<RecipeCardViewModel[]>([]);
  const [totalProducts, setTotalProducts] = useState(0);
  const [totalRecipes, setTotalRecipes] = useState(0);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 1. Auto-focus on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        inputRef.current?.focus();
      }, 50);
      setActiveIndex(-1);
    } else {
      setQuery('');
      setDebouncedQuery('');
      setProducts([]);
      setRecipes([]);
      setTotalProducts(0);
      setTotalRecipes(0);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // 2. 250ms Debounce
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedQuery(query.trim());
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);

  // 3. Execute search when debouncedQuery changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    if (debouncedQuery.length < 2) {
      setProducts([]);
      setRecipes([]);
      setTotalProducts(0);
      setTotalRecipes(0);
      setIsLoading(false);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    searchGlobalAction(debouncedQuery)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (res.success) {
          setProducts(res.products || []);
          setRecipes(res.recipes || []);
          setTotalProducts(res.totalProducts || 0);
          setTotalRecipes(res.totalRecipes || 0);
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(res.error || 'خطا در جستجو.');
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setErrorMessage('خطای ارتباط با سرور.');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };

  const selectableItems: SelectableItem[] = [];

    selectableItems.push({
      id: `p_${p.id}`,
      type: 'product',
      title: p.title,
      href: p.href,
    });
  });

  if (totalProducts > products.length && debouncedQuery) {
    selectableItems.push({
      id: 'see-all-products',
      type: 'see-all-products',
      title: `مشاهده تمام محصولات (${toPersianDigits(totalProducts)})`,
      href: `/products?q=${encodeURIComponent(debouncedQuery)}`,
    });
  }

  recipes.forEach((r) => {
    selectableItems.push({
      id: `r_${r.id}`,
      type: 'recipe',
      title: r.title,
      href: r.href,
    });
  });

  if (totalRecipes > recipes.length && debouncedQuery) {
    selectableItems.push({
      id: 'see-all-recipes',
      type: 'see-all-recipes',
      title: `مشاهده تمام دستورها (${toPersianDigits(totalRecipes)})`,
      href: `/recipes?q=${encodeURIComponent(debouncedQuery)}`,
    });
  }

  if (debouncedQuery.length >= 2 && (products.length > 0 || recipes.length > 0)) {
    selectableItems.push({
      id: 'see-all-global',
      type: 'see-all-global',
      title: `صفحه نتایج جامع برای «${debouncedQuery}»`,
      href: `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(debouncedQuery)}`,
    });
  }

  // 5. Keyboard Navigation (ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Escape)
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onClose();
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev < selectableItems.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : selectableItems.length - 1));
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (activeIndex >= 0 && activeIndex < selectableItems.length) {
        const item = selectableItems[activeIndex];
        router.push(item.href);
        onClose();
      } else if (query.trim().length >= 2) {
        router.push(`/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}`);
        onClose();
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      className="fixed inset-x-0 top-[94px] lg:top-20 z-40 bg-[#FDFBF8] border-b-2 border-[#D97706] shadow-2xl animate-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-200 max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col"
      dir="rtl"
      role="search"
      aria-label="جستجوی همگانی وب‌سایت"
    >
      {/* Search Input Bar */}
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-6 py-4 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[#EFE9E0]">
        <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-[#D97706] shrink-0" />
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="search"
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setQuery(e.target.value);
            setActiveIndex(-1);
          }}
          placeholder="جستجوی نام عسل، خاستگاه گیاهی، دستورها، یا خواص درمانی (حداقل ۲ حرف)..."
          className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm sm:text-base text-[#2B2017] font-medium placeholder-stone-400 focus:outline-none"
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        {query && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setQuery('');
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }}
            aria-label="پاک کردن"
            className="p-1.5 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="بستن کادر جستجو"
          className="p-2 text-stone-600 hover:text-[#2B2017] hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-lg transition-colors text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
        >
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">بستن</span>
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Suggestions Container */}
      <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-6 py-5 space-y-6">
        {/* Loading State */}
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-stone-500 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-[#D97706]" />
            <span>در حال جستجوی همزمان در محصولات و دستورها...</span>
          </div>

            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>

'use client';

/**
 * Search Results Client Component (Phase 10 Task 2)
 *
 * Implements:
 * - Search query refinement input.
 * - Grouped sections for Products and Recipes.
 * - Independent "نمایش بیشتر" (Load more) cursor pagination per group.
 * - 3-column desktop grid & 1-per-row horizontal mobile cards.
 * - Empty state with helpful suggestions.
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Search, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ContentCard } from '@/components/ui/content-card';
import { PillButton } from '@/components/ui/pill-button';
import { loadMoreProductsAction, loadMoreRecipesAction } from '@/server/actions/listing-actions';
import { toPersianDigits } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import type { ProductCardViewModel, ProductCursor } from '@/server/queries/products';
import type { RecipeCardViewModel, RecipeCursor } from '@/server/queries/recipes';

export interface SearchResultsClientProps {
  initialQuery: string;
  initialProducts: ProductCardViewModel[];
  initialRecipes: RecipeCardViewModel[];
  totalProducts: number;
  totalRecipes: number;
}

export function SearchResultsClient({
  initialQuery,
  initialProducts,
  initialRecipes,
  totalProducts,
  totalRecipes,
}: SearchResultsClientProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState(initialQuery);

  // Products group state
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<ProductCardViewModel[]>(initialProducts);
  const [productCursor, setProductCursor] = useState<ProductCursor | null>(
    initialProducts.length >= 20
      ? {
          sortOrder: initialProducts[initialProducts.length - 1].sortOrder,
          id: initialProducts[initialProducts.length - 1].id,
        }
      : null
  );
  const [hasMoreProducts, setHasMoreProducts] = useState(totalProducts > initialProducts.length);
  const [isLoadingMoreProducts, setIsLoadingMoreProducts] = useState(false);

  // Recipes group state
  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<RecipeCardViewModel[]>(initialRecipes);
  const [recipeCursor, setRecipeCursor] = useState<RecipeCursor | null>(
    initialRecipes.length >= 20
      ? {
          sortOrder: initialRecipes[initialRecipes.length - 1].sortOrder,
          id: initialRecipes[initialRecipes.length - 1].id,
        }
      : null
  );
  const [hasMoreRecipes, setHasMoreRecipes] = useState(totalRecipes > initialRecipes.length);
  const [isLoadingMoreRecipes, setIsLoadingMoreRecipes] = useState(false);

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = searchInput.trim();
    if (trimmed) {
      router.push(`/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleLoadMoreProducts = async () => {
    if (!productCursor || isLoadingMoreProducts) return;
    setIsLoadingMoreProducts(true);

    try {
      const res = await loadMoreProductsAction({
        q: initialQuery,
        cursor: productCursor,
        take: 20,
      });

      if (res.success && res.items) {
        setProducts((prev) => [...prev, ...res.items!]);
        setProductCursor(res.nextCursor ?? null);
        setHasMoreProducts(Boolean(res.hasMore));
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingMoreProducts(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLoadMoreRecipes = async () => {
    if (!recipeCursor || isLoadingMoreRecipes) return;
    setIsLoadingMoreRecipes(true);

    try {
      const res = await loadMoreRecipesAction({
        q: initialQuery,
        cursor: recipeCursor,
        take: 20,
      });

      if (res.success && res.items) {
        setRecipes((prev) => [...prev, ...res.items!]);
        setRecipeCursor(res.nextCursor ?? null);
        setHasMoreRecipes(Boolean(res.hasMore));
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingMoreRecipes(false);
    }
  };

  const totalResults = totalProducts + totalRecipes;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-12 sm:space-y-16">
      {/* Search Input Bar */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchInput}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="جستجوی مجدد در محصولات و دستورها..."
            className="w-full h-12 pr-12 pl-28 rounded-full bg-white/95 border border-[#EFE9E0] text-[#2B2017] placeholder-[#5C5248] text-sm sm:text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FBBF24] shadow-sm"
            dir="rtl"
          />
          <Search className="absolute right-4 top-3.5 w-5 h-5 text-[#B45309] pointer-events-none" />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="absolute left-1.5 top-1.5 bottom-1.5 px-5 rounded-full bg-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#F59E0B] text-[#2B2017] font-black text-xs sm:text-sm transition-colors shadow"
          >
            جستجو
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* Empty State */}
      {totalResults === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-16 px-4 max-w-lg mx-auto bg-white border border-[#FDE68A] p-8 space-y-4 shadow-md">
          <p className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-[#2B2017]">
            موردی یافت نشد
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#5C5248] leading-relaxed">
            هیچ محصول یا دستوری مطابق با عبارت «{initialQuery}» یافت نشد. لطفاً عبارت دیگری را امتحان کرده یا املای آن را بررسی فرمایید.
          </p>
          <div className="pt-2 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            <PillButton variant="gold" size="sm" href="/products">
              مشاهده محصولات
            </PillButton>
            <PillButton variant="green" size="sm" href="/recipes">
              مشاهده دستورها
            </PillButton>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-16">
          {/* 1. Group: Products */}
          {products.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-8">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/20 pb-3">
                <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#FBBF24]">
                  محصولات مرتبط ({toPersianDigits(totalProducts)})
                </h2>
                <span className="text-xs text-[#E8E2D9]/70">
                  نمایش {toPersianDigits(products.length)} از {toPersianDigits(totalProducts)} مورد
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Desktop: 3-column grid */}
              <div className="hidden md:grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8">
                {products.map((item) => (
                  <ContentCard
                    key={item.id}
                    title={item.title}
                    subtitle={item.subtitle}
                    href={item.href}
                    imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                    theme={item.theme}
                    slug={item.slug}
                    sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
                    isAvailable={item.isAvailable}
                    linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                    variant="vertical"
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Mobile: 1 item per row (horizontal) */}
              <div className="md:hidden space-y-4">
                {products.map((item) => (
                  <ContentCard
                    key={item.id}
                    title={item.title}
                    subtitle={item.subtitle}
                    href={item.href}
                    imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                    theme={item.theme}
                    slug={item.slug}
                    sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
                    isAvailable={item.isAvailable}
                    linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                    variant="horizontal"
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Load more Products */}
              {hasMoreProducts && (
                <div className="text-center pt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleLoadMoreProducts}
                    disabled={isLoadingMoreProducts}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#F5A623] hover:bg-[#E08B38] text-[#2B2017] hover:text-white font-black text-sm transition-all shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isLoadingMoreProducts ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                        <span>در حال بارگذاری...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span>نمایش بیشتر محصولات</span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 2. Group: Recipes */}
          {recipes.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-8">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/20 pb-3">
                <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#FBBF24]">
                  دسرهای مرتبط ({toPersianDigits(totalRecipes)})
                </h2>
                <span className="text-xs text-[#E8E2D9]/70">
                  نمایش {toPersianDigits(recipes.length)} از {toPersianDigits(totalRecipes)} مورد
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Desktop: 3-column grid */}
              <div className="hidden md:grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8">
                {recipes.map((item) => (
                  <ContentCard
                    key={item.id}
                    title={item.title}
                    subtitle={item.subtitle}
                    href={item.href}
                    imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                    theme={item.theme}
                    slug={item.slug}
                    sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
                    linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                    variant="vertical"
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Mobile: 1 item per row (horizontal) */}
              <div className="md:hidden space-y-4">
                {recipes.map((item) => (
                  <ContentCard
                    key={item.id}
                    title={item.title}
                    subtitle={item.subtitle}
                    href={item.href}
                    imageAsset={item.imageAsset}
                    theme={item.theme}
                    slug={item.slug}
                    sortOrder={item.sortOrder}
                    linkLabel={item.linkLabel}
                    variant="horizontal"
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Load more Recipes */}
              {hasMoreRecipes && (
                <div className="text-center pt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleLoadMoreRecipes}
                    disabled={isLoadingMoreRecipes}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#F5A623] hover:bg-[#E08B38] text-[#2B2017] hover:text-white font-black text-sm transition-all shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isLoadingMoreRecipes ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                        <span>در حال بارگذاری...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span>نمایش بیشتر دستورها</span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ShellLayout Client Coordinator (Phase 5 & 10)
 * Coordinates the public shell: sticky Header with integrated corner contact tab,
 * SearchDrawer, HamburgerDrawer, and honey.com Footer.
 */

'use client';

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { SiteSettingsData } from '@/server/services/settings-service';
import { PublicChannelItem } from '@/server/queries/settings';
import { CategoryNavItem, HamburgerDrawer } from './hamburger-drawer';
import { Header } from './header';
import { SearchDrawer } from './search-drawer';
import { Footer } from './footer';

interface ShellLayoutProps {
  settings: SiteSettingsData;
  contactBarChannels: PublicChannelItem[];
  footerChannels: PublicChannelItem[];
  productCategories: CategoryNavItem[];
  recipeCategories: CategoryNavItem[];
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function ShellLayout({
  settings,
  contactBarChannels,
  footerChannels,
  productCategories,
  recipeCategories,
  children,
}: ShellLayoutProps) {
  const [isHamburgerOpen, setIsHamburgerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const hamburgerButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#FDFBF8] text-[#2B2017]">
      {/* Sticky Header with integrated honey.com corner Contact Tab & Logo */}
      <Header
        siteNameFa={settings.siteNameFa}
        cartEnabled={settings.cartEnabled}
        channels={contactBarChannels}
        onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onOpenHamburger={() => setIsHamburgerOpen(true)}
        hamburgerButtonRef={hamburgerButtonRef}
      />

      {/* Search Drawer */}
      <SearchDrawer
        isOpen={isSearchOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Hamburger Drawer (Main Navigation Menu) */}
      <HamburgerDrawer
        isOpen={isHamburgerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsHamburgerOpen(false)}
        onOpenSearch={() => {
          setIsHamburgerOpen(false);
          setIsSearchOpen(true);
        }}
        productCategories={productCategories}
        recipeCategories={recipeCategories}
        triggerRef={hamburgerButtonRef}
      />

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <main className="flex-1 w-full">{children}</main>

      {/* Authentic honey.com Footer */}
      <Footer settings={settings} channels={footerChannels} />
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface ContainerProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'default' | 'narrow' | 'wide';
}

export function Container({ children, size = 'default', className, ...props }: ContainerProps) {
  const sizeClasses = {
    default: 'max-w-7xl',
    narrow: 'max-w-5xl',
    wide: 'max-w-[1440px]',
  }[size];

  return (
    <div className={cn('w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8', sizeClasses, className)} {...props}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ContentCard Component (Brief Section 5 & Phase 5, Task 3)
 * Shared card for Products and Recipes.
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - 90-degree sharp corners (rounded-none)
 * - Subtle shadow, border
 * - Hover lifts 6px (-translate-y-1.5) and image scales ~1.08
 * - Image area 240px high on desktop (sm:h-60), responsive
 * - Card themes: green (#4CA849), orange (#E08B38), yellow (#F5A623, dark text), burgundy (#9E3556), and AUTO (hash from slug)
 * - Availability badge if out of stock ("ناموجود")
 * - Link label followed by honey.com signature dotted arrow icon
 * - Horizontal mobile-row variant: image on visual right (in RTL), text on visual left
 */

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { CardTheme, getCardThemeForSlug, getBalancedCardTheme, resolveItemCardTheme } from '@/lib/domain-utils';
import { Picture } from './picture';
import { DottedArrowIcon } from './dotted-arrow-icon';

  subtitle?: string | null;
  href: string;
  imageAsset?: {

    width: number;
    height: number;
    blurDataUrl?: string | null;

  imageAlt?: string;
  theme?: CardTheme | 'AUTO' | string;
  slug?: string;
  isAvailable?: boolean;
  linkLabel?: string;
  variant?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  className?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
  index?: number;
  sortOrder?: number;
  itemType?: 'product' | 'recipe';
}

    text: string;
    subtext: string;
    badgeBg: string;
    arrowColor: string;
    borderColor: string;
    hex: string;
  }

  // Uppercase keys
  GREEN: {

    text: 'text-white',
    subtext: 'text-white/90',
    badgeBg: 'bg-black/50 text-white',
    arrowColor: 'text-white',
    borderColor: 'border-[#3D8B3A]',
    hex: '#4CA849',
  },

export function ContentCard({
  title,
  subtitle,
  href,
  imageAsset,
  imageUrl,
  imageAlt = '',
  theme = 'AUTO',
  slug = '',
  isAvailable = true,
  linkLabel = 'مشاهده',
  variant = 'vertical',
  className = '',
  priority = false,
  index,
  sortOrder,
  itemType,
}: ContentCardProps) {
  // Resolve card theme consistently matching detail page breadcrumbs
  const resolvedTheme: string = resolveItemCardTheme({
    cardTheme: theme,
    sortOrder: typeof sortOrder === 'number' ? sortOrder : index,
    slug: slug || title,
    index,
  });

  const currentTheme = THEME_STYLES[resolvedTheme] || THEME_STYLES.GREEN;
  const isProduct = itemType === 'product' || (itemType === undefined && href.startsWith('/products'));

  // Horizontal variant (Mobile-row: Image on visual right in RTL, text on left)
  if (variant === 'horizontal') {
    return (
      <Link
        href={href}
        className={`group block rounded-none border ${currentTheme.borderColor} shadow-[0_3px_12px_rgba(51,33,21,0.18)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_28px_rgba(51,33,21,0.28)] active:scale-[0.99] transition-all duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1.5 motion-reduce:transform-none overflow-hidden ${currentTheme.bg} ${className}`}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-row items-center h-28 sm:h-32">
          {/* Image Container - Visual Right in RTL (first in DOM under dir="rtl") */}
          <div className="relative w-28 sm:w-32 h-full shrink-0 overflow-hidden bg-black/10">
            {imageAsset ? (
              <Picture
                asset={imageAsset}
                width={imageAsset.width}
                height={imageAsset.height}
                blurDataUrl={imageAsset.blurDataUrl}
                alt={imageAlt || title}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-105 motion-reduce:transform-none"
                priority={priority}
              />
            ) : imageUrl ? (
              <img
                src={imageUrl}
                alt={imageAlt || title}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-105 motion-reduce:transform-none"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-black/10 text-xs font-bold text-white/90">
                <span>عسل باباخُرم</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {!isAvailable && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black/70 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-none z-10 shadow-xs">
                ناموجود
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Content Area - Visual Left in RTL */}
          <div className="flex-1 p-3 sm:p-4 flex flex-col justify-between h-full min-w-0 text-right">
            <div>
              <h3 className={`font-black text-xs sm:text-sm leading-snug line-clamp-2 ${currentTheme.text}`}>
                {title}
              </h3>
              {subtitle && (
                <p className={`text-[11px] sm:text-xs mt-1 truncate font-bold ${currentTheme.subtext}`}>
                  {subtitle}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Link Label with Dotted Arrow */}
            <div className={`text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-black/15 mt-1 ${currentTheme.text}`}>
              <span>{linkLabel}</span>
              <DottedArrowIcon
                direction="left"

              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>
    );
  }
