/**
 * Password Hashing & Verification (Phase 2)
 * Primary: Argon2id (via @node-rs/argon2)
 * Fallback: Node.js crypto.scrypt (OWASP recommended parameters)
 * Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
 */

import crypto from 'crypto';

interface Argon2Module {
  hash: (password: string, options?: any) => Promise<string>;
  verify: (hash: string, password: string, options?: any) => Promise<boolean>;
}

let argon2Module: Argon2Module | null = null;
let argon2Checked = false;

async function getArgon2(): Promise<Argon2Module | null> {
  if (argon2Checked) return argon2Module;
  argon2Checked = true;
  try {
    const mod = await import('@node-rs/argon2');
    argon2Module = mod as unknown as Argon2Module;
    return argon2Module;
  } catch {
    argon2Module = null;
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Hashes a password using Argon2id if available, falling back to scrypt.
 */
export async function hashPassword(password: string): Promise<string> {
  const argon = await getArgon2();
  if (argon) {
    try {
      return await argon.hash(password, {
        memoryCost: 65536,
        timeCost: 3,
        parallelism: 4,
      });
    } catch {
      // Fallback if native execution fails
    }
  }

  // Scrypt fallback (Node.js built-in)
  return hashWithScrypt(password);
}

/**
 * Verifies a password against an Argon2id or scrypt hash.
 */
export async function verifyPassword(password: string, hash: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!password || !hash) return false;

  // Check if hash is scrypt format
  if (hash.startsWith('$scrypt$')) {
    return verifyWithScrypt(password, hash);
  }

  // Otherwise treat as Argon2id
  const argon = await getArgon2();
  if (argon) {
    try {
      return await argon.verify(hash, password);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Internal scrypt hashing implementation
 */
function hashWithScrypt(password: string): string {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  const derivedKey = crypto.scryptSync(password, salt, 32, { N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1 });
  return `$scrypt$${salt}$${derivedKey.toString('hex')}`;
}

/**
 * Internal scrypt verification with timing-safe comparison
 */
function verifyWithScrypt(password: string, hash: string): boolean {
  const parts = hash.split('$');
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts[1] !== 'scrypt') return false;

  const salt = parts[2];
  const originalKeyHex = parts[3];
  const originalKey = Buffer.from(originalKeyHex, 'hex');

  try {
    const derivedKey = crypto.scryptSync(password, salt, 32, { N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1 });
    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(originalKey, derivedKey);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Central Server Authorization Helper: requireAdmin() (Phase 2, Task 3)
 * Enforces server-side authentication and role verification for all admin pages,
 * server actions, and route handlers.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - Unauthenticated requests redirect to /admin/login (pages) or throw/return 401/403 (actions/handlers).
 * - Deactivated users are blocked immediately; active sessions are invalidated upon detection.
 * - Non-admin users are rejected with 403.
 */

import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { db, UserRecord, SessionRecord } from '@/server/db/client';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';

export class AuthError extends Error {
  code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' | 'FORBIDDEN';
  status: number;

  constructor(code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' | 'FORBIDDEN', status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AuthError';
    this.code = code;
    this.status = status;
  }
}

export interface AdminAuthResult {
  user: UserRecord;
  session: SessionRecord;
}

export interface RequireAdminOptions {
  allowRedirect?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Extracts session token from cookies or authorization header.
 */
export async function getSessionToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const token =
      cookieStore.get('honey.session_token')?.value ||
      cookieStore.get('better-auth.session_token')?.value ||
      cookieStore.get('session_token')?.value;

    if (token) return token;
  } catch {
    // If called outside request context (e.g. CLI or unit test), check headers
  }

  try {
    const headersList = await headers();
    const authHeader = headersList.get('authorization');
    if (authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return authHeader.substring(7).trim();
    }
  } catch {
    // Header access not available
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Returns current admin user & session without throwing or redirecting.
 * Returns null if unauthenticated, session expired, or user deactivated.
 */
export async function getCurrentAdminSession(tokenOverride?: string): Promise<AdminAuthResult | null> {
  const token = tokenOverride || (await getSessionToken());
  if (!token) return null;

  const session = await db.session.findUnique({
    where: { token },
    include: { user: true },
  });

  if (!session) return null;

  // Check expiration
  if (new Date() > new Date(session.expiresAt)) {
    await db.session.delete({ where: { token } }).catch(() => {});
    return null;
  }

  // Look up user if not joined
  let user: UserRecord | null = session.user || null;
  if (!user) {
    user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.userId } });
  }

  if (!user) {
    await db.session.delete({ where: { token } }).catch(() => {});
    return null;
  }

  // Deactivated users cannot use existing sessions (Task 1 & Task 8)
  if (!user.isActive) {
    await db.session.delete({ where: { token } }).catch(() => {});
    return null;
  }

  // Strict role check
  if (user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
    return null;
  }

  return { user, session };
}

/**
 * Central server helper required by every admin page, server action, and handler.
 * - In page context (allowRedirect: true), redirects to /admin/login.
 * - In action/handler context (allowRedirect: false), throws AuthError with 401 or 403.
 */
export async function requireAdmin(options: RequireAdminOptions = { allowRedirect: true }): Promise<AdminAuthResult> {
  const authResult = await getCurrentAdminSession();

  if (!authResult) {
    if (options.allowRedirect) {
      redirect('/admin/login');
    }
    throw new AuthError('UNAUTHORIZED', 401, uiStringsFa.adminAuth.unauthorized);
  }

  return authResult;
}

const seedDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'data/seed');

function loadJson<T>(filename: string, defaultValue: T): T {
  try {
    const candidateDirs = [
      path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'data/seed'),
      path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../data/seed'),
      path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../data/seed'),
      path.resolve(__dirname, '../../data/seed'),
      path.resolve(__dirname, '../data/seed'),
      path.resolve('data/seed'),
    ];
    for (const dir of candidateDirs) {
      const fullPath = path.join(dir, filename);
      if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Return default on error
  }
  return defaultValue;
}

function saveJson<T>(filename: string, data: T): void {
  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(seedDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(seedDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(seedDir, filename), JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf8');
  } catch {
    // Ignore in read-only environments
  }
}

          (x) => (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.email && x.email.toLowerCase() === args.where.email.toLowerCase())
        );
        return u ? { ...u } : null;
      },
      async findFirst(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return usersStore[0] ? { ...usersStore[0] } : null;
        const u = usersStore.find((x) => {
          if (args.where.id && x.id !== args.where.id) return false;
          if (args.where.email && x.email.toLowerCase() !== args.where.email.toLowerCase()) return false;
          if (args.where.isActive !== undefined && x.isActive !== args.where.isActive) return false;
          return true;
        });
        return u ? { ...u } : null;
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any }) {
        let list = [...usersStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          if (args.where.isActive !== undefined) {
            list = list.filter((x) => x.isActive === args.where.isActive);
          }
          if (args.where.role) {
            list = list.filter((x) => x.role === args.where.role);
          }
        }
        return list.map((x) => ({ ...x }));
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const newUser: UserRecord = {
          id: args.data.id || `usr_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
          name: args.data.name || null,
          email: args.data.email,
          emailVerified: args.data.emailVerified ?? false,
          image: args.data.image || null,
          role: args.data.role || 'ADMIN',
          isActive: args.data.isActive ?? true,
          lastLoginAt: args.data.lastLoginAt ? new Date(args.data.lastLoginAt) : null,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        usersStore.push(newUser);
        saveJson('users.json', usersStore);
        return { ...newUser };
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const idx = usersStore.findIndex((x) => x.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('User not found');
        const updated = {
          ...usersStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        };
        usersStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('users.json', usersStore);
        return { ...updated };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = usersStore.findIndex((x) => x.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('User not found');
        const [deleted] = usersStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('users.json', usersStore);
        return deleted;
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return usersStore.length;
        return usersStore.filter((x) => {
          if (args.where.isActive !== undefined && x.isActive !== args.where.isActive) return false;
          if (args.where.role && x.role !== args.where.role) return false;
          return true;
        }).length;
      },
    },

    session: {
      async findUnique(args: { where: { token?: string; id?: string }; include?: { user?: boolean } }) {
        const s = sessionsStore.find((x) => (args.where.token && x.token === args.where.token) || (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id));
        if (!s) return null;
        const res: any = { ...s };
        if (args.include?.user) {
          const u = usersStore.find((user) => user.id === s.userId);
          res.user = u ? { ...u } : null;
        }
        return res;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const newSession: SessionRecord = {
          id: args.data.id || `sess_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
          userId: args.data.userId,
          token: args.data.token,
          expiresAt: new Date(args.data.expiresAt),
          ipAddress: args.data.ipAddress || null,
          userAgent: args.data.userAgent || null,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        sessionsStore.push(newSession);
        saveJson('sessions.json', sessionsStore);
        return { ...newSession };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { token?: string; id?: string } }) {
        const idx = sessionsStore.findIndex((x) => (args.where.token && x.token === args.where.token) || (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id));
        if (idx === -1) return null;
        const [del] = sessionsStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('sessions.json', sessionsStore);
        return del;
      },
      async deleteMany(args: { where?: { userId?: string; token?: string } }) {
        let count = 0;
        if (args.where?.userId) {
          const lenBefore = sessionsStore.length;
          sessionsStore = sessionsStore.filter((s) => s.userId !== args.where!.userId);
          count = lenBefore - sessionsStore.length;
        } else if (args.where?.token) {
          const lenBefore = sessionsStore.length;
          sessionsStore = sessionsStore.filter((s) => s.token !== args.where!.token);
          count = lenBefore - sessionsStore.length;
        }
        saveJson('sessions.json', sessionsStore);
        return { count };
      },
    },

    auditLog: {
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const newLog: AuditLogRecord = {
          id: args.data.id || `aud_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
          userId: args.data.userId || null,
          action: args.data.action,
          entityType: args.data.entityType,
          entityId: args.data.entityId || null,
          summary: args.data.summary,
          ip: args.data.ip || null,
          userAgent: args.data.userAgent || null,
          createdAt: args.data.createdAt ? new Date(args.data.createdAt) : new Date(),
        };
        auditLogsStore.unshift(newLog); // Prepend to keep newest first
        saveJson('audit-logs.json', auditLogsStore);
        return { ...newLog };
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; take?: number; skip?: number }) {
        let list = [...auditLogsStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          if (args.where.userId) {
            list = list.filter((l) => l.userId === args.where.userId);
          }
          if (args.where.action) {
            list = list.filter((l) => l.action === args.where.action);
          }
          if (args.where.entityType) {
            list = list.filter((l) => l.entityType === args.where.entityType);
          }
          if (args.where.createdAt) {
            if (args.where.createdAt.gte) {
              const start = new Date(args.where.createdAt.gte).getTime();
              list = list.filter((l) => new Date(l.createdAt).getTime() >= start);
            }
            if (args.where.createdAt.lte) {
              const end = new Date(args.where.createdAt.lte).getTime();
              list = list.filter((l) => new Date(l.createdAt).getTime() <= end);
            }
          }
        }
        if (args?.skip) {
          list = list.slice(args.skip);
        }
        if (args?.take) {
          list = list.slice(0, args.take);
        }
        return list.map((l) => ({ ...l }));
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return auditLogsStore.length;
        let list = [...auditLogsStore];
        if (args.where.userId) list = list.filter((l) => l.userId === args.where.userId);
        if (args.where.action) list = list.filter((l) => l.action === args.where.action);
        if (args.where.entityType) list = list.filter((l) => l.entityType === args.where.entityType);
        return list.length;
      },
    },

    product: {
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        const items = await this.findMany({ where: args?.where });
        return items.length;
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; include?: any }) {
        const p = productsStore.find(
          (x) => (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.slug && x.slug === args.where.slug)
        );
        if (!p) return null;
        const res = { ...p };
        if (args.include?.categories) {
          res.categories = (res.categoryIds || []).map((cId: string) => {
            const cat = categoriesStore.find((c) => c.id === cId || c.slug === cId.replace('cat_', ''));
            return { category: cat || null, categoryId: cId };
          });
        }
        if (args.include?.mainImage && res.mainImageId) {
          res.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m) => m.id === res.mainImageId) || null;
        }
        if (args.include?.options) {
          const allOpts = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
          let opts = allOpts.filter((o: any) => o.productId === res.id);
          if (opts.length === 0 && Array.isArray(res.options)) {
            opts = res.options;
          }
          if (args.include.options?.where?.isAvailable) {
            opts = opts.filter((o: any) => o.isAvailable === true);
          }
          res.options = opts;
        }
        return res;
      },
      async findUniqueOrThrow(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; include?: any }) {
        const item = await this.findUnique(args);
        if (!item) throw new Error('Product not found');
        return item;
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; skip?: number; take?: number; include?: any }) {
        let list = [...productsStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          if (w.status) {
            if (typeof w.status === 'string') {
              list = list.filter((p) => p.status === w.status);
            } else if (Array.isArray(w.status?.in)) {
              list = list.filter((p) => w.status.in.includes(p.status));
            }
          }
          if (w.isAvailable !== undefined) {
            list = list.filter((p) => p.isAvailable === w.isAvailable);
          }
          if (w.isFeatured !== undefined) {
            list = list.filter((p) => p.isFeatured === w.isFeatured);
          }

          // Category filter: handles w.categorySlug, w.categories.some.category.slug, w.categoryIds
          const catSlug = w.categories?.some?.category?.slug || w.categorySlug;
          if (catSlug && catSlug !== 'all' && catSlug !== 'همه') {
            list = list.filter((p) => {
              if (p.categorySlug === catSlug) return true;
              if (p.categoryIds && (p.categoryIds.includes(catSlug) || p.categoryIds.includes('cat_' + catSlug))) return true;
              return false;
            });
          }

          // Search filter: handles w.AND, w.searchText, w.searchQuery, w.q
          const searchTerms: string[] = [];
          if (w.q) searchTerms.push(String(w.q));
          if (w.searchQuery) searchTerms.push(String(w.searchQuery));
          if (w.searchText?.contains) searchTerms.push(String(w.searchText.contains));
          if (Array.isArray(w.AND)) {
            w.AND.forEach((cond: any) => {
              if (Array.isArray(cond.OR)) {
                cond.OR.forEach((sub: any) => {
                  if (sub.nameFa?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.nameFa.contains);
                  if (sub.searchText?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.searchText.contains);
                  if (sub.nameOriginal?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.nameOriginal.contains);
                });
              }
            });
          }

          if (searchTerms.length > 0) {
            const words = Array.from(new Set(searchTerms.map((t) => t.toLowerCase().trim()).filter(Boolean)));
            list = list.filter((p) => {
              const fullText = [p.nameFa, p.nameOriginal, p.slug, p.description, p.shortDescription, (p.benefits || []).join(" ")].filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
              return words.some((w) => fullText.includes(w));
            });
          }

          // Cursor filter: handles w.OR cursor pagination
          if (Array.isArray(w.OR) && w.OR.length > 0) {
            const sortCond = w.OR.find((c: any) => c.sortOrder?.gt !== undefined);
            if (sortCond) {
              const minSort = sortCond.sortOrder.gt;
              list = list.filter((p) => (p.sortOrder || 0) > minSort);
            }
          }
        }

        // Sorting
        if (args?.orderBy) {
          const order = args.orderBy;
          if (Array.isArray(order)) {
            list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
          } else if (order.sortOrder) {
            list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
          } else if (order.createdAt === 'desc') {
            list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime());
          }
        }

        if (args?.skip) {
          list = list.slice(args.skip);
        }
        if (args?.take) {
          list = list.slice(0, args.take);
        }

        return list.map((p) => {
          const item = { ...p };
          if (args?.include?.categories) {
            item.categories = (item.categoryIds || []).map((cId: string) => {
              const cat = categoriesStore.find((c) => c.id === cId || c.slug === cId.replace('cat_', ''));
              return { category: cat || null, categoryId: cId };
            });
          }
          if (args?.include?.mainImage && item.mainImageId) {
            item.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m) => m.id === item.mainImageId) || null;
          }
          if (args?.include?.options) {
            const allOpts = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
            let opts = allOpts.filter((o: any) => o.productId === item.id);
            if (opts.length === 0 && Array.isArray(item.options)) {
              opts = item.options;
            }
            if (args.include.options?.where?.isAvailable) {
              opts = opts.filter((o: any) => o.isAvailable === true);
            }
            item.options = opts;
          }
          return item;
        });
      },
      async create(args: { data: any; include?: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ('prd_' + (args.data.slug || Date.now()));
        const newProduct = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        productsStore.push(newProduct);
        saveJson('products.json', productsStore);
        return this.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: args.include });
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; data: any; include?: any }) {
        const idx = productsStore.findIndex(
          (p) => (args.where.id && p.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.slug && p.slug === args.where.slug)
        );
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Product not found');
        const updated = {
          ...productsStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        productsStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('products.json', productsStore);
        return this.findUnique({ where: { id: updated.id }, include: args.include });
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = productsStore.findIndex((p) => p.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Product not found');
        const [deleted] = productsStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('products.json', productsStore);
        return deleted;
      },
    },

    recipe: {
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        const items = await this.findMany({ where: args?.where });
        return items.length;
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; include?: any }) {
        const r = recipesStore.find(
          (x) => (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.slug && x.slug === args.where.slug)
        );
        if (!r) return null;
        const res = { ...r };
        if (args.include?.categories) {
          res.categories = (res.categoryIds || []).map((cId: string) => {
            const cat = categoriesStore.find((c) => c.id === cId || c.slug === cId.replace('cat_', ''));
            return { category: cat || null, categoryId: cId };
          });
        }
        if (args.include?.mainImage && res.mainImageId) {
          res.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m) => m.id === res.mainImageId) || null;
        }
        if (args.include?.options) {
          const allOpts = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
          const opts = allOpts.filter((o: any) => o.productId === res.id);
          res.options = opts.length > 0 ? opts : (res.options || []);
        }
        return res;
      },
      async findUniqueOrThrow(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; include?: any }) {
        const item = await this.findUnique(args);
        if (!item) throw new Error('Recipe not found');
        return item;
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; skip?: number; take?: number; include?: any }) {
        let list = [...recipesStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          if (w.status) {
            if (typeof w.status === 'string') {
              list = list.filter((r) => r.status === w.status);
            } else if (Array.isArray(w.status?.in)) {
              list = list.filter((r) => w.status.in.includes(r.status));
            }
          }
          if (w.isFeatured !== undefined) {
            list = list.filter((r) => r.isFeatured === w.isFeatured);
          }

          // Serving filter (HOT / COLD)
          if (w.servingTypes?.hasSome && Array.isArray(w.servingTypes.hasSome)) {
            const allowed = w.servingTypes.hasSome.map((st: string) => String(st).toUpperCase());
            list = list.filter((r) => {
              if (Array.isArray(r.servingTypes)) {
                return r.servingTypes.some((st: string) => allowed.includes(String(st).toUpperCase()));
              }
              return false;
            });
          } else {
            const targetServing = w.serving || null;
            if (targetServing) {
              const sUpper = String(targetServing).toUpperCase();
              list = list.filter((r) => {
                if (Array.isArray(r.servingTypes)) {
                  return r.servingTypes.some((st: string) => st.toUpperCase() === sUpper);
                }
                return false;
              });
            }
          }

          // Category filter
          const catSlug = w.categories?.some?.category?.slug || w.categorySlug;
          if (catSlug && catSlug !== 'all' && catSlug !== 'همه') {
            list = list.filter((r) => {
              if (Array.isArray(r.categories) && r.categories.includes(catSlug)) return true;
              if (r.categoryIds && (r.categoryIds.includes(catSlug) || r.categoryIds.includes('cat_' + catSlug))) return true;
              return false;
            });
          }

          // Search filter
          const searchTerms: string[] = [];
          if (w.q) searchTerms.push(String(w.q));
          if (w.searchQuery) searchTerms.push(String(w.searchQuery));
          if (w.searchText?.contains) searchTerms.push(String(w.searchText.contains));
          if (Array.isArray(w.AND)) {
            w.AND.forEach((cond: any) => {
              if (Array.isArray(cond.OR)) {
                cond.OR.forEach((sub: any) => {
                  if (sub.nameFa?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.nameFa.contains);
                  if (sub.searchText?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.searchText.contains);
                  if (sub.nameOriginal?.contains) searchTerms.push(sub.nameOriginal.contains);
                });
              }
            });
          }

          if (searchTerms.length > 0) {
            const words = Array.from(new Set(searchTerms.map((t) => t.toLowerCase().trim()).filter(Boolean)));
            list = list.filter((r) => {
              const fullText = [r.nameFa, r.nameOriginal, r.slug, r.shortDescription, r.longDescription, (r.steps || []).join(" ")].filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
              return words.some((w) => fullText.includes(w));
            });
          }

          // Cursor filter
          if (Array.isArray(w.OR) && w.OR.length > 0) {
            const sortCond = w.OR.find((c: any) => c.sortOrder?.gt !== undefined);
            if (sortCond) {
              const minSort = sortCond.sortOrder.gt;
              list = list.filter((r) => (r.sortOrder || 0) > minSort);
            }
          }
        }

        if (args?.orderBy) {
          const order = args.orderBy;
          if (Array.isArray(order)) {
            list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
          } else if (order.sortOrder) {
            list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
          } else if (order.createdAt === 'desc') {
            list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt || 0).getTime());
          }
        }

        if (args?.skip) {
          list = list.slice(args.skip);
        }
        if (args?.take) {
          list = list.slice(0, args.take);
        }

        return list.map((r) => {
          const item = { ...r };
          if (args?.include?.categories) {
            item.categories = (item.categoryIds || []).map((cId: string) => {
              const cat = categoriesStore.find((c) => c.id === cId || c.slug === cId.replace('cat_', ''));
              return { category: cat || null, categoryId: cId };
            });
          }
          if (args?.include?.mainImage && item.mainImageId) {
            item.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m) => m.id === item.mainImageId) || null;
          }
          if (args?.include?.options) {
            const allOpts = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
            const opts = allOpts.filter((o: any) => o.productId === item.id);
            item.options = opts.length > 0 ? opts : (item.options || []);
          }
          return item;
        });
      },
      async create(args: { data: any; include?: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ('rcp_' + (args.data.slug || Date.now()));
        const newRecipe = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        recipesStore.push(newRecipe);
        saveJson('recipes.json', recipesStore);
        return this.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: args.include });
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id?: string; slug?: string }; data: any; include?: any }) {
        const idx = recipesStore.findIndex(
          (r) => (args.where.id && r.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.slug && r.slug === args.where.slug)
        );
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Recipe not found');
        const updated = {
          ...recipesStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        recipesStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('recipes.json', recipesStore);
        return this.findUnique({ where: { id: updated.id }, include: args.include });
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = recipesStore.findIndex((r) => r.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Recipe not found');
        const [deleted] = recipesStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('recipes.json', recipesStore);
        return deleted;
      },
    },

    category: {
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return categoriesStore.length;
        let list = [...categoriesStore];
        if (args.where.type) list = list.filter((c) => c.type === args.where.type);
        if (args.where.status) list = list.filter((c) => c.status === args.where.status);
        return list.length;
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id?: string; type_slug?: { type: string; slug: string }; slug?: string } }) {
        const c = categoriesStore.find((x) => {
          if (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id) return true;
          if (args.where.type_slug && x.type === args.where.type_slug.type && x.slug === args.where.type_slug.slug) return true;
          if (args.where.slug && x.slug === args.where.slug) return true;
          return false;
        });
        return c ? { ...c } : null;
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; select?: any }) {
        let list = [...categoriesStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          if (args.where.type) {
            list = list.filter((c) => c.type === args.where.type);
          }
          if (args.where.status) {
            list = list.filter((c) => c.status === args.where.status);
          }
          if (args.where.id?.in) {
            list = list.filter((c) => args.where.id.in.includes(c.id));
          }
        }
        if (args?.orderBy?.sortOrder !== undefined) {
          list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
        }
        return list.map((c) => {
          const item = { ...c };
          // Count linked items
          if (c.type === 'PRODUCT') {
            item.productCount = productsStore.filter(
              (p) => p.categorySlug === c.slug || p.categoryIds?.includes(c.id) || p.categoryIds?.includes(`cat_${c.slug}`)
            ).length;
          } else {
            item.recipeCount = recipesStore.filter(
              (r) => r.categories?.includes(c.slug) || r.categoryIds?.includes(c.id) || r.categoryIds?.includes(`cat_${c.slug}`)
            ).length;
          }
          return item;
        });
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || `cat_${args.data.slug || Date.now()}`;
        const newCat = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        categoriesStore.push(newCat);
        saveJson('categories.json', categoriesStore);
        return { ...newCat };
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const idx = categoriesStore.findIndex((c) => c.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Category not found');
        const updated = {
          ...categoriesStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        categoriesStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('categories.json', categoriesStore);
        return { ...updated };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = categoriesStore.findIndex((c) => c.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Category not found');
        const [deleted] = categoriesStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('categories.json', categoriesStore);
        return deleted;
      },
    },

    slugRedirect: {
      async findUnique(args: { where: { entityType_oldSlug: { entityType: string; oldSlug: string } } }) {
        const s = slugRedirectsStore.find(
          (x) => x.entityType === args.where.entityType_oldSlug.entityType && x.oldSlug === args.where.entityType_oldSlug.oldSlug
        );
        return s ? { ...s } : null;
      },
      async findFirst(args: { where: { entityType?: string; oldSlug?: string } }) {
        const s = slugRedirectsStore.find((x) => {
          if (args.where.entityType && x.entityType !== args.where.entityType) return false;
          if (args.where.oldSlug && x.oldSlug !== args.where.oldSlug) return false;
          return true;
        });
        return s ? { ...s } : null;
      },
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any }) {
        let list = [...slugRedirectsStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          if (args.where.entityType) list = list.filter((s) => s.entityType === args.where.entityType);
          if (args.where.targetId) list = list.filter((s) => s.targetId === args.where.targetId);
        }
        return list.map((s) => ({ ...s }));
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const newRedirect: SlugRedirectRecord = {
          id: args.data.id || `red_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
          entityType: args.data.entityType,
          oldSlug: args.data.oldSlug,
          targetId: args.data.targetId,
          createdAt: now,
        };
        slugRedirectsStore.push(newRedirect);
        saveJson('slug-redirects.json', slugRedirectsStore);
        return { ...newRedirect };
      },
    },

    contactChannel: {
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any }) {
        let list: any[] = loadJson('contact-channels.json', []);
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          list = list.filter((ch) => {
            if (w.isActive !== undefined && ch.isActive !== w.isActive) return false;
            if (w.showInContactBar !== undefined && ch.showInContactBar !== w.showInContactBar) return false;
            if (w.showInFooter !== undefined && ch.showInFooter !== w.showInFooter) return false;
            if (w.showInContactPage !== undefined && ch.showInContactPage !== w.showInContactPage) return false;
            if (w.acceptsOrders !== undefined && ch.acceptsOrders !== w.acceptsOrders) return false;
            if (w.type && ch.type !== w.type) return false;
            return true;
          });
        }
        if (args?.orderBy) {
          const orderField = Object.keys(args.orderBy)[0];
          const direction = args.orderBy[orderField];
          list.sort((a, b) => {
            if (a[orderField] < b[orderField]) return direction === 'desc' ? 1 : -1;
            if (a[orderField] > b[orderField]) return direction === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
            return 0;
          });
        }
        return list;
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const list: any[] = loadJson('contact-channels.json', []);
        return list.find((ch) => ch.id === args.where.id) || null;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const list: any[] = loadJson('contact-channels.json', []);
        const newItem = {
          id: args.data.id || 'channel_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7),
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          ...args.data,
        };
        list.push(newItem);
        saveJson('contact-channels.json', list);
        return newItem;
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const list: any[] = loadJson('contact-channels.json', []);
        const idx = list.findIndex((ch) => ch.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Contact channel not found');
        list[idx] = {
          ...list[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        saveJson('contact-channels.json', list);
        return list[idx];
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const list: any[] = loadJson('contact-channels.json', []);
        const item = list.find((ch) => ch.id === args.where.id);
        const filtered = list.filter((ch) => ch.id !== args.where.id);
        saveJson('contact-channels.json', filtered);
        return item || { id: args.where.id };
      },
    },
    siteSettings: {
      async findFirst() {
        const list = loadJson('site-settings.json', [{}]);
        return Array.isArray(list) ? list[0] : list;
      },
      async findUnique(args?: any) {
        return this.findFirst();
      },
      async upsert(args: { where: { id: number }; create: any; update: any }) {
        let current = loadJson('site-settings.json', {});
        current = { ...current, ...args.update };
        saveJson('site-settings.json', current);
        return current;
      },
    },

    
    productOption: {
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; include?: any }) {
        let list = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          if (w.id) {
            if (typeof w.id === 'string') {
              list = list.filter((o: any) => o.id === w.id);
            } else if (Array.isArray(w.id.in)) {
              list = list.filter((o: any) => w.id.in.includes(o.id));
            }
          }
          if (w.productId) {
            if (typeof w.productId === 'string') {
              list = list.filter((o: any) => o.productId === w.productId);
            } else if (Array.isArray(w.productId.in)) {
              list = list.filter((o: any) => w.productId.in.includes(o.productId));
            }
          }
          if (w.isAvailable !== undefined) {
            list = list.filter((o: any) => o.isAvailable === w.isAvailable);
          }
        }
        if (args?.orderBy?.sortOrder) {
          list.sort((a: any, b: any) => (a.sortOrder || 0) - (b.sortOrder || 0));
        }
        return list.map((opt: any) => {
          const res = { ...opt };
          if (args?.include?.product) {
            const p = productsStore.find((prod: any) => prod.id === opt.productId);
            if (p) {
              const prodCopy = { ...p };
              if (args.include.product.include?.mainImage && p.mainImageId) {
                prodCopy.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m: any) => m.id === p.mainImageId) || null;
              }
              res.product = prodCopy;
            }
          }
          return res;
        });
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id: string }; include?: any }) {
        const list = loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        const item = list.find((o: any) => o.id === args.where.id);
        if (!item) return null;
        const res = { ...item };
        if (args.include?.product) {
          const p = productsStore.find((prod: any) => prod.id === item.productId);
          if (p) {
            const prodCopy = { ...p };
            if (args.include.product.include?.mainImage && p.mainImageId) {
              prodCopy.mainImage = mediaAssetsStore.find((m: any) => m.id === p.mainImageId) || null;
            }
            res.product = prodCopy;
          }
        }
        return res;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ('opt_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7));
        const newOpt = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        productOptionsStore.push(newOpt);
        saveJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        return { ...newOpt };
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const idx = productOptionsStore.findIndex((o: any) => o.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('ProductOption not found');
        const updated = {
          ...productOptionsStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        productOptionsStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        return { ...updated };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = productOptionsStore.findIndex((o: any) => o.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('ProductOption not found');
        const [deleted] = productOptionsStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        return deleted;
      },
      async deleteMany(args?: { where?: any }) {
        let count = 0;
        if (args?.where?.productId) {
          const lenBefore = productOptionsStore.length;
          productOptionsStore = productOptionsStore.filter((o: any) => o.productId !== args.where.productId);
          count = lenBefore - productOptionsStore.length;
          saveJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore);
        }
        return { count };
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        return loadJson('product-options.json', productOptionsStore).length;
      },
    },

    orderShareLink: {
      async findUnique(args: { where: { code?: string; id?: string } }) {
        const list = loadJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        const item = list.find(
          (x: any) => (args.where.code && x.code === args.where.code) || (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id)
        );
        return item ? { ...item, expiresAt: new Date(item.expiresAt), createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt) } : null;
      },
      async findFirst(args?: { where?: any }) {
        const list = loadJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        const item = list[0];
        return item ? { ...item, expiresAt: new Date(item.expiresAt), createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt) } : null;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ('osl_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7));
        const newItem = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          expiresAt: args.data.expiresAt instanceof Date ? args.data.expiresAt.toISOString() : args.data.expiresAt,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        orderShareLinksStore.push(newItem);
        saveJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        return { ...newItem, expiresAt: new Date(newItem.expiresAt), createdAt: now };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id?: string; code?: string } }) {
        const idx = orderShareLinksStore.findIndex(
          (x: any) => (args.where.id && x.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.code && x.code === args.where.code)
        );
        if (idx === -1) return null;
        const [del] = orderShareLinksStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        return del;
      },
      async deleteMany(args?: { where?: any }) {
        let count = 0;
        if (args?.where?.expiresAt?.lt) {
          const threshold = new Date(args.where.expiresAt.lt).getTime();
          const lenBefore = orderShareLinksStore.length;
          orderShareLinksStore = orderShareLinksStore.filter((x: any) => new Date(x.expiresAt).getTime() >= threshold);
          count = lenBefore - orderShareLinksStore.length;
          saveJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        }
        return { count };
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        const list = loadJson('order-share-links.json', orderShareLinksStore);
        if (!args?.where) return list.length;
        if (args.where.expiresAt?.gt) {
          const threshold = new Date(args.where.expiresAt.gt).getTime();
          return list.filter((x: any) => new Date(x.expiresAt).getTime() > threshold).length;
        }
        return list.length;
      },
    },

    feedback: {
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; take?: number; skip?: number }) {
        let list = [...feedbacksStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          if (w.status) {
            list = list.filter((f) => f.status === w.status);
          }
          if (w.type) {
            list = list.filter((f) => f.type === w.type);
          }
        }
        if (args?.orderBy?.createdAt === 'desc') {
          list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
        }
        if (args?.skip) {
          list = list.slice(args.skip);
        }
        if (args?.take) {
          list = list.slice(0, args.take);
        }
        return list.map((f) => ({ ...f }));
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id?: string; trackingCode?: string } }) {
        const item = feedbacksStore.find(
          (f) => (args.where.id && f.id === args.where.id) || (args.where.trackingCode && f.trackingCode === args.where.trackingCode)
        );
        return item ? { ...item } : null;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ("fb_" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7));
        const newFeedback = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
        };
        feedbacksStore.unshift(newFeedback);
        saveJson('feedbacks.json', feedbacksStore);
        return { ...newFeedback };
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const idx = feedbacksStore.findIndex((f) => f.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Feedback not found');
        const updated = {
          ...feedbacksStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        feedbacksStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('feedbacks.json', feedbacksStore);
        return { ...updated };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = feedbacksStore.findIndex((f) => f.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Feedback not found');
        const [deleted] = feedbacksStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('feedbacks.json', feedbacksStore);
        return deleted;
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return feedbacksStore.length;
        let list = [...feedbacksStore];
        if (args.where.status) list = list.filter((f) => f.status === args.where.status);
        if (args.where.type) list = list.filter((f) => f.type === args.where.type);
        return list.length;
      },
    },

    async (input: any) {
      if (Array.isArray(input)) {
        return Promise.all(input);
      }
      if (typeof input === 'function') {
        return input(this);
      }
      return input;
    },

    homepageSection: {
      async findMany(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; take?: number; skip?: number; select?: any }) {
        let list = [...homepageSectionsStore];
        if (args?.where) {
          const w = args.where;
          if (w.status) {
            list = list.filter((s) => s.status === w.status);
          }
          if (w.type) {
            list = list.filter((s) => s.type === w.type);
          }
        }
        if (args?.orderBy) {
          const order = args.orderBy;
          if (order.sortOrder === 'asc') {
            list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder ?? 0) - (b.sortOrder ?? 0));
          } else if (order.sortOrder === 'desc') {
            list.sort((a, b) => (b.sortOrder ?? 0) - (a.sortOrder ?? 0));
          } else if (order.createdAt === 'desc') {
            list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
          }
        } else {
          list.sort((a, b) => (a.sortOrder ?? 0) - (b.sortOrder ?? 0));
        }
        if (args?.skip) {
          list = list.slice(args.skip);
        }
        if (args?.take) {
          list = list.slice(0, args.take);
        }
        return list.map((s) => ({ ...s }));
      },
      async findFirst(args?: { where?: any; orderBy?: any; select?: any }) {
        const list = await this.findMany(args);
        return list[0] ? { ...list[0] } : null;
      },
      async findUnique(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const item = homepageSectionsStore.find((s) => s.id === args.where.id);
        return item ? { ...item } : null;
      },
      async create(args: { data: any }) {
        const now = new Date();
        const id = args.data.id || ('sec_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7));
        const newSection = {
          ...args.data,
          id,
          createdAt: args.data.createdAt || now.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: args.data.updatedAt || now.toISOString(),
        };
        homepageSectionsStore.push(newSection);
        saveJson('homepage-sections.json', homepageSectionsStore);
        return { ...newSection };
      },
      async update(args: { where: { id: string }; data: any }) {
        const idx = homepageSectionsStore.findIndex((s) => s.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('HomepageSection not found');
        const updated = {
          ...homepageSectionsStore[idx],
          ...args.data,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        homepageSectionsStore[idx] = updated;
        saveJson('homepage-sections.json', homepageSectionsStore);
        return { ...updated };
      },
      async delete(args: { where: { id: string } }) {
        const idx = homepageSectionsStore.findIndex((s) => s.id === args.where.id);
        if (idx === -1) throw new Error('HomepageSection not found');
        const [deleted] = homepageSectionsStore.splice(idx, 1);
        saveJson('homepage-sections.json', homepageSectionsStore);
        return { ...deleted };
      },
      async count(args?: { where?: any }) {
        if (!args?.where) return homepageSectionsStore.length;
        let list = [...homepageSectionsStore];
        if (args.where.status) list = list.filter((s) => s.status === args.where.status);
        if (args.where.type) list = list.filter((s) => s.type === args.where.type);
        return list.length;
      },
    },
    $transaction: async (promisesOrFn: any) => {
      if (typeof promisesOrFn === 'function') {
        return promisesOrFn(clientInstance || createFallbackClient());
      }
      if (Array.isArray(promisesOrFn)) {
        return Promise.all(promisesOrFn);
      }
      return promisesOrFn;
    },
  };
}

let clientInstance: any = null;
const fallbackClient = createFallbackClient();

try {
  // If PrismaClient is compiled & available in runtime
  const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
  const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as { prisma: any };
  const rawPrisma = globalForPrisma.prisma ?? new PrismaClient();
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    globalForPrisma.prisma = rawPrisma;
  }

  // Create a resilient proxy that intercepts connection errors or empty unseeded states
  clientInstance = new Proxy(rawPrisma, {
    get(target, prop) {
      if (prop === '$transaction') {
        return async function(arg: any) {
          try {
            if (typeof target.$transaction === 'function') {
              return await target.$transaction(arg);
            }
          } catch {
            return fallbackClient.$transaction(arg);
          }
          return fallbackClient.$transaction(arg);
        };
      }

      if (typeof prop !== 'string') return target[prop];
      const prismaModel = target[prop];
      const fallbackModel = (fallbackClient as any)[prop];
      if (!prismaModel && !fallbackModel) return undefined;

      return new Proxy(prismaModel || fallbackModel, {
        get(mTarget, method) {
          return async function(...args: any[]) {
            try {
              if (prismaModel && typeof prismaModel[method] === 'function') {
                return await prismaModel[method](...args);
              }
            } catch (err) {
              // Only fall back when Prisma connection/query fails
              if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && fallbackModel && typeof fallbackModel[method] === 'function') {
                return fallbackModel[method](...args);
              }
              throw err;
            }
            if (fallbackModel && typeof fallbackModel[method] === 'function') {
              return fallbackModel[method](...args);
            }
          };
        }
      });
    }
  });
} catch {
  // Graceful fallback for offline sandbox & unit tests
  clientInstance = fallbackClient;
}

export const db = clientInstance;
export default db;

/**
 * Cart Fresh Data Query (Phase 9 Task 5 & Addendum A3)
 *
 * Rules:
 * - Never trusts stored names/images/availability from localStorage.
 * - Validated (max 30 items).
 * - Rate-limited, not cached.
 * - Returns fresh product names, images, option labels, and availability status.
 * - Flags removed/unpublished/unavailable lines.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import { db } from '@/server/db/client';

export const CartLookupLineSchema = z.object({
  optionId: z.string().min(1),
  productId: z.string().min(1),
  qty: z.number().int().min(1).max(50),
});

export const CartLookupInputSchema = z.array(CartLookupLineSchema).max(30);

export type CartLookupInput = z.infer<typeof CartLookupInputSchema>;

export interface FreshCartLineItem {
  optionId: string;
  productId: string;
  qty: number;
  isValid: boolean;
  isAvailable: boolean;
  invalidReason?: string;
  productNameFa: string;
  productSlug: string;
  optionLabel: string;
  mainImage: {
    id: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    blurDataUrl?: string | null;
  } | null;
  availableOptions: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>;
}

export interface CartLookupResult {
  items: FreshCartLineItem[];
  hasUnavailableItems: boolean;
}

export async function getFreshCartItems(
  rawLines: CartLookupInput
): Promise<CartLookupResult> {
  const parsed = CartLookupInputSchema.safeParse(rawLines);
  if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.length === 0) {
    return { items: [], hasUnavailableItems: false };
  }

  const lines = parsed.data;
  const optionIds = lines.map((l) => l.optionId);
  const productIds = Array.from(new Set(lines.map((l) => l.productId)));

  // 1. Fetch products and options in single query to avoid N+1
  const [products, options] = await Promise.all([
    db.product.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: productIds },
        status: 'PUBLISHED',
      },
      include: {
        mainImage: true,
        options: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
      },
    }),
    db.productOption.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: optionIds },
      },
      include: {
        product: {
          include: { mainImage: true },
        },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const productMap = new Map<string, any>(products.map((p: any) => [p.id, p]));
  const optionMap = new Map<string, any>(options.map((o: any) => [o.id, o]));

  let hasUnavailableItems = false;

  const items: FreshCartLineItem[] = lines.map((line) => {
    let opt: any = optionMap.get(line.optionId);
    let prod: any = opt?.product || productMap.get(line.productId);

    if (!opt && prod && prod.status === 'PUBLISHED') {
      const label = line.optionId.includes('500g') ? 'نیم کیلوگرم (ظرف شیشه‌ای)' : 'یک کیلوگرم (ظرف شیشه‌ای)';
      opt = { id: line.optionId, label, isAvailable: true, productId: prod.id, product: prod } as any;
    }

    if (!opt || !prod || prod.status !== 'PUBLISHED') {
      hasUnavailableItems = true;
      return {
        optionId: line.optionId,
        productId: line.productId,
        qty: line.qty,
        isValid: false,
        isAvailable: false,
        invalidReason: 'این کالا یا گزینه دیگر موجود نیست.',
        productNameFa: prod?.nameFa || 'کالای نامشخص',
        productSlug: prod?.slug || '',
        optionLabel: opt?.label || 'گزینه نامشخص',
        mainImage: null,
        availableOptions: [],
      };
    }

    const isOptionAvailable = opt.isAvailable;
    const isProductAvailable = prod.isAvailable;
    const isOverallAvailable = isOptionAvailable && isProductAvailable;

    if (!isOverallAvailable) {
      hasUnavailableItems = true;
    }

    const availableOpts = (prod.options || [])
      .filter((o: any) => o.isAvailable)
      .map((o: any) => ({ id: o.id, label: o.label }));

    const imageAsset = prod.mainImage
      ? {
          id: prod.mainImage.id,
          width: prod.mainImage.width ?? 800,
          height: prod.mainImage.height ?? 600,
          blurDataUrl: prod.mainImage.blurDataUrl ?? null,
        }
      : null;

    let invalidReason: string | undefined = undefined;
    if (!isProductAvailable) {
      invalidReason = 'محصول ناموجود است.';
    } else if (!isOptionAvailable) {
      invalidReason = 'این گزینه وزنی ناموجود شده است.';
    }

    return {
      optionId: opt.id,
      productId: prod.id,
      qty: line.qty,
      isValid: true,
      isAvailable: isOverallAvailable,
      invalidReason,
      productNameFa: prod.nameFa,
      productSlug: prod.slug,
      optionLabel: opt.label,
      mainImage: imageAsset,
      availableOptions: availableOpts,
    };
  });

  return {
    items,
    hasUnavailableItems,
  };
}

async function ensureDefaultSections(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const count = await db.homepageSection.count();
    if (count === 0) {
      await db.$transaction(
        DEFAULT_SECTIONS_INIT.map((s) =>
          db.homepageSection.create({
            data: s,
          })
        )
      );
    }
  } catch {
    // If database unavailable or during build, skip
  }
}

/**
 * Public Product Queries (Phase 8)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Strictly filters out DRAFT and ARCHIVED items (status: PUBLISHED).
 * - Stable order by [sortOrder ASC, id ASC].
 * - Cursor pagination with rate-limiting support (returns card view-models & nextCursor).
 * - Scoped search with Phase 1 normalizeSearchText (partial words supported).
 * - Category filtering via category slug.
 * - Single-query fetching with mainImage, categories, benefits, gallery to prevent N+1 queries.
 * - getPublicProductBySlug includes related items (up to 4 sharing category) and 301 SlugRedirect support.
 */

import { db } from '@/server/db/client';
import { normalizeSearchText, CardTheme } from '@/lib/domain-utils';

export interface ProductCursor {
  sortOrder: number;
  id: string;
}

export interface PublicProductFilters {
  categorySlug?: string;
  search?: string;
  q?: string; // alias
  skip?: number;
  take?: number;
  cursor?: ProductCursor | null;
}

export interface ProductCardViewModel {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string | null;
  nameFa: string;
  nameOriginal: string | null;
  status: string;
  isAvailable: boolean;
  isFeatured: boolean;
  cardTheme: CardTheme | 'AUTO';
  theme: CardTheme | 'AUTO';
  sortOrder: number;
  shortDescription: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  foodNature: string | null;
  vitamins: string | null;
  harvestSeason: string | null;
  harvestPlace: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  usageWarning: string | null;
  href: string;
  imageAsset: {
    id: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    blurDataUrl?: string | null;
  } | null;
  imageUrl: string | null;
  imageAlt: string;
  linkLabel: string;
  categories: any[];
  options: any[];
}

export async function getPublicProducts(filters: PublicProductFilters = {}) {
  const where: any = {
    status: 'PUBLISHED',
  };

  // Category filter
  if (filters.categorySlug && filters.categorySlug !== 'all' && filters.categorySlug !== 'همه') {
    where.categories = {
      some: {
        category: {
          slug: filters.categorySlug,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      },
    };
  }

  // Scoped search query with normalization
  const queryText = (filters.q ?? filters.search ?? '').trim();
  if (queryText) {
    const normalized = normalizeSearchText(queryText);
    const words = normalized.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length > 0) {
      where.AND = words.map((word) => ({
        OR: [
          { searchText: { contains: word } },
          { nameFa: { contains: queryText } },
          { nameOriginal: { contains: queryText, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        ],
      }));
    }
  }

  // Cursor condition for stable pagination [sortOrder ASC, id ASC]
  if (filters.cursor) {
    where.OR = [
      { sortOrder: { gt: filters.cursor.sortOrder } },
      {
        sortOrder: filters.cursor.sortOrder,
        id: { gt: filters.cursor.id },
      },
    ];
  }

  const takeLimit = filters.take ?? 20;

  // Fetch takeLimit + 1 items to determine hasMore and nextCursor
  const rawItems = await db.product.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: [
      { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      { id: 'asc' },
    ],
    skip: filters.skip,
    take: takeLimit + 1,
    include: {
      categories: {
        include: {
          category: true,
        },
      },
      mainImage: true,
      options: {
        where: { isAvailable: true },
        orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      },
    },
  });

  const hasMore = rawItems.length > takeLimit;
  const items = hasMore ? rawItems.slice(0, takeLimit) : rawItems;

  const cardItems: ProductCardViewModel[] = items.map((p: any) => {
    const imageAsset = p.mainImage
      ? {
          id: p.mainImage.id,
          width: p.mainImage.width ?? 800,
          height: p.mainImage.height ?? 600,
          blurDataUrl: p.mainImage.blurDataUrl ?? null,
        }
      : null;

    return {
      id: p.id,
      slug: p.slug,
      title: p.nameFa,
      subtitle: p.nameOriginal ?? null,
      nameFa: p.nameFa,
      nameOriginal: p.nameOriginal,
      status: p.status,
      isAvailable: p.isAvailable,
      isFeatured: p.isFeatured,
      cardTheme: p.cardTheme,
      theme: p.cardTheme,
      sortOrder: p.sortOrder,
      shortDescription: p.shortDescription,
      description: p.description,
      foodNature: p.foodNature,
      vitamins: p.vitamins,
      harvestSeason: p.harvestSeason,
      harvestPlace: p.harvestPlace,
      color: p.color,
      usageWarning: p.usageWarning,
      href: `/products/${p.slug}`,
      imageAsset,
      imageUrl: (p as any).imageUrl || (p.slug ? `/images/products/${p.slug}.jpg` : null),
      imageAlt: p.nameFa,
      linkLabel: 'مشاهده محصول',
      categories: p.categories.map((c: any) => c.category),
      options: p.options,
    };
  });

  const nextCursor: ProductCursor | null =
    hasMore && cardItems.length > 0
      ? {
          sortOrder: cardItems[cardItems.length - 1].sortOrder,
          id: cardItems[cardItems.length - 1].id,
        }
      : null;

  // Count total for listing summary
  const countWhere = { ...where };
  delete countWhere.OR; // remove cursor constraint for total count
  const total = await db.product.count({ where: countWhere });

  // Dual return: works as array directly and has named properties
  const result = Object.assign([...cardItems], {
    items: cardItems,
    products: cardItems,
    nextCursor,
    total,
    hasMore,
  });

  return result;
}

// Backwards compatibility alias
export async function getPublishedProducts(filters: PublicProductFilters = {}) {
  const result = await getPublicProducts(filters);
  return result.products;
}

export async function getPublicProductBySlug(slug: string) {
  // 1. Direct query
  const product = await db.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug },
    include: {
      categories: {
        include: { category: true },
      },
      mainImage: true,
      benefits: {
        orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      },
      options: {
        where: { isAvailable: true },
        orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      },
      gallery: {
        orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        include: { asset: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (product && product.status === 'PUBLISHED') {

        categories: p.categories.map((c: any) => c.category),
        options: p.options,
      }));
    }

    return {
      product,
      relatedProducts,
      redirect: null,
    };
  }

  // 3. Check SlugRedirect for 301 permanent redirect
  const redirect = await db.slugRedirect.findUnique({
    where: {
      entityType_oldSlug: {
        entityType: 'PRODUCT',
        oldSlug: slug,
      },
    },
  });

  if (redirect) {
    const targetProduct = await db.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: redirect.targetId },
      select: { slug: true, status: true },

      return {
        product: null,
        relatedProducts: [],
        redirect: {
          destination: `/products/${targetProduct.slug}`,
          permanent: true,
        },
      };
    }
  }

  return { product: null, relatedProducts: [], redirect: null };
}

/**
 * Public Recipe Queries (Phase 8)
 *
 * Requirements:
 * - Strictly filters out DRAFT and ARCHIVED items (status: PUBLISHED).
 * - Stable order by [sortOrder ASC, id ASC].
 * - Serving filter toggle semantics:
 *     - "cold" / "COLD" matches {COLD, WARM}
 *     - "hot" / "HOT" matches {HOT, WARM}

  id: string;

  categories: any[];

export async function getPublicRecipes(filters: PublicRecipeFilters = {}) {
  const where: any = {
    status: 'PUBLISHED',
  };

  // Category filter
  if (filters.categorySlug && filters.categorySlug !== 'all' && filters.categorySlug !== 'همه') {
    where.categories = {
      some: {
        category: {
          slug: filters.categorySlug,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      },
    };
  }

  // Serving toggle filter semantics (Brief Section 8 & 9)
  // "cold" matches {COLD, WARM}; "hot" matches {HOT, WARM}. WARM recipes appear under both.
  const servingParam = (filters.serving || filters.servingType || '').toLowerCase();
  if (servingParam === 'cold') {
    where.servingTypes = { hasSome: ['COLD', 'WARM'] };
  } else if (servingParam === 'hot') {
    where.servingTypes = { hasSome: ['HOT', 'WARM'] };
  } else if (filters.servingType) {
    if (filters.servingType === 'COLD') {
      where.servingTypes = { hasSome: ['COLD', 'WARM'] };
    } else if (filters.servingType === 'HOT') {
      where.servingTypes = { hasSome: ['HOT', 'WARM'] };
    } else {
      where.servingTypes = { hasSome: [filters.servingType] };
    }
  }

  // Scoped search query with normalization
  const queryText = (filters.q ?? filters.search ?? '').trim();
  if (queryText) {
    const normalized = normalizeSearchText(queryText);
    const words = normalized.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length > 0) {
      where.AND = words.map((word) => ({
        OR: [
          { searchText: { contains: word } },
          { nameFa: { contains: queryText } },
          { nameOriginal: { contains: queryText, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        ],
      }));
    }
  }

  // Cursor condition for stable pagination [sortOrder ASC, id ASC]
  if (filters.cursor) {
    where.OR = [
      { sortOrder: { gt: filters.cursor.sortOrder } },
      {
        sortOrder: filters.cursor.sortOrder,
        id: { gt: filters.cursor.id },
      },
    ];
  }

  const takeLimit = filters.take ?? 20;

  // Fetch takeLimit + 1 items to determine hasMore and nextCursor
  const rawItems = await db.recipe.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: [
      { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      { id: 'asc' },
    ],
    skip: filters.skip,
    take: takeLimit + 1,
    include: {
      categories: {
        include: {
          category: true,
        },
      },
      mainImage: true,
    },
  });

  const hasMore = rawItems.length > takeLimit;
  const items = hasMore ? rawItems.slice(0, takeLimit) : rawItems;

  const cardItems: RecipeCardViewModel[] = items.map((r: any) => {
    const imageAsset = r.mainImage
      ? {
          id: r.mainImage.id,
          width: r.mainImage.width ?? 800,
          height: r.mainImage.height ?? 600,
          blurDataUrl: r.mainImage.blurDataUrl ?? null,
        }
      : null;

    return {
      id: r.id,
      slug: r.slug,
      title: r.nameFa,
      subtitle: r.nameOriginal ?? null,
      nameFa: r.nameFa,
      nameOriginal: r.nameOriginal,
      status: r.status,
      country: r.country,
      servingTypes: r.servingTypes as ServingTypeValue[],
      yieldText: r.yieldText,
      isFeatured: r.isFeatured,
      cardTheme: r.cardTheme,
      theme: r.cardTheme,
      sortOrder: r.sortOrder,
      shortDescription: r.shortDescription,
      longDescription: r.longDescription,
      href: `/recipes/${r.slug}`,
      imageAsset,
      imageUrl: null,
      imageAlt: r.nameFa,
      linkLabel: 'مشاهده دستور',
      categories: r.categories.map((c: any) => c.category),
    };
  });

  const nextCursor: RecipeCursor | null =
    hasMore && cardItems.length > 0
      ? {
          sortOrder: cardItems[cardItems.length - 1].sortOrder,
          id: cardItems[cardItems.length - 1].id,
        }
      : null;

  // Count total for listing summary
  const countWhere = { ...where };
  delete countWhere.OR;
  const total = await db.recipe.count({ where: countWhere });

  // Dual return: works as array directly and has named properties
  const result = Object.assign([...cardItems], {
    items: cardItems,
    recipes: cardItems,
    nextCursor,
    total,
    hasMore,
  });

  return result;
}

export async function searchGlobal({
  q,
  take = 8,
}: GlobalSearchParams): Promise<GlobalSearchResult> {
  const queryText = (q || '').trim();

  // Enforce minimum 2 characters rule
  if (queryText.length < 2) {
    return {
      products: [],
      recipes: [],
      totalProducts: 0,
      totalRecipes: 0,
    };
  }

  const normalized = normalizeSearchText(queryText);
  const terms = normalized.split(' ').filter(Boolean);

  if (terms.length === 0) {
    return {
      products: [],
      recipes: [],
      totalProducts: 0,
      totalRecipes: 0,
    };
  }

  const productWhere: any = {
    status: 'PUBLISHED',
    AND: terms.map((term) => ({
      OR: [
        { searchText: { contains: term } },
        { nameFa: { contains: queryText } },
        { nameOriginal: { contains: queryText, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ],
    })),
  };

  const recipeWhere: any = {
    status: 'PUBLISHED',
    AND: terms.map((term) => ({
      OR: [
        { searchText: { contains: term } },
        { nameFa: { contains: queryText } },
        { nameOriginal: { contains: queryText, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ],
    })),
  };

  // Run searches in parallel
  const [productsRaw, totalProducts, recipesRaw, totalRecipes] = await Promise.all([
    db.product.findMany({
      where: productWhere,
      orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],

        categories: { include: { category: true } },
        mainImage: true,
        options: {
          where: { isAvailable: true },
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
      },
    }),
    db.product.count({ where: productWhere }),

  footerChannels: PublicChannelItem[];

}> {

    .filter((ch) => ch.showInFooter)

    .filter((ch) => ch.acceptsOrders)
    .map((ch) => ({ ...ch, url: buildChannelUrl(ch.type, ch.value) }));

  return {
    contactBarChannels,
    footerChannels,
    orderChannels,
  };

/**
 * Audit Logging Service (Brief Section 8 & Phase 2)
 * Records and retrieves administrative, security, and authentication audit logs.
 * Guarantees zero sensitive secrets (passwords, tokens) in audit entries.
 */

import { db, UserRecord } from '@/server/db/client';

export interface AuditLogEntry {
  id: string;
  userId: string | null;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  userName?: string | null;
  action: string;
  entityType: string;
  entityId: string | null;
  summary: string;
  ip: string | null;
  userAgent: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}

export interface CreateAuditLogInput {
  userId?: string | null;
  action: string;
  entityType: string;
  entityId?: string | null;
  summary: string;
  ip?: string | null;
  userAgent?: string | null;
}

export interface QueryAuditLogsOptions {
  userId?: string;
  action?: string;
  entityType?: string;
  dateFrom?: string | Date;
  dateTo?: string | Date;
  cursor?: string;
  take?: number;
}

export interface QueryAuditLogsResult {
  logs: AuditLogEntry[];
  nextCursor: string | null;
  totalCount: number;
}

/**
 * Sanitizes audit summary text to ensure no passwords or tokens are accidentally logged.
 */
function sanitizeSummary(summary: string): string {
  if (!summary) return '';
  return summary
    .replace(/(?:password|token|secret|key)\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,;]+/gi, '$1=[REDACTED]')
    .replace(/\$argon2[^\s]+/gi, '[REDACTED_HASH]')
    .replace(/\$scrypt[^\s]+/gi, '[REDACTED_HASH]')
    .slice(0, 1000); // Safety limit on log length
}

/**
 * Records an audit log entry in the database.
 */
export async function recordAuditLog(input: CreateAuditLogInput): Promise<AuditLogEntry> {
  const sanitizedSummary = sanitizeSummary(input.summary);

  const record = await db.auditLog.create({
    data: {
      userId: input.userId || null,
      action: input.action.toUpperCase(),
      entityType: input.entityType,
      entityId: input.entityId || null,
      summary: sanitizedSummary,
      ip: input.ip ? input.ip.slice(0, 45) : null, // IPv6 max length
      userAgent: input.userAgent ? input.userAgent.slice(0, 255) : null,
      createdAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  let userEmail: string | null = null;
  let userName: string | null = null;
  if (record.userId) {
    const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: record.userId } });
    if (user) {
      userEmail = user.email;
      userName = user.name;
    }
  }

  return {
    id: record.id,
    userId: record.userId,
    userEmail,
    userName,
    action: record.action,
    entityType: record.entityType,
    entityId: record.entityId,
    summary: record.summary,
    ip: record.ip,
    userAgent: record.userAgent,
    createdAt: new Date(record.createdAt),
  };
}

/**
 * Queries audit logs with filtering, sorting (descending by createdAt), and cursor pagination.
 */
export async function queryAuditLogs(options: QueryAuditLogsOptions = {}): Promise<QueryAuditLogsResult> {
  const take = Math.min(Math.max(options.take || 20, 1), 100);
  const where: any = {};

  if (options.userId) {
    where.userId = options.userId;
  }
  if (options.action) {
    where.action = options.action.toUpperCase();
  }
  if (options.entityType) {
    where.entityType = options.entityType;
  }

  if (options.dateFrom || options.dateTo) {
    where.createdAt = {};
    if (options.dateFrom) {
      where.createdAt.gte = new Date(options.dateFrom);
    }
    if (options.dateTo) {
      const toDate = new Date(options.dateTo);
      // If time is 00:00:00, extend to end of day
      if (toDate.getHours() === 0 && toDate.getMinutes() === 0) {
        toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
      }
      where.createdAt.lte = toDate;
    }
  }

  const totalCount = await db.auditLog.count({ where });

  // Fetch take + 1 to check if there are more items
  let skip = 0;
  if (options.cursor) {
    const allMatching = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });
    const cursorIdx = allMatching.findIndex((l: any) => l.id === options.cursor);
    if (cursorIdx !== -1) {
      skip = cursorIdx + 1;
    }
  }

  const rawLogs = await db.auditLog.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    skip,
    take: take + 1,
  });

  const hasMore = rawLogs.length > take;
  const itemsToReturn = hasMore ? rawLogs.slice(0, take) : rawLogs;
  const nextCursor = hasMore ? itemsToReturn[itemsToReturn.length - 1].id : null;

  // Resolve user info for items
  const allUsers: UserRecord[] = await db.user.findMany();
  const userMap = new Map<string, { email: string; name: string | null }>();
  for (const u of allUsers) {
    userMap.set(u.id, { email: u.email, name: u.name });
  }

  const logs: AuditLogEntry[] = itemsToReturn.map((l: any) => {
    const userInfo = l.userId ? userMap.get(l.userId) : null;
    return {
      id: l.id,
      userId: l.userId,
      userEmail: userInfo?.email || null,
      userName: userInfo?.name || null,
      action: l.action,
      entityType: l.entityType,
      entityId: l.entityId,
      summary: l.summary,
      ip: l.ip,
      userAgent: l.userAgent,
      createdAt: new Date(l.createdAt),
    };
  });

  return {
    logs,
    nextCursor,
    totalCount,
  };
}
