      });
      if (conflict && conflict.id !== id) {
        throw new Error(`دسته‌بندی با شناسه «${slug}» قبلاً ثبت شده است.`);
      }
    }

    // Detect changed fields
    const changedFields: string[] = [];
    if (rawInput.name && rawInput.name !== existing.name) changedFields.push('name');
    if (rawInput.slug && rawInput.slug !== existing.slug) changedFields.push('slug');
    if (rawInput.status && rawInput.status !== existing.status) changedFields.push('status');
    if (rawInput.sortOrder !== undefined && rawInput.sortOrder !== existing.sortOrder) changedFields.push('sortOrder');

    const updated = await db.category.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        name: rawInput.name ?? existing.name,
        slug,
        type,
        status: rawInput.status ?? existing.status,
        sortOrder: rawInput.sortOrder ?? existing.sortOrder,
      },
    });

      entityType: 'Category',

// Aliases for equivalent field names (e.g. title <-> heading)
const FIELD_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
  heading: 'title',
  title: 'heading',
};

/**
 * Switch a section's template with field mapping and the `preserved` bucket.
 * Roundtrip test: A -> B -> A restores all original data without silent loss.
 */
export function switchSectionTemplate(
  oldTemplateId: string,
  newTemplateId: string,
  currentContent: Record<string, any>
): Record<string, any> {
  const newDef = TEMPLATE_REGISTRY[newTemplateId];
  if (!newDef) {
    throw new Error(`قالب مقصد نامعتبر است: ${newTemplateId}`);
  }

  // Combine current visible content with previously preserved fields
  const previousPreserved = currentContent.preserved || {};
  const allKnownData: Record<string, any> = { ...previousPreserved, ...currentContent };
  delete allKnownData.preserved;
  delete allKnownData.schemaVersion;

  const newContent: Record<string, any> = {
    schemaVersion: 1,
  };

  const supportedSet = new Set(newDef.supportedFields);
  const preservedBucket: Record<string, any> = {};

  // 1. Direct matches & alias mappings
  for (const field of newDef.supportedFields) {
    if (allKnownData[field] !== undefined) {
      newContent[field] = allKnownData[field];
    } else {
      // Check alias (e.g. heading <-> title)
      const alias = FIELD_ALIASES[field];
      if (alias && allKnownData[alias] !== undefined) {
        newContent[field] = allKnownData[alias];
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Put all other non-supported keys into preserved
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(allKnownData)) {
    if (!supportedSet.has(key)) {
      preservedBucket[key] = val;
    }
  }

  // Keep single image <-> images array compatibility if possible
  if (supportedSet.has('image') && !newContent.image && Array.isArray(allKnownData.images) && allKnownData.images.length > 0) {
    newContent.image = allKnownData.images[0];
  } else if (supportedSet.has('images') && (!newContent.images || newContent.images.length === 0) && allKnownData.image) {
    newContent.images = [allKnownData.image];
  }

  if (Object.keys(preservedBucket).length > 0) {
    newContent.preserved = preservedBucket;
  }

  return newContent;
}

/**
 * Analyze template switch to show the admin which fields carry over and which are preserved.
 */
export function analyzeTemplateSwitch(
  oldTemplateId: string,
  newTemplateId: string,
  currentContent: Record<string, any>
): {
  mappedFields: string[];
  hiddenFields: string[];
} {
  const newDef = TEMPLATE_REGISTRY[newTemplateId];
  if (!newDef) {
    return { mappedFields: [], hiddenFields: [] };
  }

  const supportedSet = new Set(newDef.supportedFields);
  const previousPreserved = currentContent.preserved || {};
  const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(currentContent), ...Object.keys(previousPreserved)])).filter(
    (k) => k !== 'preserved' && k !== 'schemaVersion'
  );

  const mappedFields: string[] = [];
  const hiddenFields: string[] = [];

  for (const key of allKeys) {
    const alias = FIELD_ALIASES[key];
    if (supportedSet.has(key) || (alias && supportedSet.has(alias))) {
      mappedFields.push(key);
    } else {
      hiddenFields.push(key);
    }
  }

  return { mappedFields, hiddenFields };
}

/**
 * Media Reference Tracking Service (Phase 3, Task 6)
 * Scans all database entities, relations, and arbitrary homepage section JSON
 * to ensure no image that is currently referenced anywhere on the site can ever be deleted.
 */

import { db } from '@/server/db/client';

export interface ReferenceLocation {
  entityType: 'Product' | 'Recipe' | 'SiteSettings' | 'HomepageSection';
  entityId: string;
  field: string;
}

/**
 * Recursively scans any JSON object or array for an asset ID or storage key.
 */
function scanJsonForAsset(json: any, targetId: string, storageKey?: string): boolean {
  if (!json) return false;

  if (typeof json === 'string') {
    if (json === targetId) return true;
    if (storageKey && json.includes(storageKey)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(json)) {
    return json.some((item) => scanJsonForAsset(item, targetId, storageKey));
  }

  if (typeof json === 'object') {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(json)) {
      if (
        (key === 'id' || key === 'assetId' || key === 'mediaId' || key === 'imageId') &&
        value === targetId
      ) {
        return true;
      }
      if (scanJsonForAsset(value, targetId, storageKey)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Finds all locations where a given MediaAsset is currently referenced.
 */
export async function findMediaAssetReferences(assetId: string): Promise<ReferenceLocation[]> {
  const references: ReferenceLocation[] = [];

  const asset = await db.mediaAsset.findUnique({ where: { id: assetId } });
  const storageKey = asset?.storageKey;

  // 1. Check Products (main image and gallery)
  const products = await db.product.findMany();
  for (const p of products) {
    if (p.mainImageId === assetId) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'Product', entityId: p.id, field: 'mainImageId' });
    }
    if (Array.isArray(p.gallery)) {
      const inGallery = p.gallery.some((g: any) => g.assetId === assetId || g.id === assetId);
      if (inGallery) {
        references.push({ entityType: 'Product', entityId: p.id, field: 'gallery' });
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Check Recipes (main image and gallery)
  const recipes = await db.recipe.findMany();
  for (const r of recipes) {
    if (r.mainImageId === assetId) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'Recipe', entityId: r.id, field: 'mainImageId' });
    }
    if (Array.isArray(r.gallery)) {
      const inGallery = r.gallery.some((g: any) => g.assetId === assetId || g.id === assetId);
      if (inGallery) {
        references.push({ entityType: 'Recipe', entityId: r.id, field: 'gallery' });
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Check SiteSettings (logoId, footerLogoId, ogImageId)
  const settings = await db.siteSettings.findFirst();
  if (settings) {
    if (settings.logoId === assetId) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'SiteSettings', entityId: String(settings.id), field: 'logoId' });
    }
    if (settings.footerLogoId === assetId) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'SiteSettings', entityId: String(settings.id), field: 'footerLogoId' });
    }
    if (settings.ogImageId === assetId) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'SiteSettings', entityId: String(settings.id), field: 'ogImageId' });
    }
  }

  // 4. Check Homepage Sections (deep scan through dynamic JSON content)
  const sections = await db.homepageSection.findMany();
  for (const s of sections) {
    if (scanJsonForAsset(s.content, assetId, storageKey)) {
      references.push({ entityType: 'HomepageSection', entityId: s.id, field: 'content' });
    }
  }

  return references;
}

/**
 * Returns true if the MediaAsset is actively in use anywhere on the website.
 */
export async function isMediaAssetReferenced(assetId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const refs = await findMediaAssetReferences(assetId);
  return refs.length > 0;
}

/**
 * Media Processing & Storage Service (Phase 3, Task 2)
 * Handles:
 * - Magic byte inspection (rejecting spoofed/unsupported formats)
 * - Dimension bounds validation (max 6000px) & size limit (max 10MB)
 * - Metadata stripping & EXIF auto-rotation
 * - Responsive WebP variant generation (480, 768, 1200, 1920; never upscaled)
 * - 16px blur placeholder generation
 * - MediaAsset database record persistence
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import os from 'os';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'child_process';
import { db, MediaAssetRecord } from '@/server/db/client';
import { getStorageProvider } from '@/server/storage/storage-provider';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';

export const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10 MB
export const MAX_DIMENSION_PX = 6000;
export const BREAKPOINTS = [480, 768, 1200, 1920];

export type SupportedImageMime = 'image/jpeg' | 'image/png' | 'image/webp';

export interface ImageValidationResult {
  isValid: boolean;
  mime?: SupportedImageMime;
  error?: string;
}

export interface ImageVariantInfo {
  key: string;
  url: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  bytes: number;
}

export interface ProcessedImageResult {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  masterKey: string;
  bytes: number;
  variants: Record<string, ImageVariantInfo>;
  blurDataUrl: string;
}

/**
 * Validates magic byte signatures to prevent spoofed/malicious uploads.
 * Allowed: JPEG (FF D8 FF), PNG (89 50 4E 47 ...), WebP (RIFF....WEBP).
 */
export function validateImageMagicBytes(buffer: Buffer): ImageValidationResult {
  if (!buffer || buffer.length < 12) {
    return { isValid: false, error: uiStringsFa.adminMedia.invalidFileType };
  }

  // 1. JPEG: FF D8 FF
  if (buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xd8 && buffer[2] === 0xff) {
    return { isValid: true, mime: 'image/jpeg' };
  }

  // 2. PNG: 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A
  if (
    buffer[0] === 0x89 &&
    buffer[1] === 0x50 &&
    buffer[2] === 0x4e &&
    buffer[3] === 0x47 &&
    buffer[4] === 0x0d &&
    buffer[5] === 0x0a &&
    buffer[6] === 0x1a &&
    buffer[7] === 0x0a
  ) {
    return { isValid: true, mime: 'image/png' };
  }

  // 3. WebP: RIFF (bytes 0-3) + WEBP (bytes 8-11)
  const isRiff = buffer.slice(0, 4).toString('ascii') === 'RIFF';
  const isWebp = buffer.slice(8, 12).toString('ascii') === 'WEBP';
  if (isRiff && isWebp) {
    return { isValid: true, mime: 'image/webp' };
  }

  // Non-matching (spoofed file or disallowed format e.g. SVG, EXE, TXT)
  return { isValid: false, error: uiStringsFa.adminMedia.fileSpoofed };
}

/**
 * Processes image buffer: auto-rotates, strips metadata, validates dimensions,
 * generates responsive WebP variants, and creates blur placeholder.
 */
export async function processImage(
  buffer: Buffer,
  filePrefix: string
): Promise<ProcessedImageResult> {
  const uploadDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || './uploads');
  if (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  // Try primary engine: native sharp
  try {
    const sharpMod = await import('sharp');
    const sharp = sharpMod.default || sharpMod;

    const metadata = await sharp(buffer).rotate().metadata();
    const origWidth = metadata.width || 0;
    const origHeight = metadata.height || 0;

    if (origWidth > MAX_DIMENSION_PX || origHeight > MAX_DIMENSION_PX) {
      throw new Error(uiStringsFa.adminMedia.dimensionTooLarge);
    }

    // Determine target widths (never upscale)
    const targetWidths = BREAKPOINTS.filter((w) => w < origWidth);
    if (!targetWidths.includes(origWidth)) {
      targetWidths.push(origWidth);
    }
    targetWidths.sort((a, b) => a - b);

    const variants: Record<string, ImageVariantInfo> = {};

    for (const w of targetWidths) {
      const outFilename = `${filePrefix}-${w}.webp`;
      const outPath = path.join(uploadDir, outFilename);

      const variantBuffer = await sharp(buffer)
        .rotate()
        .resize(w, null, { withoutEnlargement: true })
        .webp({ quality: 82 })
        .toBuffer();

      await fs.promises.writeFile(outPath, variantBuffer);

      const variantMeta = await sharp(variantBuffer).metadata();

      variants[String(w)] = {
        key: outFilename,
        url: `/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(outFilename)}`,
        width: w,
        height: variantMeta.height || Math.round((origHeight * w) / origWidth),
        bytes: variantBuffer.length,
      };
    }

    // Generate 16px blur placeholder
    const blurBuffer = await sharp(buffer)
      .rotate()
      .resize(16, null, { withoutEnlargement: true })
      .webp({ quality: 30 })
      .toBuffer();

    const blurDataUrl = `data:image/webp;base64,${blurBuffer.toString('base64')}`;
    const masterKey = `${filePrefix}-${origWidth}.webp`;

    return {
      width: origWidth,
      height: origHeight,
      masterKey,
      bytes: variants[String(origWidth)].bytes,
      variants,
      blurDataUrl,
    };
  } catch (sharpError: any) {
    if (sharpError.message === uiStringsFa.adminMedia.dimensionTooLarge) {
      throw sharpError;
    }

    // Fallback engine: Python Pillow script
    const tempInput = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `temp-${filePrefix}.raw`);
    await fs.promises.writeFile(tempInput, buffer);

    try {
      const scriptPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/process-image.py');
      const proc = spawnSync('python3', [scriptPath, tempInput, uploadDir, filePrefix], {
        encoding: 'utf8',
      });

      if (proc.status !== 0 || !proc.stdout) {
        throw new Error(proc.stderr || 'Image processing failed');
      }

      const res = JSON.parse(proc.stdout.trim());
      if (res.error === 'DIMENSION_TOO_LARGE') {
        throw new Error(uiStringsFa.adminMedia.dimensionTooLarge);
      }
      if (res.error) {
        throw new Error(res.error);
      }

      return res;
    } finally {
      if (fs.existsSync(tempInput)) {
        await fs.promises.unlink(tempInput).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * End-to-end media upload pipeline:
 * 1. Validates size & magic bytes
 * 2. Processes image into responsive WebP variants
 * 3. Saves MediaAsset record to database
 */
export async function uploadAndProcessMedia(params: {
  buffer: Buffer;
  filename?: string;
  alt?: string;
  createdById?: string;
}): Promise<MediaAssetRecord> {
  const { buffer, alt, createdById } = params;

  // 1. File size check
  if (buffer.length > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(uiStringsFa.adminMedia.fileTooLarge);
  }

  // 2. Magic byte validation
  const validation = validateImageMagicBytes(buffer);
  if (!validation.isValid) {
    throw new Error(validation.error || uiStringsFa.adminMedia.fileSpoofed);
  }

  // 3. Process into WebP variants
  const filePrefix = `img_${Date.now()}_${crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;
  const processed = await processImage(buffer, filePrefix);

  // 4. Persist MediaAsset in database
  const asset = await db.mediaAsset.create({
    data: {
      storageKey: processed.masterKey,
      mime: 'image/webp',
      bytes: processed.bytes,
      width: processed.width,
      height: processed.height,
      blurDataUrl: processed.blurDataUrl,
      variants: processed.variants,
      alt: alt?.trim() || null,
      createdById: createdById || null,
    },
  });

  return asset;
}

/**
 * Safely deletes a media asset record and its associated physical files from storage.
 */
export async function deleteMediaAsset(assetId: string): Promise<void> {
  const asset = await db.mediaAsset.findUnique({ where: { id: assetId } });
  if (!asset) {
    throw new Error('تصویر یافت نشد.');
  }

  const storage = getStorageProvider();
  if (asset.variants && typeof asset.variants === 'object') {
    for (const variant of Object.values(asset.variants) as any[]) {
      if (variant?.key) {
        await storage.delete(variant.key);
      }
    }
  }
  await storage.delete(asset.storageKey);

  await db.mediaAsset.delete({ where: { id: assetId } });
}

/**
 * Product Domain Service (Phase 4, Task 2 & 5)
 * Manages Product CRUD, order options, slug redirect maintenance,

import { revalidatePath, revalidateTag } from 'next/cache';
import { db } from '@/server/db/client';

export class ConcurrencyConflictError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'این مورد از زمان باز شدن توسط کاربر دیگری ویرایش شده است.') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ConcurrencyConflictError';
  }
}

export interface ProductListFilters {
  search?: string;
  status?: string;
  categorySlug?: string;
  isAvailable?: boolean;
  skip?: number;
  take?: number;
}

  /**
   * Validates that all categoryIds belong strictly to PRODUCT categories.
   */
  static async validateProductCategories(categoryIds: string[], requireActive = false): Promise<{ id: string; name: string }[]> {
    if (!categoryIds || categoryIds.length === 0) return [];

    const categories = await db.category.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: categoryIds } },
    });

    for (const cat of categories) {
      if (cat.type !== 'PRODUCT') {
        throw new Error(
          `${uiStringsFa.validation.categoryTypeMismatch}: دسته‌بندی «${cat.name}» از نوع محصول نیست.`
        );
      }
      if (requireActive && cat.status === 'ARCHIVED') {
        throw new Error(`دسته‌بندی «${cat.name}» بایگانی شده است و نمی‌تواند به محصول جدید تخصیص یابد.`);
      }
    }

    return categories.map((c: any) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name }));
  }

  /**
   * Lists products with comprehensive filtering and option count calculation.
   */
  static async listProducts(filters: ProductListFilters = {}) {
    const where: any = {};

    if (filters.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }
    if (filters.isAvailable !== undefined) {
      where.isAvailable = filters.isAvailable;
    }
    if (filters.categorySlug) {
      where.categorySlug = filters.categorySlug;
    }
    if (filters.search) {
      where.searchQuery = filters.search;
    }

    const items = await db.product.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
      skip: filters.skip,
      take: filters.take,
      include: { categories: true, mainImage: true },
    });

    const totalCount = await db.product.count({ where });

    return {
      items: items.map((p: any) => ({
        ...p,
        optionCount: Array.isArray(p.options) ? p.options.length : 0,
      })),
      totalCount,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Gets single product by ID with full relations.
   */
  static async getProductById(id: string) {
    return await db.product.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { categories: true, mainImage: true },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Creates a new product, validating categories, checking slug uniqueness,
   * building searchText, and recording an audit entry.
   */
  static async createProduct(rawInput: ProductInput, userId?: string) {
    const validated = productInputSchema.parse(rawInput);

    // Enforce category constraint: PRODUCT categories only (active only for new creations)
    const categories = await this.validateProductCategories(validated.categoryIds, true);
    const categoryNames = categories.map((c) => c.name);

    // Slug uniqueness check
    const existingSlug = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug: validated.slug } });
    if (existingSlug) {
      throw new Error(`محصولی با شناسه لاتین «${validated.slug}» از قبل وجود دارد.`);
    }

    // Compute normalized search text
    const searchText = buildProductSearchText({
      nameFa: validated.nameFa,
      nameOriginal: validated.nameOriginal,
      foodNature: validated.foodNature,
      vitamins: validated.vitamins,
      harvestSeason: validated.harvestSeason,
      harvestPlace: validated.harvestPlace,
      color: validated.color,
      usageWarning: validated.usageWarning,
      benefits: validated.benefits,
      categoryNames,
    });

    const created = await db.product.create({
      data: {
        nameFa: validated.nameFa,
        nameOriginal: validated.nameOriginal || null,
        slug: validated.slug,
        status: validated.status,
        isAvailable: validated.isAvailable,
        isFeatured: validated.isFeatured,
        cardTheme: validated.cardTheme,
        sortOrder: validated.sortOrder,
        shortDescription: validated.shortDescription || null,
        description: validated.description || null,
        foodNature: validated.foodNature || null,
        vitamins: validated.vitamins || null,
        harvestSeason: validated.harvestSeason || null,
        harvestPlace: validated.harvestPlace || null,
        color: validated.color || null,
        usageWarning: validated.usageWarning || null,
        benefits: validated.benefits,
        options: validated.options.map((opt, idx) => ({
          id: opt.id || `opt_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,

          isAvailable: opt.isAvailable,

        })),

      revalidateTag('products', 'max');
      revalidatePath('/products');
      revalidatePath('/admin/products');

      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: created.id,

    });

  /**
   * Updates an existing product with optimistic concurrency conflict detection
   * and automatic SlugRedirect generation upon slug changes.
   */
  static async updateProduct(
    id: string,
    rawInput: Partial<ProductInput>,
    expectedUpdatedAt?: string | Date,
    userId?: string
  ) {
    const existing = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id },
      include: { categories: true },
    });

    // Optimistic Concurrency Control
    if (expectedUpdatedAt && existing.updatedAt) {
      const existingTime = new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();
      const expectedTime = new Date(expectedUpdatedAt).getTime();
      if (Math.abs(existingTime - expectedTime) > 1000) {
        throw new ConcurrencyConflictError(
          'این محصول از زمان بارگذاری توسط کاربر دیگری تغییر یافته است. لطفاً صفحه را تازه‌سازی نمایید.'
        );
      }
    }

    // Slug Redirect Maintenance
    const oldSlug = existing.slug;
    const newSlug = rawInput.slug ?? existing.slug;

    if (rawInput.slug && rawInput.slug !== oldSlug) {
      const conflict = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug: newSlug } });
      if (conflict && conflict.id !== id) {
        throw new Error(`محصول دیگری با شناسه لاتین «${newSlug}» ثبت شده است.`);
      }

      // Create permanent 301 redirect entry
      await db.slugRedirect.create({
        data: {
          entityType: 'PRODUCT',
          oldSlug,
          targetId: id,
        },
      });
    }

    const categoryIds = rawInput.categoryIds ?? existing.categoryIds ?? [];
    const categories = await this.validateProductCategories(categoryIds);
    const categoryNames = categories.map((c) => c.name);

    const nameFa = rawInput.nameFa ?? existing.nameFa;
    const nameOriginal = rawInput.nameOriginal !== undefined ? rawInput.nameOriginal : existing.nameOriginal;
    const foodNature = rawInput.foodNature !== undefined ? rawInput.foodNature : existing.foodNature;
    const vitamins = rawInput.vitamins !== undefined ? rawInput.vitamins : existing.vitamins;
    const harvestSeason = rawInput.harvestSeason !== undefined ? rawInput.harvestSeason : existing.harvestSeason;
    const harvestPlace = rawInput.harvestPlace !== undefined ? rawInput.harvestPlace : existing.harvestPlace;
    const color = rawInput.color !== undefined ? rawInput.color : existing.color;
    const usageWarning = rawInput.usageWarning !== undefined ? rawInput.usageWarning : existing.usageWarning;
    const benefits = rawInput.benefits ?? existing.benefits ?? [];
    const options = rawInput.options ?? existing.options ?? [];

    const searchText = buildProductSearchText({
      nameFa,
      nameOriginal,
      foodNature,
      vitamins,
      harvestSeason,
      harvestPlace,
      color,
      usageWarning,
      benefits,
      categoryNames,
    });

    // Changed field detection for audit log
    const changedFields: string[] = [];
    if (rawInput.nameFa && rawInput.nameFa !== existing.nameFa) changedFields.push('nameFa');
    if (rawInput.slug && rawInput.slug !== existing.slug) changedFields.push('slug');
    if (rawInput.status && rawInput.status !== existing.status) changedFields.push('status');
    if (rawInput.isAvailable !== undefined && rawInput.isAvailable !== existing.isAvailable) changedFields.push('isAvailable');
    if (rawInput.options) changedFields.push('options');
    if (rawInput.benefits) changedFields.push('benefits');

    const updated = await db.product.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        nameFa,
        nameOriginal,
        slug: newSlug,
        status: rawInput.status ?? existing.status,
        isAvailable: rawInput.isAvailable ?? existing.isAvailable,
        isFeatured: rawInput.isFeatured ?? existing.isFeatured,
        cardTheme: rawInput.cardTheme ?? existing.cardTheme,
        sortOrder: rawInput.sortOrder ?? existing.sortOrder,
        shortDescription: rawInput.shortDescription !== undefined ? rawInput.shortDescription : existing.shortDescription,
        description: rawInput.description !== undefined ? rawInput.description : existing.description,
        foodNature,
        vitamins,
        harvestSeason,
        harvestPlace,
        color,
        usageWarning,
        benefits,
        options,
        categoryIds,
        categorySlug: categories[0]?.id?.replace('cat_', '') || existing.categorySlug,
        searchText,
      },
      include: { categories: true, mainImage: true },
    });

    try {
      revalidateTag('products', 'max');
      revalidateTag(`product-${id}`, 'max');
      revalidatePath('/products');
      revalidatePath(`/products/${newSlug}`);
      revalidatePath('/admin/products');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'PRODUCT_UPDATE',
      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: id,
      summary: `Updated product «${updated.nameFa}» (changed: ${changedFields.join(', ') || 'none'})`,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Quick toggle of product availability from list view.
   */
  static async toggleProductAvailability(id: string, isAvailable: boolean, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });

    const updated = await db.product.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isAvailable },
    });

    try {
      revalidateTag('products', 'max');
      revalidateTag(`product-${id}`, 'max');
      revalidatePath('/admin/products');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY_CHANGE',
      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: id,
      summary: `Changed product «${existing.nameFa}» availability to ${isAvailable ? 'موجود' : 'ناموجود'}`,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Duplicates an existing product, copying order options and benefits in DRAFT mode.
   */
  static async duplicateProduct(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const source = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });

    const allProducts = await db.product.findMany();
    const existingSlugs = allProducts.map((p: any) => p.slug);
    const newSlug = resolveSlugCollision(`${source.slug}-copy`, existingSlugs);

    const duplicated = await db.product.create({
      data: {
        ...source,
        id: undefined,
        nameFa: `${source.nameFa} (کپی)`,
        slug: newSlug,
        status: 'DRAFT',
        isFeatured: false,
        options: (source.options || []).map((o: any, idx: number) => ({
          ...o,
          id: `opt_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,
        })),
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    });

    try {
      revalidateTag('products', 'max');
      revalidatePath('/admin/products');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'PRODUCT_DUPLICATE',
      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: duplicated.id,
      summary: `Duplicated product «${source.nameFa}» into new draft «${duplicated.nameFa}» (${duplicated.slug})`,
    });

    return duplicated;
  }

  /**
   * Hard-deletes a product after confirmation.
   */
  static async deleteProduct(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });

    const deleted = await db.product.delete({ where: { id } });

    try {
      revalidateTag('products', 'max');
      revalidatePath('/products');
      revalidatePath('/admin/products');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'PRODUCT_DELETE',
      entityType: 'Product',
      entityId: id,
      summary: `Deleted product «${existing.nameFa}» (${existing.slug})`,
    });

    return deleted;
  }

      revalidateTag(`recipe-${id}`, 'max');
      revalidatePath('/recipes');
      revalidatePath(`/recipes/${newSlug}`);
      revalidatePath('/admin/recipes');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'RECIPE_UPDATE',
      entityType: 'Recipe',
      entityId: id,
      summary: `Updated recipe «${updated.nameFa}» (changed: ${changedFields.join(', ') || 'none'})`,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Duplicates an existing recipe into a new draft.
   */
  static async duplicateRecipe(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const source = await db.recipe.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });

    const allRecipes = await db.recipe.findMany();
    const existingSlugs = allRecipes.map((r: any) => r.slug);
    const newSlug = resolveSlugCollision(`${source.slug}-copy`, existingSlugs);

    const duplicated = await db.recipe.create({
      data: {
        ...source,
        id: undefined,
        nameFa: `${source.nameFa} (کپی)`,
        slug: newSlug,
        status: 'DRAFT',
        isFeatured: false,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    });

    try {
      revalidateTag('recipes', 'max');
      revalidatePath('/admin/recipes');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'RECIPE_DUPLICATE',
      entityType: 'Recipe',
      entityId: duplicated.id,
      summary: `Duplicated recipe «${source.nameFa}» into new draft «${duplicated.nameFa}» (${duplicated.slug})`,
    });

    return duplicated;
  }

  /**
   * Hard-deletes a recipe.
   */
  static async deleteRecipe(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await db.recipe.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });

    const deleted = await db.recipe.delete({ where: { id } });

    try {
      revalidateTag('recipes', 'max');
      revalidatePath('/recipes');
      revalidatePath('/admin/recipes');
    } catch {}

    await recordAuditLog({
      userId,
      action: 'RECIPE_DELETE',
      entityType: 'Recipe',
      entityId: id,
      summary: `Deleted recipe «${existing.nameFa}» (${existing.slug})`,
    });

    return deleted;
  }

export function buildProductSearchText(data: ProductSearchData): string {

    data.nameFa,
    data.nameOriginal || '',
    data.foodNature || '',
    data.vitamins || '',
    data.harvestSeason || '',
    data.harvestPlace || '',
    data.color || '',
    data.usageWarning || '',
    ...(data.benefits || []),

/**
 * Storage Provider Abstraction (Phase 3, Task 1)
 * Decouples file persistence from callers, supporting LocalDiskStorage now
 * and allowing drop-in S3-compatible providers later without touching callers.
 * Implements strict path-traversal prevention.
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export interface SavedFileResult {
  key: string;
  url: string;
  bytes: number;
}

export interface StorageProvider {
  save(buffer: Buffer, key: string, contentType: string): Promise<SavedFileResult>;
  delete(key: string): Promise<boolean>;
  exists(key: string): Promise<boolean>;
  getBuffer(key: string): Promise<Buffer>;
  getPublicUrl(key: string): string;
}

export class LocalDiskStorage implements StorageProvider {
  private baseDir: string;

  constructor(baseDir?: string) {
    this.baseDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), baseDir || process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || './uploads');
    this.ensureDirectory();
  }

  private ensureDirectory(): void {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.baseDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.baseDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resolves key to absolute path and prevents path-traversal attacks.
   */
  public resolveSafePath(key: string): string {
    const cleanKey = path.basename(key);
    const fullPath = path.resolve(this.baseDir, cleanKey);

    // Strictly ensure resolved path resides inside baseDir
    if (!fullPath.startsWith(this.baseDir)) {
      throw new Error(`Path traversal security violation: ${key}`);
    }

    return fullPath;
  }

  async save(buffer: Buffer, key: string, _contentType: string): Promise<SavedFileResult> {
    this.ensureDirectory();
    const filePath = this.resolveSafePath(key);
    await fs.promises.writeFile(filePath, buffer);
    return {
      key: path.basename(key),
      url: this.getPublicUrl(key),
      bytes: buffer.length,
    };
  }

  async delete(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const filePath = this.resolveSafePath(key);
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        await fs.promises.unlink(filePath);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async exists(key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const filePath = this.resolveSafePath(key);
      return fs.existsSync(filePath);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async getBuffer(key: string): Promise<Buffer> {
    const filePath = this.resolveSafePath(key);
    return await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);
  }

  getPublicUrl(key: string): string {
    const cleanKey = path.basename(key);
    return `/uploads/${encodeURIComponent(cleanKey)}`;
  }
}

// Singleton storage provider instance
let storageProviderInstance: StorageProvider | null = null;

export function getStorageProvider(): StorageProvider {
  if (!storageProviderInstance) {
    const providerType = process.env.STORAGE_PROVIDER || 'local';
    if (providerType === 's3') {
      // S3 provider placeholder (can be implemented in future without altering callers)
      throw new Error('S3 storage provider is reserved for future cloud deployment.');
    }
    storageProviderInstance = new LocalDiskStorage();
  }
  return storageProviderInstance;
}

/**
 * Homepage Section CMS Validation Schemas (Brief Section 7)
 *
 * Implements:
 * - Controlled Links with strict path validation (starts with '/', no '//', no 'javascript:')
 * - Section Content Schemas per type and template with schemaVersion: 1
 * - Preserved bucket support for safe roundtrip template switching
 */

import { z } from 'zod';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Controlled Link Schema
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

export const linkTypeEnum = z.enum([
  'NONE',
  'HOME',
  'PRODUCTS_PAGE',
  'RECIPES_PAGE',
  'PRODUCT',
  'RECIPE',
  'CATEGORY',
  'CONTACT_PAGE',
  'INTERNAL_PATH',
]);

export type LinkType = z.infer<typeof linkTypeEnum>;

export const controlledLinkSchema = z.object({
  type: linkTypeEnum.default('NONE'),
  targetId: z.string().optional().nullable(),
  path: z
    .string()
    .optional()
    .nullable()
    .refine((p) => {
      if (!p) return true;
      const clean = p.trim();
      // Must start with single '/', must not start with '//', must not include scheme or javascript:
      return clean.startsWith('/') && !clean.startsWith('//') && !clean.toLowerCase().includes('javascript:');
    }, {
      message: 'مسیر داخلی باید با / شروع شود و نباید شامل پروتکل، // یا کدهای جاوااسکریپت باشد.',
    }),
  label: z.string().max(80).optional().nullable(),
});

export type ControlledLink = z.infer<typeof controlledLinkSchema>;

// Helper to resolve a controlled link to an actual href
export function resolveControlledLink(link?: ControlledLink | null): { href: string; label: string } | null {
  if (!link || link.type === 'NONE') return null;
  const label = link.label?.trim() || 'مشاهده بیشتر';

  switch (link.type) {
    case 'HOME':
      return { href: '/', label };
    case 'PRODUCTS_PAGE':
      return { href: '/products', label: link.label?.trim() || 'مشاهده محصولات' };
    case 'RECIPES_PAGE':
      return { href: '/recipes', label: link.label?.trim() || 'مشاهده دستورها' };
    case 'CONTACT_PAGE':
      return { href: '/contact', label: link.label?.trim() || 'تماس با ما' };
    case 'PRODUCT':
      return link.targetId ? { href: `/products/${link.targetId}`, label } : null;
    case 'RECIPE':
      return link.targetId ? { href: `/recipes/${link.targetId}`, label } : null;
    case 'CATEGORY':
      return link.targetId ? { href: `/products?category=${link.targetId}`, label } : null;
    case 'INTERNAL_PATH':
      return link.path && link.path.startsWith('/') ? { href: link.path, label } : null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Zod Validation Schemas (Phase 1)
 * Inputs for Category, Product (including options), and Recipe.
 * All Persian error messages are sourced from uiStringsFa.
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import { uiStringsFa } from '@/content/ui-strings.fa';

const latinSlugRegex = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Category Schemas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

export const categoryInputSchema = z.object({
  name: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.categoryNameRequired)
    .trim(),
  slug: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.slugRequired)
    .regex(latinSlugRegex, uiStringsFa.validation.slugInvalid)
    .trim(),
  type: z.enum(['PRODUCT', 'RECIPE'] as const),
  status: z.enum(['ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED']).default('ACTIVE'),
  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
});

export type CategoryInput = z.infer<typeof categoryInputSchema>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Product & ProductOption Schemas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

export const productOptionInputSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().optional(),
  label: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.optionLabelRequired)
    .trim(),
  isAvailable: z.boolean().default(true),
  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
});

export type ProductOptionInput = z.infer<typeof productOptionInputSchema>;

export const productInputSchema = z.object({
  nameFa: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.nameFaRequired)
    .trim(),
  nameOriginal: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  slug: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.slugRequired)
    .regex(latinSlugRegex, uiStringsFa.validation.slugInvalid)
    .trim(),
  status: z.enum(['DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED']).default('DRAFT'),
  isAvailable: z.boolean().default(true),
  isFeatured: z.boolean().default(false),
  cardTheme: z.enum(['AUTO', 'GREEN', 'ORANGE', 'YELLOW', 'BURGUNDY']).default('AUTO'),
  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
  shortDescription: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  description: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  foodNature: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  vitamins: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  harvestSeason: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  harvestPlace: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  color: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  usageWarning: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  benefits: z.array(z.string().trim()).default([]),
  options: z.array(productOptionInputSchema).default([]),
  categoryIds: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
});

export type ProductInput = z.infer<typeof productInputSchema>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Recipe Schemas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

export const recipeIngredientInputSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().optional(),
  name: z.string().min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.required).trim(),
  quantityText: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  unit: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  equivalentText: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  isOptional: z.boolean().default(false),
  note: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),
  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
});

  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
});

export const recipeInputSchema = z.object({
  nameFa: z
    .string()
    .min(1, uiStringsFa.validation.nameFaRequired)

  nameOriginal: z.string().trim().optional().nullable(),

  status: z.enum(['DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED']).default('DRAFT'),
  isFeatured: z.boolean().default(false),
  cardTheme: z.enum(['AUTO', 'GREEN', 'ORANGE', 'YELLOW', 'BURGUNDY']).default('AUTO'),
  sortOrder: z.coerce.number().int().default(0),
  ingredients: z.array(recipeIngredientInputSchema).default([]),
  steps: z.array(recipeStepInputSchema).default([]),
  categoryIds: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
});
